H1.gloss: a primitive word; father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application):--chief, (fore-)father(-less), ×  patrimony, principal. Compare names in "Abi-".
H1.outline:
- father of an individual
- of God as father of his people
- head or founder of a household, group, family, or clan
- ancestor
- grandfather, forefathers -- of person
- of people
- originator or patron of a class, profession, or art
- of producer, generator (fig.)
- of benevolence and protection (fig.)
- term of respect and honour
- ruler or chief (spec.)

H3.gloss: from the same as «024»; a green plant:--greenness, fruit.
H3.outline: - freshness, fresh green, green shoots, or greenery

H5.gloss: of foreign origin; Abagtha, a eunuch of Xerxes:--Abagtha.
H5.outline:
Abagtha = "God-given"
- one of the seven eunuchs in the Persian court of Ahasuerus

H6.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy):--break, destroy(- uction), + not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, ×  and surely, take, be undone, ×  utterly, be void of, have no way to flee.
H6.outline:
- perish, vanish, go astray, be destroyed
- (Qal)
- perish, die, be exterminated
- perish, vanish (fig.)
- be lost, strayed
- (Piel)
- to destroy, kill, cause to perish, to give up (as lost), exterminate
- to blot out, do away with, cause to vanish, (fig.)
- cause to stray, lose
- (Hiphil)
- to destroy, put to death 1c
- of divine judgment
- object name of kings (fig.)

H7.outline:
- to perish, vanish
- (P'al) shall perish
- (Aphel) destroy
- (Hophal) be destroyed

H8.gloss: active of participle of «06»; (concrete) wretched or (abstract) destructin:--perish.

H9.gloss: from «06»; concrete, something lost; abstract, destruction, i.e. Hades:--lost. Compare «010».

H10.gloss: the same as «09», miswritten for «011»; a perishing:-- destruction.
H10.outline: - a lost thing, something lost, a perishing

H11.gloss: intensive from «06»; abstract, a perishing; concrete, Hades:--destruction.
H11.outline: - place of destruction, destruction, ruin, Abaddon

H14.gloss: a primitive root; to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent:--consent, rest content will, be willing.
H14.outline:
- to be willing, consent
- (Qal)
- to be willing
- to consent, yield to, accept
- to desire

H16.gloss: from «014» (in the sense of bending toward); the papyrus:--swift.
H16.outline: - reed, papyrus ++++ Probably ships made of reeds or papyrus were the clipper sailing ships of those days because of their speed.

H17.gloss: from «014» (in the sense of desiring); want:--sorrow.
H17.outline: - Oh!, Woe!, (exclamation of pain -- indicates desire or uneasiness)

H19.gloss: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn); brandishing of a sword:--point.

H20.gloss: of uncertain derivation; a melon (only plural):--melon.

H22.gloss: from «01» and «0410»; father (i.e. possessor) of God; Abiel, the name of two Israelites:--Abiel.

H23.gloss: from «01» and «0622»; father of gathering (i.e. gatherer); Abiasaph, an Israelite:--Abiasaph.
H23.outline:
Abiasaph = "my father has gathered"
- son (descendant) of Korah

H24.gloss: from an unused root (meaning to be tender); green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan:--Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize).
H24.outline:
- fresh, young barley ears, barley
- month of ear-forming, of greening of crop, of growing green Abib, month of exodus and passover (March or April)

H25.gloss: from «01» and «01391»; father (i.e. founder) of Gibon; Abi-Gibon, perhaps an Israelite:--father of Gibeon.
H25.outline:
Abi Gibon = "father of Gibeon"
- site of great Bamah, location of the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place

H26.gloss: or shorter Abiygal {ab-ee-gal'}; from «01» and «01524»; father (i.e. source) of joy; Abigail or Abigal, the name of two Israelitesses:--Abigal.
H26.outline:
Abigail = "my father is joy"
- wife of Nabal, then of David
- sister of David

H27.gloss: from «01» and «01777»; father of judgment (i.e. judge); Abidan, an Israelite:--Abidan.
H27.outline:
Abidan = "my father is judge"
- a prince (ruler) of Benjamin

H28.gloss: from «01» and «03045»; father of knowledge (i.e. knowing); Abida, a son of Abraham by Keturah:--Abida, Abidah.
H28.outline:
Abida or Abidah = "my father knows"
- fourth son of Midian and grandson of Abraham by his wife Keturah (after Sarah died)

H29.gloss: or prolonged Abiyahuw {ab-ee-yaw'-hoo}; from «01» and «03050»; father (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Abijah, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses:--Abiah, Abijah.
H29.outline:
Abia or Abiah or Abijah = "Jehovah is (my) father"
- king of Judah, son and successor of Rehoboam
- second son of Samuel
- son of Jeroboam the first, king of Israel
- son of Becher, a Benjamite
- head of a priestly house (one of the 24 Levite groups)
- head of a priestly house (after the exile)
- wife of Hezron
- mother of Hezekiah (cf
-

H30.gloss: from «01» and «01931»; father (i.e. worshipper) of Him (i.e. God); Abihu, a son of Aaron:--Abihu.
H30.outline:
Abihu = "he is (my) father"
- a son of Aaron destroyed for sacrificing strange fire to God

H31.gloss: from «01» and «01935»; father (i.e. possessor) of renown; Abihud, the name of two Israelites:--Abihud.
H31.outline:
Ahihud = "my father is majesty"
- son of Bela, a Benjamite

H32.gloss: or (more correctly) hAbiychayil {ab-ee- khah'-yil}; from 1 and «02428»; father (i.e. possessor) of might; Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses:--Abihail.
H32.outline:
Abihail = "my father is might"
- a Levite in Moses's time
- a Gadite
- father of Esther
- wife of Abishur
- wife of Rehoboam

H33.gloss: from «044» with the article inserted; father of the Ezrite; an Abiezrite or descendant of Abiezer; -- Abiezrite.
H33.outline:
Abiezrite = "my father is help"
- one of the family of Abiezer, a descendant of Joseph's son, Manasseh

H34.gloss: from «014», in the sense of want (especially in feeling); destitute:--beggar, needy, poor (man).
H34.outline:
- in want, needy, chiefly poor, needy person
- subject to oppression and abuse
- needing help, deliverance from trouble, especially as delivered by God
- general reference to lowest class

H35.gloss: from «014»; provocative of desire; the caper berry (from its stimulative taste):--desire.

H36.gloss: from «01» and «02898»; father of goodness (i.e. good); Abitub, an Israelite:--Abitub.
H36.outline:
Abitub = "my father is good(ness)"
- son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite

H37.gloss: from «01» and «02919»; father of dew (i.e. fresh); Abital, a wife of King David:--Abital.
H37.outline:
Abital = "my father is (the) dew"
- a wife of David

H38.gloss: from «01» and «03220»; father of (the) sea (i.e. seaman); Abijam (or Abijah), a king of Judah:--Abijam.
H38.outline:
Abijam = "my father is the sea" or "Yah(u) is (my) father"
- king of Judah, son and successor of Rehoboam

H39.gloss: from «01» and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe); Abimael, a son of Joktan:--Abimael.
H39.outline:
Abimael = "my father is El (God)"
- son of Joktan, descendant of Shem

H40.gloss: from «01» and «04428»; father of (the) king; Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites:--Abimelech.
H40.outline:
Abimelech = "Melek is father" or "my father is king"
- king of Gerar in Abraham's time
- king of Gath in David's time; maybe title of Philistine kings
- son of Gideon by a concubine
- priest, son of Abiathar

H41.gloss: from «01» and «05068»; father of generosity (i.e. liberal); Abinadab, the name of four Israelites:--Abinadab.
H41.outline:
Abinadab = "my father is noble" or "my father is willing"
- a man of Gibeah who sheltered the ark
- second son of Jesse, David's older brother
- a son of Saul, slain with him by the Philistines

H42.gloss: from «01» and «05278»; father of pleasantness (i.e. gracious); Abinoam, an Israelite:--Abinoam.
H42.outline:
Abinoam = "my father is delight"
- father of Barak, descendant of Naphtali

H43.outline:
Ebiasaph = "my father has gathered"
- a son or descendant of Korah

H44.gloss: from «01» and «05829»; father of help (i.e. helpful); Abiezer, the name of two Israelites:--Abiezer.
H44.outline:
Abiezer = "my father is help"
- a Manassite, called "son" of Gilead, also son of Gilead's sister
- a Benjamite, warrior of David

H45.gloss: from «01» and and an unused root of uncertain. derivation; probably, father of strength (i.e. valiant); Abialbon, an Israelite:--Abialbon.
H45.outline:
Abialbon = "El (God) is my father"
- one of David's mighty men (hero)

H46.outline:
- strong, mighty - used only to describe God
- the Strong - old name for God (poetic)

H47.gloss: for «046»; --angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout(-hearted), strong (one), valiant.
H47.outline:
- mighty, valiant
- of men
- of angels
- of animals
- (metaph)
- of enemies
- of princes
- of sacrificial objects
- obstinate (fig.)

H48.gloss: from «01» and «07311»; father of height (i.e. lofty); Abiram, the name of two Israelites:--Abiram.
H48.outline:
Abiram = "my father is exalted" or "(the) Exalted One is (my) father"
- a Reubenite, son of Eliab in exodus
- son of Hiel the Bethelite who worked to rebuild Jericho

H49.gloss: from «01» and «07686»; father of error (i.e. blundering); Abishag, a concubine of David:--Abishag.
H49.outline:
Abishag = "my father is a wanderer"
- David's beautiful young nurse

H50.gloss: from «01» and «07771»; father of plenty (i.e. prosperous); Abishua, the name of two Israelites:--Abishua.
H50.outline:
Abishua = "my father is rescue (safety), or is opulence"
- son of Phinehas, grandson of Aaron

H51.gloss: from «01» and «07791»; father of (the) wall (i.e. perhaps mason); Abishur, an Israelite:--Abishur.
H51.outline:
Abishur = "my father is a wall"
- son of Shammai, descendant of Judah

H52.gloss: or (shorter) Abshay {ab-shah'ee}; from «01» and «07862»; father of a gift (i.e. probably generous); Abishai, an Israelite:--Abishai.
H52.outline:
Abishai = "my father is Jesse" or "my father is a gift"
- grandson of Jesse, nephew of David via his sister Zeruiah, brother of Joab

H53.gloss: or (shortened) bAbshalowm {ab-shaw- lome'}; from «01» and «07965»; father of peace (i.e. friendly); Abshalom, a son of David; also (the fuller form) a later Israelite:--Abishalom, Absalom.
H53.outline:
Absalom or Abishalom = "my father is peace"
- father-in-law of Rehoboam
- third son of David, killer of first-born son Amnon, also leader of revolt against his father - David

H54.gloss: contracted from «01» and «03498»; father of abundance (i.e. liberal); Ebjathar, an Israelite:--Abiathar.
H54.outline:
Abiathar = "my father is great"
- priest, son of Ahitub (Ahimelech), faithful to David, but later rebelled with Adonijah

H55.gloss: a primitive root; probably to coil upward:--mount up.
H55.outline:
- to roll, turn
- (Hithpael) to roll, roll up, billow

H56.gloss: a primitive root; to bewail:--lament, mourn.
H56.outline:
- to mourn, lament
- (Qal) to mourn, lament
- of humans
- of inanimate objects (fig.) 1a
- of gates 1a
- of land
- (Hiphil)
- to mourn, cause to mourn (fig.)
- (Hithpael)
- to mourn
- play the mourner

H57.outline:
- mourning
- for the dead
- because of calamity
- of rites of mourning
- mourner (subst.)
- for the dead
- for calamity

H58.gloss: from an unused root (meaning to be grassy); a meadow:--plain. Compare also the proper names beginning with Abel-.
H58.outline: - meadow (from verb - to grow green, to withstand)

H59.gloss: from «058»; a meadow; Abel, the name of two places in Palestine.:--Abel.
H59.outline:
- city in northern Israel near Bethmaachah
- the place where the ark rested in the field of Joshua at Bethshemesh

H60.outline:
- mourning
- for the dead
- for rites of mourning (metaph)
- mourning garb
- period of mourning

H61.gloss: apparently from «056» through the idea of negation; nay, i.e. truly or yet:--but, indeed, nevertheless, verily.
H61.outline:
- truly, verily, surely
- but, however, howbeit
- contrariwise, nay rather (neg.)

H62.gloss: from «058» and «01004» and «04601»; meadow of Beth-Maakah; Abel of Beth-maakah, a place in Palestine:--Abel-beth-maachah, Abel of Beth-maachah,
H62.outline:
Abel Beth Maachah = "meadow of the house of Maachah"
- city in northern Israel near Beth Maachah

H63.gloss: from «058» and the plural of «07848», with the article inserted; meadow of the acacias; Abel hash- Shittim, a place in Palestine:--Abel-shittim.
H63.outline:
Abel Shittim = "meadow of acacias"
- place in lowlands of Moab

H64.gloss: from «058» and the plural of «03754»; meadow of vineyards; Abel-Keramim, a place in Palestine:--plain of the vineyards.
H64.outline:
Abel Keramim = "meadow of the vineyards"
- a place in Ammon

H65.gloss: from «058» and «04246»; meadow of dancing; Abel-Mecholah, a place in Palestine:--Abel-meholah.
H65.outline:
Abel Meholah = "meadow of dancing"
- a city of Issachar, birthplace of Elisha

H66.gloss: from «058» and «04325»; meadow of water; Abel-Majim, a place in Palestine:--Abel-maim.
H66.outline:
Abel Maim = "meadow of waters"
- a city in northern Israel (perhaps Abel Beth Maachah)

H67.gloss: from «058» and «04714»; meadow of Egypt; Abel-Mitsrajim, a place in Palestine:--Abel-mizraim.
H67.outline:
Abel Mizraim = "meadow of Egypt"
- a place east of the Jordan (perhaps "as fertile as Egypt")

H68.gloss: from the root of «01129» through the meaning to build; a stone:--+ carbuncle, + mason, + plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-)stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s).
H68.outline:
- stone (large or small)
- common stone (in natural state)
- stone, as material
- of tablets
- marble, hewn stones
- precious stones, stones of fire
- stones containing metal (ore), tool for work or weapon
- weight
- plummet (stones of destruction) also made of metal
- stonelike objects, eg hailstones, stony heart, ice
- sacred object, as memorial Samuel set up to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines
- (simile)
- sinking in water, motionlessness
- strength, firmness, solidity
- commonness
- (metaph)
- petrified with terror
- perverse, hard heart

H69.outline:
- stone
- a (the) stone
- stone, material of idols and buildings

H70.gloss: from the same as «068»; a pair of stones (only dual); a potter's wheel or a midwife's stool (consisting alike of two horizontal disks with a support between):--wheel, stool.
H70.outline:
- wheel, disc
- potter's wheel
- bearing-stool, midwife's stool

H71.gloss: perhaps feminine of «068»; stony; Abanah, a river near Damascus:--Abana. Compare «0549».
H71.outline: - river Abana, Syrian river flowing through Damascus

H72.gloss: from «068» and «05828» with the article inserted; stone of the help; Eben-ha-Ezer, a place in Palestine:--Ebenezer.
H72.outline:
Ebenezer = "stone of help"
- memorial stone erected by Samuel to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines - north of Jerusalem

H73.outline:
- girdle, sash, waistband
- of high priest
- of other priests
- of high official

H74.gloss: or (fully) nAbiyner {ab-ee-nare'}; from «01» and «05216»; father of light (i.e. enlightening); Abner, an Israelite:--Abner.
H74.outline:
Abner = "my father is a lamp"
- Saul's cousin and army captain, treacherously slain by Joab

H75.gloss: a primitive root; to fodder:--fatted, stalled.

H76.gloss: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth); an inflammatory pustule (as eruption):--blains.
H76.outline: - blisters, boils (from root, to swell up)

H77.gloss: from an unused root probably meaning to gleam; conspicuous; Ebets, a place in Palestine:--Abez.
H77.outline:
Abez = "I will make white (or miry)"
- a city in Issachar

H78.gloss: from the same as «076»; splendid; Ibtsan, an Israelite:--Ibzan.
H78.outline:
Ibzan, "their whiteness (literally their tin -- as white"
- a Bethlehemite judge in time of the judges

H79.gloss: a primitive root, probably to float away (as vapor), but used only as denominative from «080»; to bedust, i.e. grapple:-- wrestle.

H80.gloss: from root of «079»; light particles (as volatile):--(small) dust, powder.

H83.outline:
- pinion, wing
- of bird (dove, eagle)
- of Babylonian king (fig.)

H84.outline:
- pinion, wing
- of bird (ostrich, eagle, dove)
- of God (metaph)

H85.gloss: contracted from «01» and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous); father of a multitude; Abraham, the later name of Abram:--Abraham.
H85.outline:
Abraham = "father of a multitude" or "chief of multitude"
- friend of God and founder of Hebrew nation via God's elective covenant

H86.gloss: probably an Egyptian word meaning kneel:--bow the knee.
H86.outline:
- (meaning dubious) - a shout made to announce Joseph's chariot
- command
- bow

H87.gloss: contracted from «048»; high father; Abram, the original name of Abraham:--Abram.
H87.outline:
Abram = "exalted father"
- original name of Abraham

H88.gloss: plural of «0178»; water-skins; Oboth, a place in the Desert:--Oboth.
H88.outline:
Oboth = "waterskins"
- undetermined site of an Israelite camp in the wilderness (perhaps at east boundary of Moab)

H89.gloss: of uncertain derivation (compare «090»); Age, an Israelite:--Agee.
H89.outline:
Agee = "I shall increase"
- father of a warrior of David

H90.gloss: or uAgag {Ag-awg'}; of uncertain derivation (compare «089»); flame; Agag, a title of Amalekitish kings:--Agag.
H90.outline:
Agag = "I will overtop"
- king of Amalek, spared by Saul but slain by Samuel

H91.gloss: patrial or patronymic from «090»; an Agagite or descendent (subject) of Agag:--Agagite.
H91.outline:
Agagite = "I will overtop"
- said of Haman, Haman the Agagite

H92.gloss: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind); a band, bundle, knot, or arch:--bunch, burden, troop.
H92.outline:
- band, binding
- cords, bands, thongs (metaphorical of slavery)
- bunch of hyssop
- band of men, troops
- vault (of the heavens), firmament (binding earth to the heavens)

H93.gloss: prob of Persian origin; a nut:--nut.

H94.gloss: passive participle of «0103»; gathered (i.e. received among the sages); Agur, a fanciful name for Solomon:--Agur.
H94.outline:
Agur = "gathered"
- son of Jakeh, an author or compiler of Provs 30

H95.gloss: from the same as «094»; properly, something gathered, i.e. perhaps a grain or berry; used only of a small (silver) coin:--piece (of) silver.

H96.gloss: from an unused root (meaning to flow down or together as drops); a reservoir:--drop.

H97.gloss: dual of «096».; a double pond; Eglajim, a place in Moab:--Eglaim.
H97.outline:
Eglaim = "double reservoir"
- a town in Moab

H98.gloss: from an unused root (meaning to collect as water); a marsh; hence a rush (as growing in swamps); hence a stockade of reeds:--pond, pool, standing (water).
H98.outline:
- pool, troubled pool
- troubled or muddy (gloomy) pools, marshes
- any pool, pond
- swamp reeds, reeds, rush(es)

H99.gloss: probably from the same as «098» (in the sense of stagnant water); figuratively, sad:--pond.

H100.gloss: from the same as «098»; a marshy pool (others from a different root, a kettle); by implication a rush (as growing there); collectively a rope of rushes:--bulrush, caldron, hook, rush.
H100.outline:
- rush, bulrush
- used as cord or line (of twisted rushes or spun of rush fibre)
- of the lowly, insignificant (metaph)
- sad, drooping
- of line of bulrushes
- bowing of the head (fig.)
- of the lowly (metaph)

H101.gloss: probably from «05059»; a bowl (as pounded out hollow):--basin, cup, goblet.
H101.outline:
- bowl, basins
- basins used in ritual
- human body (metaph), curves of the body (simile)
- of family of Eliakim (metaph)

H102.gloss: probably from «05062» (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; i.e. (only plural) wings of an army, or crowds of troops:--bands.
H102.outline: - wing (of an army), band, army, hordes

H104.gloss: (Aramaic) of Persian origin; an epistle (as carried by a state courier or postman):--letter.
H104.outline: - letter, missive (Aramaic loan-word used in last OT books)

H106.gloss: from «01640» (in the sense of grasping); the clenched hand:--fist.

H108.gloss: from the same as «0181» (in the sense of enveloping); a fog:-- mist, vapor.

H109.outline:
- to grieve, cause grief
- (Hiph) to cause to grieve, to grieve, to cause grief

H110.gloss: probably from «0109» (in the sense of chastisement) and «0410»; disciplined of God; Adbeel, a son of Ishmael:--Adbeel.
H110.outline:
Adbeel = "chastened of God"
- third son of Ishmael and grandson of Abraham

H111.gloss: probably an orthographical variation for «02301»; Adad (or Hadad), an Edomite:--Hadad.
H111.outline:
Hadad = "I shall move softly: I shall love"
- an Edomite enemy God raised up to punish Solomon for his sins

H112.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Iddo, an Israelite:--Iddo.
H112.outline:
Iddo = "I will praise him"
- a chief Israelite during resettlement

H113.gloss: or (shortened) adon {aw-done'}; from an unused root (meaning to rule); sovereign, i.e. controller (human or divine):-- lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with "Adoni-".
H113.outline:
- firm, strong, lord, master
- lord, master
- reference to men 1a
- superintendent of household,of affairs 1a
- master 1a
- king
- reference to God 1a
- the Lord God 1a
- Lord of the whole earth
- lords, kings
- reference to men 1b
- proprietor of hill of Samaria 1b
- master 1b
- husband 1b
- prophet 1b
- governor 1b
- prince 1b
- king
- reference to God 1b
- Lord of lords (probably = "thy husband, Yahweh")
- my lord, my master
- reference to men 1c
- master 1c
- husband 1c
- prophet 1c
- prince 1c
- king 1c
- father 1c
- Moses 1c
- priest 1c
- theophanic angel 1c
- captain 1c
- general recognition of superiority
- reference to God 1c
- my Lord,my Lord and my God 1c
- Adonai (parallel with Yahweh)

H114.gloss: probably intensive for «0113»; powerful; Addon, apparently an Israelite:--Addon.

H115.gloss: dual from «0142» (in the sense of eminence); double mound; Adorajim, a place in Palestine:--Adoraim.
H115.outline:
Adoraim = "double glory"
- city in Judah fortified by Rehoboam about 5 miles or 8 km SW of Hebron

H116.gloss: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; then (of time):--now, that time, then.
H116.outline: - then, afterwards, thereupon, from that time

H117.gloss: from «0142»; wide or (generally) large; figuratively, powerful:--excellent, famous, gallant, glorious, goodly, lordly, mighty(- ier one), noble, principal, worthy.
H117.outline:
- great, majestic
- of waters of sea
- of a tree
- of kings, nations, gods

- how! (in lamentation)
- expression of satisfaction

H350.gloss: from «0336» and «03519»; (there is) no glory, i.e. inglorious; Ikabod, a son of Phineas:--I-chabod.
H350.outline:
Ichabod = "no glory"
- a son of Phinehas, so named because of the capture of the Ark by the Philistines

H351.gloss: probably a variation for «0349», but not as an interogative; where:--where.

H352.gloss: from the same as «0193»; properly, strength; hence, anything strong; specifically a chief (politically); also a ram (from his strength); a pilaster (as a strong support); an oak or other strong tree:--mighty (man), lintel, oak, post, ram, tree.
H352.outline:
- ram
- ram (as food)
- ram (as sacrifice)
- ram (skin dyed red, for tabernacle)
- pillar, door post, jambs, pilaster
- strong man, leader, chief
- mighty tree, terebinth

H354.gloss: an intensive form of «0352» (in the sense of ram); a stag or male deer:--hart.

H355.gloss: feminine of «0354»; a doe or female deer:--hind.

H356.gloss: or (shortened) ;Elown {ay-lone'}; or Eylon {ay- lone'}; from «0352»; oak-grove; Elon, the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelites:--Elon.
H356.outline:
Elon = "terebinth, mighty"
- Hittite, father-in-law of Esau
- second son of Zebulun
- Zebulonite judge of Israel
- town in Dan

H357.gloss: from «0354»; deer-field; Ajalon, the name of five places in Palestine:--Aijalon, Ajalon.
H357.outline:
Ajalon or Aijalon = "field of deer"
- Levitical city in Dan, 14 miles or 25 km NW of Jerusalem, later ruled by the Amorites, then the Benjamites of Judah, then by the Philistines
- a city of Zebulun, site unknown

H358.gloss: from «0356», «01004», and «02603»; oak-grove of (the) house of favor; Elon of Beth-chanan, a place in Palestine:--Elon-beth-hanan.
H358.outline:
Elon Beth-hanan = "oak of the house of grace"
- a city of Dan

H359.gloss: or mEylath {ay-lath'}; from «0352»; trees or a grove (i.e. palms); Eloth or Elath, a place on the Red Sea:--Elath, Eloth.
H359.outline:
Elath or Eloth = "grove of lofty trees"
- a port on the north-east arm of the Red Sea

H360.gloss: feminine of «0353»; power; by implication, protection:--strength.

H361.gloss: or (shortened) ;elam {ay-lawm'}; or (feminine) ielammah {ay-lam-maw'}; probably from «0352»; a pillar-space (or colonnade), i.e. a pale (or portico):--arch.

H362.gloss: plural of «0352»; palm-trees; Elim, a place in the Desert:--Elim.
H362.outline:
Elim = "palms"
- second encampment of the Israelites after the Exodus

H364.gloss: from «0352» and «06290»; oak of Paran; El- Paran, a portion of the district of Paran:--El-paran.
H364.outline:
El-paran = "palm of Paran"
- town and harbour at tip of Gulf of Aqaba on the Red Sea

H365.gloss: the same as «0355»; a doe:--hind, Aijeleth.
H365.outline:
- doe, deer, hind
- "Aijeleth Shahar" is part of the title of Ps. 22 and probably describes to the musician the melody to which the psalm was to be played

H366.gloss: from an unused root (meaning to frighten); frightful:--terrible.

H367.gloss: or (shortened) remah {ay-maw'}; from the same as «0366»; fright; concrete, an idol (as a bugbear):--dread, fear, horror, idol, terrible, terror.

H368.gloss: plural of «0367»; terrors; Emim, an early Canaanitish (or Maobitish) tribe:--Emims.

H369.gloss: as if from a primitive root meaning to be nothing or not exist; a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle:--else, except, fail, (father-)less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past,  un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare «0370».
H369.outline:
- nothing, not, nought n
- nothing, nought neg
- not
- to have not (of possession) adv
- without w/prep
- for lack of

H370.gloss: probably identical with «0369» in the sense of query (compare «0336»); --where? (only in connection with prepositional prefix, whence):--whence, where.

H371.gloss: apparently a shortened form of «0369»; but (like «0370») an interrogative: is it not?:--not.
H371.outline: - Is there not?, Have you not?

H372.gloss: from «0336» and «05828»; helpless; Iezer, an Israelite:--Jeezer.
H372.outline:
Jeezer = "no help"
- a descendant of Manasseh

H373.gloss: patronymic from «0372»; an Iezrite or descendant of Iezer:--Jezerite.
H373.outline:
Jeezerite = "no help"
- one of the tribe of Jeezer

H374.gloss: or (shortened)  ephah {ay-faw'}; of Egyptian derivation; an ephah or measure for grain; hence, a measure in general:-- ephah, (divers) measure(-s).
H374.outline:
- ephah
- a dry measure of quantity, equal to 3 seahs, 10 omers; the same as the liquid measure bath; (about 9 imperial gallons (40 l), rabbinical writings give sizes of one-half this amount)
- the receptacle for measuring or holding that amount

H375.gloss: from «0335» and «06311»; what place?; also (of time) when?; or (of means) how?; --what manner, where.

H376.gloss: contracted for «0582» (or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to be extant); a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation):--also, another, any (man), a certain, + champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-)man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), + none, one, people, person, + steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare «0802».
H376.outline:
- man
- man, male (in contrast to woman, female)
- husband
- human being, person (in contrast to God)
- servant
- mankind
- champion
- great man
- whosoever
- each (adjective)

H377.gloss: denominative from «0376»; to be a man, i.e. act in a manly way:--show (one) self a man.
H377.outline: - (Hithpalel) to be a man, show masculinity, champion, great man

H378.gloss: from «0376» and «01322»; man of shame; Ish- Bosheth, a son of King Saul:--Ish-bosheth.
H378.outline:
Ishbosheth = "man of shame"
- surviving son of Saul, king of Israel for 7 years while David was king over Judah; succeeded by David who united the kingdom

H379.gloss: from «0376» and «01935»; man of renown; Ishod, an Israelite:--Ishod.
H379.outline:
Ishod = "man of majesty"
- a Manassite from east of the Jordan

H380.gloss: diminutive from «0376»; the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence, the middle (of night):--apple (of the eye), black, obscure.
H380.outline:
- pupil of the eye
- middle of the night (that is the deepest blackness)

H381.gloss: from «0376» and «02428»; man of might; by defect. transcription (2 Sam. 23:20)  Iysh-Chay {eesh-khah'ee}; as if from «0376» and «02416»; living man; Ish-chail (or Ish-chai), an Israelite:--a valiant man.

H382.gloss: from «0376» and «02897»; man of Tob; Ish-Tob, a place in Palestine:--Ish-tob.
H382.outline:
Ishtob = "man of Tob"
- a region beyond Jordan, north or northeast of Gilead

H383.gloss: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03426»; properly, entity; used only as a particle of affirmation, there is:--art thou, can, do ye, have, it be, there is (are), × we will not.
H383.outline:
- there is, there are
- particle denoting existence

H384.gloss: perhaps from «0837» and «0410»; God has arrived; Ithiel, the name of an Israelite, also of a symbolical person:--Ithiel.
H384.outline:
Ithiel = "God is with me"
- the disciple to whom Agur gave proverbs
- a Benjamite in Nehemiah's time

H385.gloss: from «0339» and «08558»; coast of the palm-tree; Ithamar, a son of Aaron:--Ithamar.
H385.outline:
Ithamar = "coast of palms"
- fourth and youngest son of Aaron

H386.gloss: or (shortened) ethan {ay-thawn'}; from an unused root (meaning to continue); permanence; hence (concrete) permanent; specifically a chieftain:--hard, mighty, rough, strength, strong.
H386.outline:
- perpetual, constant, perennial, ever-flowing
- ever-flowing (of a stream)
- permanence, permanent, enduring (fig.)

H387.gloss: the same as «0386»; permanent; Ethan, the name of four Israelites:--Ethan.
H387.outline:
Ethan = "enduring"
- an Ezrahite known for his wisdom
- a grandson of Judah, father of Azariah
- a Kohathite descendant of Levi
- a Merarite son of Kushaiah, descendant of Levi

H388.gloss: plural of «0386»; always with the article; the permanent brooks; Ethanim, the name of a month:--Ethanim.
H388.outline:
Ethanim = "enduring"
- seventh Jewish month, corresponding to modern Oct. to Nov.; so named because permanent streams still flowed

H389.gloss: akin to «0403»; a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only:--also, in any wise, at least, but, certainly, even, howbeit, nevertheless, notwithstanding, only, save, surely, of a surety, truly, verily, + wherefore, yet (but).
H389.outline:
- indeed, surely (emphatic)
- howbeit, only, but, yet (restrictive)

H390.gloss: from an unused root probably meaning to strengthen; a fortress; Accad, a place in Babylon:--Accad.
H390.outline:
Accad = "subtle"
- a city in north Babylonia, also the district around it

H391.gloss: from «03576»; falsehood; by implication treachery:--liar, lie.
H391.outline: - deceitful, treacherous, deception, lie, deceptive, disappointing

H392.gloss: from «0391»; deceitful (in the sense of a winter- torrent which fails in summer); Akzib, the name of two places in Palestine:--Achzib.
H392.outline:
Achzib = "deceit"
- a town in the lowland of west Judah
- a town in Asher by the Sea of Galilee

H393.gloss: from an unused root (apparently meaning to act harshly); violent; by implication deadly; also (in a good sense) brave:--cruel, fierce.

H396.gloss: feminine from «0398»; something eatable, i.e. food:--meat.
H396.outline: - food, a meal, an eating, meat

H397.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Akish, a Philistine king:--Achish.
H397.outline:
Achish = "I will blacken (or terrify)" or "only a man"
- Philistine king of Gath

H398.gloss: a primitive root; to eat (literally or figuratively):--X at all, burn up, consume, devour(-er, up), dine, eat(-er, up), feed (with), food, × freely, × in...wise(-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, × quite.
H398.outline:
- to eat, devour, burn up, feed
- (Qal)
- to eat (human subject)
- to eat, devour (of beasts and birds)
- to devour, consume (of fire)
- to devour, slay (of sword)
- to devour, consume, destroy (inanimate subjects - ie, pestilence, drought)
- to devour (of oppression)
- (Niphal)
- to be eaten (by men)
- to be devoured, consumed (of fire)
- to be wasted, destroyed (of flesh)
- (Pual)
- to cause to eat, feed with
- to cause to devour
- (Hiphil)
- to feed
- to cause to eat
- (Piel)
- consume

H399.outline:
- to eat, devour
- (P'al)
- to eat (of beasts)
- to devour
- eat their pieces (in a phrase, that is, slander them)

H400.gloss: from «0398»; food:--eating, food, meal(-time), meat, prey, victuals.
H400.outline:
- food
- cereal
- meat
- food supply
- meal, dinner

H401.gloss: or mUkkal {ook-kawl'}; apparently from «0398»; devoured; Ucal, a fancy name:--Ucal.
H401.outline:
Ucal = "devoured"
- student or disciple of Agur

H402.gloss: feminine of «0401»; food:--consume, devour, eat, food, meat.
H402.outline:
- food
- food, eating
- object of devouring, consuming
- by wild beasts (figurative)
- in fire
- of judgment (figurative)

H403.gloss: from «03559» (compare «03651»); firmly; figuratively, surely; also (advers.) but:--but, certainly, nevertheless, surely, truly, verily.
H403.outline:
- surely, truly, indeed
- truly, indeed (strong assertive force)
- but indeed, but in fact (emphasizing a contrast)

H404.gloss: a primitive root; apparently meaning to curve (as with a burden); to urge:--crave.

H405.gloss: from «0404»; a load; by implication, a stroke (others dignity):--hand.

H406.gloss: from an unused root meaning to dig; a farmer:--husbandman, ploughman.
H406.outline:
- plowman, husbandman, farmer
- working the land, yet not owning any of it

H407.gloss: from «03784»; fascination; Acshaph, a place in Palestine:--Achshaph.
H407.outline:
Achshaph = "I shall be bewitched"
- city in north Canaan at foot of Mt Carmel

H408.gloss: a negative particle (akin to «03808»); not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing:--nay, neither, + never, no ,nor, not, nothing (worth), rather than.
H408.outline:
- not, no, nor, neither, nothing (as wish or preference)
- do not, let not (with a verb)
- let there not be (with a verb understood)
- not, no (with substantive)
- nothing (as substantive)

H410.gloss: shortened from «0352»; strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity):--God (god), × goodly, × great, idol, might(-y one), power, strong. Compare names in "-el."
H410.outline:
- god, god-like one, mighty one
- mighty men, men of rank, mighty heroes
- angels
- god, false god, (demons, imaginations)
- God, the one true God, Jehovah
- mighty things in nature
- strength, power

H411.gloss: a demonstrative particle (but only in a plural sense) these or those:--these, those. Compare «0428».

H413.gloss: (but only used in the shortened constructive form sel {el}); a primitive particle; properly, denoting motion towards, but occasionally used of a quiescent position, i.e. near, with or among; often in general, to:--about, according to ,after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, × hath, in(- to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
H413.outline:
- to, toward, unto (of motion)
- into (limit is actually entered)
- in among
- toward (of direction, not necessarily physical motion)
- against (motion or direction of a hostile character)
- in addition to, to
- concerning, in regard to, in reference to, on account of
- according to (rule or standard)
- at, by, against (of one's presence)
- in between, in within, to within, unto (idea of motion to)

H414.gloss: a variation of «0424»; oak; Ela, an Israelite:--Elah.
H414.outline:
Elah = "oak"
- father of one of Solomon's deputies

H415.gloss: from «0410» and «0430» and «03478»; the mighty god if Jisrael; El-Elohi-Jisrael, the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob:--El-elohe-israel.
H415.outline:
El-elohe-Israel = "the mighty God of Israel"
- name given to an altar, a location, by Jacob

H416.gloss: from «0410» and «01008»; the God of Bethel; El-Bethel, the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob:--El-beth-el.
H416.outline:
El Bethel = "The God of the House of God"
- the place where God revealed Himself to Jacob

H417.gloss: from «0410» and «01378»; hail (as if a great pearl):--great hail(-stones).

H418.gloss: by transposition for «0484»; sticks of algum wood:--algum (trees).

H419.gloss: from «0410» and «01730»; God has loved; Eldad, an Israelite:--Eldad.
H419.outline:
Eldad = "God has loved"
- one of the two elders who prophesied in the Israelite camp

H420.gloss: from «0410» and «03045»; God of knowledge; Eldaah, a son of Midian:--Eldaah.
H420.outline:
Eldaah = "God has known"
- a son or descendant of Midian

H421.gloss: a primitive root (rather identical with «0422» through the idea of invocation); to bewail:--lament.

H422.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to adjure, i.e. (usually in a bad sense) imprecate:--adjure, curse, swear.
H422.outline:
- to swear, curse
- (Qal)
- to swear, take an oath (before God)
- to curse
- (Hiphil)
- to put under oath, adjure
- to put under a curse

H423.gloss: from «0422»; an imprecation:--curse, cursing, execration, oath, swearing.
H423.outline:
- oath
- oath of covenant
- curse
- from God
- from men
- execration

H424.gloss: feminine of «0352»; an oak or other strong tree:--elm, oak, teil-tree.
H424.outline:
- terebinth, terebinth tree
- valley where David killed Goliath

H425.gloss: the same as «0424»; Elah, the name of an Edomite, of four Israelites, and also of a place in Palestine:--Elah.
H425.outline:
Elah = "An oak"
- an Edomite chief
- a king of Israel for two years, son of Baasha
- the father of king Hoshea of Israel
- a son of Caleb
- son of Uzzi

H426.outline:
- god, God
- god, heathen deity
- God (of Israel)

H428.gloss: prolonged from «0411»; these or those:--an- (the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who(-m).
H428.outline:
- these
- used before antecedent
- used following antecedent

H430.gloss: plural of «0433»; gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative:--angels, × exceeding, God (gods)(-dess, -ly), × (very) great, judges, × mighty.
H430.outline:
- (plural)
- rulers, judges
- divine ones
- angels
- gods
- (plural intensive - singular meaning)
- god, goddess
- godlike one
- works or special possessions of God
- the (true) God
- God

H432.gloss: probably from «0408»; nay, i.e. (softened) if:--but if, yea though.

H433.gloss: probably prolonged (emphat.) from «0410»; a deity or the Deity:--God, god. See «0430».

H434.gloss: for «0457»; good for nothing:--thing of nought.
H434.outline:
- worthless, something worthless, ineffective
- worthless gods, idols

H435.gloss: probably of foreign derivation; Elul, the sixth Jewish month:--Elul.
H435.outline:
Elul = "nothingness"
- sixth Jewish month corresponding to modern Aug. or Sep.

H436.gloss: prolonged from «0352»; an oak or other strong tree:--plain. See also «0356».

H438.gloss: the same as «0437»; Allon, an Israelite, also a place in Palestine:--Allon.
H438.outline:
Allon = "great tree" or "oak"
- city in Naphtali
- a Simeonite

H439.gloss: from «0437» and a variation of «01068»; oak of weeping; Allon-Bakuth, a monumental tree:--Allon-bachuth.
H439.outline:
Allon Bachuth = "oak of weeping"
- site of Deborah's (Rebekah's nurse) grave near Bethel

H440.gloss: or rather (shortened) oEloniy {ay-lo-nee'}; patron from «0438»; an Elonite or descendant (collectively) of Elon:--Elonites.
H440.outline:
Elonite = "might" or "terebinth: a plain"
- one of the clan of Elon

H441.gloss: or (shortened) talluph {al-loof'}; from «0502»; familiar; a friend, also gentle; hence, a bullock (as being tame; applied, although masculine, to a cow); and so, a chieftain (as notable, like neat cattle):--captain, duke, (chief) friend, governor, guide, ox.

H442.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Alush, a place in the Desert:--Alush.
H442.outline:
Alush = "I will knead (bread)"
- a wilderness encampment following the Exodus

H443.gloss: from «0410» and «02064»; God has bestowed; Elzabad, the name of two Israelites:--Elzabad.
H443.outline:
Elzabad = "God has given"
- a Gadite warrior who aided David
- a Korhite Levite

H444.gloss: a primitive root; to muddle, i.e. (figuratively and intransitive) to turn (morally) corrupt:--become filthy.

H445.gloss: from «0410» and «02603»; God (is) gracious; Elchanan, an Israelite:--Elkanan.
H445.outline:
Elhanan = "God has been gracious"
- Jair's son who fought the Gittites
- Dodo's son who was a chief of David

H446.gloss: from «0410» and «01»; God of (his) father; Eliab, the name of six Israelites:--Eliab.
H446.outline:
Eliab = "my God is father" or "God is father"
- son of Helon, leader of Zebulun in the wilderness
- a Reubenite chief, father of Dathan and Abiram
- David's oldest brother
- a Levite musician
- a Gadite warrior for David
- a Kohathite

H447.gloss: from «0410» repeated; God of (his) God; Eliel, the name of nine Israelites:--Eliel.
H447.outline:
Eliel = "my God is God" or "El is God"
- an ancestor of Samuel
- chief in David's army (might be two or three different men)
- a Levite with David in moving the ark
- a chief of Manasseh
- two chiefs of Benjamin
- a chief Kohathite
- a Levite

H448.gloss: or (contraction) ;Eliyathah {el-ee-yaw- thaw'}; from «0410» and «0225»; God of (his) consent; Eliathah, an Israelite:-- Eliathah.
H448.outline:
Eliathah = "God has come"
- a Hemanite musician in David's court

H449.gloss: from the same as «0419»; God of (his ) love; Elidad, an Israelite:--Elidad.
H449.outline:
Elidad = "my God has loved"
- a Benjamite chief who helped apportion his tribe's allotment to the Promised Land

H450.gloss: from «0410» and «03045»; God (is) knowing; Eljada, the name of two Israelites and of an Aramaean leader:--Eliada.
H450.outline:
Eliadah or Eliada = "God knows"
- a son of David
- a Benjamite warrior chief
- an Aramean, the father of an enemy of Solomon

H451.gloss: from «0422» (in the original sense of strength); the stout part, i.e. the fat tail of the Oriental sheep:--rump.
H451.outline: - tail, fat-tail (of sheep - an Eastern delicacy)

H452.gloss: or prolonged tEliyahuw {ay-lee-yaw'-hoo}; from «0410» and «03050»; God of Jehovah; Elijah, the name of the famous prophet and of two other Israelites:--Elijah, Eliah.
H452.outline:
Elijah or Eliah = "my God is Jehovah" or "Yah(u) is God"
- the great prophet of the reign of Ahab
- Benjamite son of Jeroham
- a son of Elam with foreign wife during exile
- a son of Harim, and priest, with foreign wife during exile

H453.gloss: or (fully) dEliyhuwh {el-ee-hoo'}; from «0410» and «01931»; God of him; Elihu, the name of one of Job's friends, and of three Israelites:--Elihu.
H453.outline:
Elihu = "He is my God"
- the younger man who rebuked Job and his three friends
- an Ephraimite, Samuel's great grandfather
- a Manassite warrior chief for David
- son of Shemaiah and Korhite gatekeeper
- David's brother

H454.gloss: or (shortened) yElyow{eynay {el- yo-ay-nah'ee}; from «0413» and «03068» and «05869»; towards Jehovah (are) my eyes; Eljehoenai or Eljoenai, the name of seven Israelites:--Elihoenai, Elionai.
H454.outline:
Elioenai or Elihoenai = "unto Jehovah are my eyes"
- a Korahite temple doorkeeper, son of Meshelemiah
- two men with foreign wife during the exile; one a priest
- a son of Neariah
- a Simeonite
- a Benjamite, son of Becher

H455.gloss: from «0410» and «02244»; God will hide; Eljachba, an Israelite:--Eliahbah.
H455.outline:
Eliahba = "God hides"
- one of David's mighty warriors

H456.gloss: from «0410» and «02779»; God of autumn; Elichoreph, an Israelite:--Elihoreph.
H456.outline:
Elihoreph = "God of winter (harvest-time)"
- a scribe in Solomon's court

H457.gloss: apparently from «0408»; good for nothing, by anal. vain or vanity; specifically an idol:--idol, no value, thing of nought.
H457.outline:
- of nought, good for nothing, worthless
- of physicians, a shepherd, a divination
- of false gods

H458.gloss: from «0410» and «04428»; God of (the) king; Elimelek, an Israelite:--Elimelech.
H458.outline:
Elimelech = "my God is king"
- Naomi's husband

H459.gloss: (Aramaic) or shorter oillen {il-lane'}; prolonged from «0412»; these:--the, these.

H460.gloss: from «0410» and «03254»; God (is) gatherer; Eljasaph, the name of two Israelites:--Eliasaph.
H460.outline:
Eliasaph = "God has added"

H577.outline: - ah now! I/we beseech you, oh now!, pray now! (participle of entreaty usually followed by the imperative verb)

H578.gloss: a primitive root; to groan:--lament, mourn.

H579.gloss: a primitive root (perhaps rather identical with «0578» through the idea of contraction in anguish); to approach; hence, to meet in various senses:--befall, deliver, happen, seek a quarrel.
H579.outline:

- (Piel) to allow to meet, cause to meet
- (Pual) to be sent, be allowed to meet
- (Hithpael) to seek occasion (quarrel), cause oneself to meet

H580.outline: - we (first pers. pl. - usually used for emphasis)

H581.gloss: (Aramaic) or (feminine)  inniyn (Aramaic) {in- neen'}; corresponding to «01992»; they:--X are, them, these.

H582.gloss: from «0605»; properly, a mortal (and thus differing from the more dignified «0120»); hence, a man in general (singly or collectively):--another, × (blood-)thirsty, certain, chap(-man); divers, fellow, × in the flower of their age, husband, (certain, mortal) man, people, person, servant, some ( × of them), + stranger, those, + their trade. It is often unexpressed in the English versions, especially when used in apposition with another word . Compare «0376».
H582.outline:
- man, mortal man, person, mankind
- of an individual
- men (collective)
- man, mankind

H583.gloss: the same as «0582»; Enosh, a son of Seth; --Enos.

H584.gloss: a primitive root; to sigh:--groan, mourn, sigh.
H584.outline:
- (Niphal) sigh, groan (in pain or grief), gasp
- moan (of cattle)

H585.outline: - sighing, groaning (expression of grief or physical distress)

H586.gloss: (Aramaic) or ganachnah (Aramaic) {an-akh- naw'}; corresponding to «0587»; we:--we.

H587.outline: - we (first pers. pl. - usually used for emphasis)

H588.gloss: probably from the same root as «05170»; a gorge or narrow pass; Anacharath, a place in Palestine:--Anaharath.
H588.outline:
Anaharath = "the groaning of fear"
- (BDB) city in Naphtali
- (CLBL) city in Issachar

H589.gloss: contracted from «0595»; I:--I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, × which, × who.
H589.outline: - I (first pers. sing. - usually used for emphasis)

H590.gloss: probably from «0579» (in the sense of conveyance); -a ship or (collectively)a fleet:--galley, navy (of ships).

H593.gloss: from «0578» and «05971»; groaning of (the) people; Aniam, an Israelite:--Aniam.
H593.outline:
Aniam = "I am the people" or "lament of people"
- a man of Manasseh

H594.gloss: probably from an unused root meaning to be narrow; according to most a plumb-line, and to others a hook:--plumb-line.

H595.gloss: sometimes {aw-no'-kee}; a primitive pro.; I:--I, me, × which.

H596.gloss: a primitive root; to mourn, i.e. complain:--complain.

H599.gloss: a primitive root; to breathe hard, i.e. be enraged:--be angry (displeased).
H599.outline:
- to be angry, to be displeased, to breathe hard
- (Qal) to be angry (of God)
- (Hithpael) to be angry (always of God)

H600.gloss: (Aramaic) corresponding to «0639» (only in the plural as a singular); the face:--face, visage.

H601.gloss: from «0599»; an unclean bird, perhaps the parrot (from its irascibility):--heron.
H601.outline:
- an unclean bird
- perhaps an heron

H602.gloss: a primitive root; to shriek:--cry, groan.
H602.outline:
- to cry, groan
- (Qal) to cry, lament
- (Niphal) to make lamentation

H604.gloss: the same as «0603»; some kind of lizard, probably the gecko (from its wail):--ferret.
H604.outline:
- an unclean animal, ferret, shrewmouse, gecko
- perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning unknown

H605.gloss: a primitive root; to be frail, feeble, or (figuratively) melancholy:--desperate(-ly wicked), incurable, sick, woeful.
H605.outline:
- to be weak, sick, frail
- (Qal)
- to be incurable
- to be sick
- desperate, incurable, desperately wicked, woeful, very sick (pass participle) (metaph.)
- (Niphal) to be sick

H606.gloss: (Aramaic) or renash (Aramaic) {en-ash'}; corresponding to «0582»; a man:--man, + whosoever.

H607.gloss: (Aramaic) corresponding to «0859»; thou:--as for thee, thou.

H609.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Asa, the name of a king and of a Levite:--Asa.
H609.outline:
Asa = "healer: injurious (?)"
- king of Judah, son of Abijam, father of Jehoshaphat
- a Levite

H612.gloss: from «0631»; a bond (especially manacles of a prisoner):--band, + prison.
H612.outline:
- band, bond
- house of bonds, prison (figurative)

H614.gloss: or maciph {aw-seef'}; from «0622»; gathered, i.e. (abstractly) a gathering in of crops:--ingathering.

H615.gloss: from «0631»; bound, i.e. a captive:--(those which are) bound, prisoner.

H617.gloss: the same as «0616»; prisoner; Assir, the name of two Israelites:--Assir.
H617.outline:
Assir = "prisoner"
- a son of Korah
- a son of Ebiasaph
- a son of Jeconiah

H618.gloss: from an unused root meaning to heap together; a storehouse (only in the plural):--barn, storehouse.

H619.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Asnah, one of the Nethinim:--Asnah.
H619.outline:
Asnah = "I shall be hated: she has stored up"
- a temple-slave who returned from exile

H620.gloss: of foreign derivation; Osnappar, an Assyrian king:--Asnapper.
H620.outline:
Asnappar or Osnappar = "horned bull: thorn abolished"
- an Assyrian king who transported other peoples into Samaria - probably the king, Ashurbanipal

H621.gloss: of Egyptian derivation; Asenath, the wife of Joseph:--Asenath.
H621.outline:
Asenath = "belonging to the goddess Neith"
- the wife of Joseph

H622.gloss: a primitive root; to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.):--assemble, bring, consume, destroy, felch, gather (in, together, up again), × generally, get (him), lose, put all together, receive, recover (another from leprosy), (be) rereward, × surely, take (away, into, up), × utterly, withdraw.
H622.outline:
- to gather, receive, remove, gather in
- (Qal)
- to gather, collect
- to gather (an individual into company of others)
- to bring up the rear
- to gather and take away, remove, withdraw
- (Niphal)
- to assemble, be gathered
- (pass of Qal
- 1b
- to be gathered to one's fathers 1b
- to be brought in or into (association with others)
- (pass of Qal
- 1b
- to be taken away, removed, perish
- (Piel)
- to gather (harvest)
- to take in, receive into
- rearguard, rearward (subst)
- (Pual) to be gathered
- (Hithpael) to gather oneself or themselves

H623.gloss: from «0622»; collector; Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first:--Asaph.
H623.outline:
Asaph = "gatherer"
- the father of Hezekiah's secretary
- a son of Berechiah, chief Levite musician under David
- a Persian officer over the royal forest

H624.gloss: passive participle of «0622»; collected (only in the plural), i.e. a collection of offerings):--threshold, Asuppim.
H624.outline:
- what is gathered, store, storing, storehouse
- (CLBL) threshold (metonomy)

H626.gloss: from «0622»; a collection of people (only adverbial):--X together.

H627.gloss: fem of «0624».; a collection of (learned) men (only in the plural):--assembly.

H628.gloss: by reduplication from «0624»; gathered up together, i.e. a promiscuous assemblage (of people):--mixt multitude.

H629.gloss: (Aramaic) of Persian derivation; diligently:--fast, forthwith, speed(-ily).

H630.gloss: of Persian derivation; Aspatha, a son of Haman:--Aspatha.
H630.outline:
Aspatha = "the enticed gathered"
- the third son of Haman

H631.gloss: a primitive root; to yoke or hitch; by analogy, to fasten in any sense, to join battle:--bind, fast, gird, harness, hold, keep, make ready, order, prepare, prison(-er), put in bonds, set in array, tie.
H631.outline:
- to tie, bind, imprison
- (Qal)
- to tie, bind
- to tie, harness
- to bind (with cords)
- to gird (rare and late)
- to begin the battle, make the attack
- of obligation of oath (figurative)
- (Niphal) to be imprisoned, bound
- (Pual) to be taken prisoner

H632.gloss: or riccar {is-sawr'}; from «0631»; an obligation or vow (of abstinence):--binding, bond.

H633.gloss: (Aramaic) corresponding to «0632» in a legal sense; an interdict:--decree.

H634.gloss: of foreign derivation; Esar- chaddon, an Assyrian king:--Esar-haddon.
H634.outline:
Esarhaddon = "Ashur has given a brother"
- king of Assyria in the seventh-century BC

H635.gloss: of Persian derivation; Ester, the Jewish heroine:--Esther.
H635.outline:
Esther = "star"
- the queen of Persia, heroine of the book of Esther - daughter of Abihail, cousin and adopted daughter of Mordecai, of the tribe of Benjamin, made queen by king Ahasuerus to replace divorced queen, Vashti.

H636.gloss: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06086»; a tree or wood:--timber, wood.

H637.gloss: a primitive particle; meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though:--also, + although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, + how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.
H637.outline:
conj (denoting addition, esp of something greater)
- also, yea, though, so much the more adv
- furthermore, indeed

H639.gloss: from «0599»; properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire:--anger(-gry), + before, countenance, face, + forebearing, forehead, + (long-)suffering, nose, nostril, snout, × worthy, wrath.

H640.gloss: a primitive root (rather a denominative from «0646»); to gird on (the ephod):--bind, gird.
H640.outline:
- (Qal) bind, gird
- to gird on (ephod)
- (TWOT) ephod

H641.gloss: the same as «0646» shortened; Ephod, an Israelite:--Ephod.
H641.outline:
Ephod = "a (special) girdle"
- the father of a chief of Manasseh

H642.gloss: feminine of «0646»; a girding on (of the ephod); hence, generally, a plating (of metal):--ephod, ornament.
H642.outline:
- ephod
- priestly garment, shoulder-cape or mantle, outer garment
- worn by an ordinary priest and made of white stuff
- worn by the high priest - more costly, woven of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and linen threads provided with shoulder-pieces and a breast piece of like material, ornamented with gems and gold
- a metallic covering for idols, a plating over

H643.gloss: apparently of foreign derivation; a pavilion or palace-tent:--palace.

H644.gloss: a primitive root; to cook, especially to bake:--bake(-r, (-meats)).

H645.gloss: or hephowe {ay-fo'}; from «06311»; strictly a demonstrative particle, here; but used of time, now or then:--here, now, where?
H645.outline:
- then, now, so
- (who) then, (what) then (with interrog)
- then (with imperative - i.e. know then)
- if...then (with adv)

H646.gloss: rarely oephod {ay-fode'}; probably of foreign derivation ; a girdle; specifically the ephod or high-priest's shoulder- piece; also generally, an image:--ephod.
H646.outline:
- ephod
- priestly garment, shoulder-cape or mantle, outer garment
- worn by an ordinary priest and made of white stuff
- worn by the high priest - more costly, woven of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and linen threads provided with shoulder-pieces and a breast piece of like material, ornamented with gems and gold

H647.gloss: perhaps from «06315»; breeze; Aphiach, an Israelite:--Aphiah.
H647.outline:
Aphiah = "I will make to breathe"
- an ancestor of Saul

H648.gloss: from the same as «0651» (in the sense of weakness); unripe:--not grown up.

H649.gloss: dual of «0639»; two nostrils; Appajim, an Israelite:--Appaim.

H650.gloss: from «0622»; properly, containing, i.e. a tube; also a bed or valley of a stream; also a strong thing or a hero:--brook, channel, mighty, river, + scale, stream, strong piece.

H651.gloss: from an unused root meaning to set as the sun; dusky:--very dark.

H652.gloss: from the same as «0651»; dusk:--darkness, obscurity, privily.

H653.gloss: feminine of «0651»; duskiness, figuratively, misfortune; concrete, concealment:--dark, darkness, gloominess, × thick.

H655.gloss: from an unused root meaning to revolve; a turn, i.e. a season:--+ fitly.

H656.gloss: a primitive root; to disappear, i.e. cease:--be clean gone (at an end, brought to nought), fail.
H656.outline: - (Qal) to cease, break, come to an end

H658.gloss: from «0657» and the plural of «01818»; boundary of blood-drops; Ephes-Dammim, a place in Palestine:--Ephes- dammim.
H658.outline:
Ephes Dammim = "edge of blood"
- a place approx 16 miles (25 km) southwest of Jerusalem

H659.gloss: from an unused root probably meaning to breathe; properly, a breath, i.e. nothing:--of nought.

H660.gloss: from «0659» (in the sense of hissing); an asp or other venomous serpent:--viper.

H662.gloss: a primitive root; to contain, i.e. (reflex.) abstain:--force (oneself), restrain.
H662.outline:
- to hold, be strong, restrain, hold back
- (Hithpael)
- to restrain oneself, refrain
- to force, compel oneself

H663.gloss: or rAphiyq {af-eek'}; from «0662» (in the sense of strength); fortress; Aphek (or Aphik), the name of three places in Palestine:--Aphek, Aphik.
H663.outline:
Aphek or Aphik = "enclosure"

- a city in territory of Asher

H664.gloss: feminine of «0663»; fortress; Aphekah, a place in Palestine:--Aphekah.
H664.outline:
Aphekah = "enclosure"
- a city near Hebron in Judah
- (BDB) possibly a group of cities including Hebron

H665.gloss: from an unused root meaning to bestrew; ashes:--ashes.

H666.gloss: from the same as «0665» (in the sense of covering); a turban:--ashes.

H667.gloss: from «06524» (in the sense of bursting the shell); the brood of a bird:--young (one).
H667.outline:
- young, young one (of birds)
- young birds

H668.gloss: probably of Egyptian derivation; a palanquin:--chariot.

H669.gloss: dual of masculine form of «0672»; double fruit; Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory:--Ephraim, Ephraimites.
H669.outline:
Ephraim = "double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful"
- second son of Joseph, blessed by him and given preference over first son, Manasseh
- the tribe, Ephraim
- the mountain country of Ephraim
- sometimes used name for the northern kingdom (Hosea or Isaiah)
- a city near Baal-hazor
- a chief gate of Jerusalem

H670.gloss: (Aramaic) of foreign origin (only in the plural); an Apherasite or inhabitant of an unknown region of Assyria:-- Apharsite.
H670.outline:
Apharsite = "causers of division (?)"
- (CLBL) an unknown office
- (BDB) secretaries
- (TWOT) perhaps a title of an official

H671.gloss: (Aramaic) or fApharcathkay (Aramaic) {af-ar-sath-kah'ee}; of foreign origin (only in the plural); an Apharsekite or Apharsathkite, an unknown Assyrian tribe:--Apharsachites, Apharasthchites.
H671.outline:
Apharsachites = "as causers of division (?)" Apharsathchites = "I will divide the deceivers (?)"
- (CLBL) an unknown office
- (BDB) perhaps an office or an official
- (TWOT)
- a people
- perhaps a title of an official

H672.gloss: or mEphrathah {ef-raw'-thaw}; from «06509»; fruitfulness; Ephrath, another name for Bethlehem; once (Psa. 132:6) perhaps for Ephraim; also of an Israelitish woman:--Ephrath, Ephratah.

Ephrath or Ephratah = "ash-heap: place of fruitfulness" n pr loc
- a place near Bethel where Rachel died and was buried
- another name for Bethlehem n pr f
- wife of Caleb

H673.gloss: patrial form «0672»; an Ephrathite or an Ephraimite:--Ephraimite, Ephrathite.
H673.outline:
Ephrathite = "ashiness: fruitfulness"
- an inhabitant or descendant of Ephraim
- an inhabitant of Bethlehem

H674.gloss: (Aramaic) of Persian origin; revenue; others at the last:--revenue.

H675.gloss: or mEtsbon {ets-bone'}; of uncertain derivation; Etsbon, the name of two Israelites:--Ezbon.
H675.outline:
Ezbon = "hasting to discern: I will be enlargement"
- a son of Gad
- grandson of Benjamin

H676.gloss: from the same as «06648» (in the sense of grasping); something to sieze with, i.e. a finger; by analogy, a toe:--finger, toe.

H678.gloss: from «0680» (in its secondary sense of separation); an extremity (Isa. 41:9), also a noble:--chief man, noble.

H679.gloss: from «0680» (in its primary sense of uniting); a joint of the hand (i.e. knuckle); also (according to some) a party-wall (Ezek. 41:8):--(arm) hole, great.

H680.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to join; used only as a denominative from «0681»; to separate; hence, to select, refuse, contract:--keep, reserve, straiten, take.

- (Niphal) to be withdrawn
- (Hiphil) to withdraw

H681.outline:
- beside, by, near, nearness, joining, proximity subst
- (BDB)
- conjunction, proximity
- beside, in proximity, contiguous to, from beside

H682.gloss: from «0680»; noble; Atsel, the name of an Israelite, and of a place in Palestine:--Azal, Azel.
H682.outline:
Azal = "proximity: he has reserved"
- a place near Jerusalem, site presently unknown (CLBL) n pr m Azel = "reserved"
- a Benjamite descendant of Saul and Jonathan

H683.gloss: from «0680» and «03050» prolonged; Jah has reserved; Atsaljah, an Israelite:--Azaliah.
H683.outline:
Azaliah = "Jehovah (Yahweh) has reserved (set apart)"
- the father of Shaphan the scribe

H684.gloss: from an unused root probably meaning to be strong; strength (i.e. strong); Otsem, the name of two Israelites:--Ozem.
H684.outline:
Ozem = "I shall hasten them"
- older brother of David
- a descendant of Judah

H685.gloss: a variation from «06807»; properly, a step- chain; by analogy, a bracelet:--bracelet, chain.

H686.gloss: a primitive root; to store up:--(lay up in) store, + (make) treasure(-r).
H686.outline:
- to store up, save, lay up
- (Qal) to store up, make treasurer
- (Niphal) treasured

H687.outline:
Ezer = "treasure"
- a chief of the Horites

H688.gloss: from «06916»; burning, i.e. a carbuncle or other fiery gem:--carbuncle.
H688.outline:
- fiery glow, sparkle
- (CLBL) the name of a gem - carbuncle

H689.gloss: probably from «0602»; slender, i.e. the ibex:--wild goat.

H690.gloss: probably for «0738»; lion; Ara, an Israelite:--Ara.

H691.outline:
- (CLBL) hero, valiant one
- (BDB) form and meaning dubious
- (TWOT) Ariel or hearth

H692.gloss: from «0691»; heroic; Areli (or an Arelite, collectively), an Israelite and his descendants:--Areli, Arelites.
H692.outline:
Areli = "lion of God"
- a son of Gad
- those of the family of Areli (pater adj - Arelites)

H693.gloss: a primitive root; to lurk:--(lie in) ambush(-ment), lay (lie in) wait.
H693.outline:
- to lie in wait, ambush, lurk
- (Qal)
- to lie in wait
- ambush (participle as subst)
- (Piel) ambushers, liers-in-wait (pl. participle)
- (Hiphil) to lay an ambush

H694.gloss: from «0693»; ambush; Arab, a place in Palestine:--Arab.

H697.gloss: from «07235»; a locust (from its rapid increase):-- grasshopper, locust.
H697.outline:
- a kind of locust, locust swarm (coll)
- (CLBL)
- sudden disappearance (fig.)
- insignificance (fig.)
- activity (fig.)

H698.gloss: feminine of «0696» (only in the plural); ambuscades:--spoils.

H699.gloss: feminine participle passive of «0693» (as if for lurking); a lattice; (by implication) a window, dove-cot (because of the pigeon-holes), chimney (with its apertures for smoke), sluice (with openings for water):--chimney, window.
H699.outline:
- lattice, window, sluice
- (CLBL) chimney (lattice opening where smoke escapes)

H700.gloss: plural of «0699»; Arubboth, a place in Palestine:--Aruboth.
H700.outline:
Aruboth = "windows"
- a district marked by Solomon for tax purposes

H701.gloss: patrial from «0694»; an Arbite or native of Arab:--Arbite.
H701.outline:
Arbite = "an ambush"
- a native of Arabia

H704.gloss: the same as «0702»; Arba, one of the Anakim:--Arba.
H704.outline:
Arba = "fourth"
- the father of Anak and the greatest of the giants (Anakim)
- see 07153 if translated "city of Arba"

H707.gloss: a primitive root; to plait or weave:--weaver(-r).
H707.outline:
- to weave
- (Qal)
- to weave (cloth)
- to braid (Samson's hair)
- weaver (subst.)
- intrigue (fig.)

H708.gloss: from «0707»; a weaving; a braid; also a shuttle:--beam, weaver's shuttle.

H709.gloss: from the same as «07263»; stony; Argob, a district of Palestine:--Argob.
H709.outline:
Argob = "heap of clods" n pr loc
- a district or area in Bashan n pr m
- one of king Pekah's officers

H712.gloss: perhaps from «07264» (in the sense of being suspended), a box (as a pannier):--coffer.

H713.gloss: of foreign origin; purple (the color or the dyed stuff):--purple.

H714.gloss: from an unused root probably meaning to wander; fugitive; Ard, the name of two Israelites:--Ard.
H714.outline:
Ard = "I shall subdue"
- son of Benjamin
- grandson of Benjamin

H715.gloss: from the same as «0714»; roaming; Ardon, an Israelite:--Ardon.
H715.outline:
Ardon = "subduer: fugitive"
- a son of Caleb

H716.gloss: patronymic from «0714»; an Ardite (collectively) or descendant of Ard:--Ardites.
H716.outline:
Ardites = "I shall subdue"
- the descendants of Ard

H717.gloss: a primitive root; to pluck:--gather, pluck.

H719.gloss: probably from «07300»; a refuge for the roving; Arvad, an island-city of Palestine:--Arvad.
H719.outline:
Arvad = "I shall break loose"
- a city-island near Sidon

H720.gloss: an orthographical variation of «0719»; fugitive; Arod, an Israelite:--Arod.
H720.outline:
Arod = "I shall subdue: I shall roam"
- a son of Gad

H721.gloss: patrial from «0719»; an Arvadite or citizen of Arvad:--Arvadite.
H721.outline:
Arvadites = "I shall break loose"
- the descendants of Arvad, a son of Canaan

H722.gloss: patronymic from «0721»; an Arodite or descendant of Arod:--Arodi, Arodites.
H722.outline:
Arodi or Arodites = "I shall subdue: I shall roam"
- descendants of Arod

H723.gloss: or rarayah {ar-aw'-yah'}; from 717(in the sense of feeding); a herding-place for an animal:--stall.

H724.gloss: or rarukah {ar-oo-kaw'}; feminine passive participle of 748 (in the sense of restoring to soundness); wholeness (literally or figuratively):--health, made up, perfected.

H725.gloss: a variation of «07316»; height; Arumah, a place in Palestine:--Arumah.
H725.outline:
