Belteshazzar = "lord of the straitened's treasure"
- the 4th of the greater prophets, taken as hostage in the first deportation to Babylon; because of the gift of God of the interpretation of dreams, he became the 2nd in command of the Babylon empire and lasted through the end of the Babylonian empire and into the Persian empire. His prophecies are the key to the understanding of end time events. Noted for his purity and holiness by contemporary prophet, Ezekiel
- also, 'Daniel' (01840 or 01841)

H1096.outline:
Belteshazzar = "lord of the straitened's treasure"
- the 4th of the greater prophets, taken as hostage in the first deportation to Babylon; because of the gift of God of the interpretation of dreams, he became the 2nd in command of the Babylon empire and lasted through the end of the Babylonian empire and into the Persian empire. His prophecies are the key to the understanding of end time events. Noted for his purity and holiness by contemporary prophet, Ezekiel
- also, 'Daniel' (01840 or 01841)

H1097.gloss: from «01086»; properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.:--corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no...is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.
H1097.outline:
subst
- wearing out adv of negation
- without, no, not

H1098.gloss: from «01101»; mixed, i.e. (specifically) feed (for cattle):--corn, fodder, provender.

H1100.gloss: from «01097» and «03276»; without profit, worthlessness; by extension, destruction, wickedness (often in connection with «0376», «0802», «01121», etc.):--Belial, evil, naughty, ungodly (men), wicked.
H1100.outline:
- worthlessness
- worthless, good for nothing, unprofitable, base fellow
- wicked
- ruin, destruction (construct)

H1101.gloss: a primitive root; to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; also (denominatively from «01098») to fodder:--anoint, confound, × fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper.
H1101.outline:
- to mix, mingle, confuse, confound
- (Qal)
- to mingle, confuse
- to mix
- to give provender, feed (animals)
- (Hithpoel) to mix oneself (among others)
- (Hiphil) to fade away

H1102.gloss: a primitive root; to muzzle:--be held in.

H1103.gloss: a primitive root; to pinch sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them):--gatherer.
H1103.outline: - (Qal) to gather figs, tend sycamore trees

H1104.gloss: a primitive root; to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy:--cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up).
H1104.outline:
- to swallow down, swallow up, engulf, eat up
- (Qal)
- to swallow down
- to swallow up, engulf
- (Niphal) to be swallowed up
- (Piel)
- to swallow
- to swallow up, engulf
- squandering (fig.)
- (Pual) to be swallowed up
- (Hithpael) to be ended

H1105.gloss: from «01104»; a gulp; figuratively, destruction:--devouring, that which he hath swallowed up.
H1105.outline:
- a swallowing, devouring (fig. for ruin)
- a thing swallowed

H1106.gloss: the same as «01105»; Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites:--Bela.
H1106.outline:
Bela = "destruction" n pr m
- a king of Edom
- first son of Benjamin
- a son of Ahaz, a Reubenite n pr loc
- one of the five cities of the plain which was spared at the intercession of Lot, and received the name of Zoar

H1107.gloss: or balmadey {bal-ad-ay'}; constructive plural from «01077» and «05703», not till, i.e. (as preposition or adverb) except, without, besides:--beside, not (in), save, without.

H1108.gloss: patronymically from «01106»: a Belaite (collectively) or descendants of Bela:--Belaites.

H1109.gloss: probably from «01077» and «05971»; not (of the) people, i.e. foreigner; Bilam, a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine:--Balaam, Bileam.
H1109.outline:
Balaam = "not of the people" n pr m
- the son of Beor, a man endowed with the gift of prophecy n pr loc
- a town in Manasseh

H1110.gloss: a primitive root; to annihilate:--(make) waste.
H1110.outline:
- to waste, lay waste, devastate
- (Poel) to make waste
- (Pual) devastated (participle)

H1111.gloss: from «01110»; waster; Balak, a Moabitish king:--Balak.
H1111.outline:
Balak = "devastator"
- a king of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel

H1112.gloss: or Belshatstsar {bale-shats-tsar'}; of foreign origin (compare «01095»); Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king:--Belshazzar.
H1112.outline:
Belshazzar = "Bel protect the king"
- king of Babylon at the time of its fall; he to whom Daniel interpreted the writing on the wall

H1113.outline:
Belshazzar = "Bel protect the king"
- king of Babylon at the time of its fall; he to whom Daniel interpreted the writing on the wall

H1114.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Bilshan, an Israelite:--Bilshan.
H1114.outline:
Bilshan = "in slander"
- an exile who returned with Zerubbabel

H1115.gloss: constructive feminine of «01086» (equivalent to «01097»); properly, a failure of, i.e. (used only as a negative particle, usually with a prepositional prefix) not, except, without, unless, besides, because not, until, etc.:--because un(satiable), beside, but, + continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without.
H1115.outline:
subst
- not, except adv
- not
- except (after preceding negation) conj
- except (after an implied or expressed negation) with prep
- so as not, in order not
- an account of not, because...not
- until not

H1116.gloss: from an unused root (meaning to be high); an elevation:--height, high place, wave.
H1116.outline:
- high place, ridge, height, bamah (technical name for cultic platform)
- high place, mountain
- high places, battlefields
- high places (as places of worship)
- funeral mound?

H1117.gloss: the same as «01116»; Bamah, a place in Palestine:--Bamah. See also «01120».
H1117.outline:
Bamah = "high place"
- a place in Palestine (of places of idolatrous worship)

H1118.gloss: probably from «04107» with prepositional prefix; with pruning; Bimhal, an Israelite:--Bimhal.
H1118.outline:
Bimhal = "in circumcision: in weakness (by mixture)"
- a descendant of Asher

H1119.gloss: prolongation for prepositional prefix; in, with, by, etc.:--for, in into, through.

H1120.gloss: plural of «01116»; heights; or (fully) Bamowth Bahal {baw-moth' bah'-al}; from the same and «01168»; heights of Baal; Bamoth or Bamoth-Baal, a place East of the Jordan:--Bamoth, Bamoth-baal.
H1120.outline:
Bamoth = "high places" or "great high place"
- a town on the river Arnon in Moab

H1121.gloss: from «01129»; a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like «01», «0251», etc.)):--+ afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-)ite, (anoint-)ed one, appointed to, (+) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-)ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, + (young) bullock, + (young) calf, ×  came up in, child, colt, × common, × corn, daughter, × of first, + firstborn, foal, + very fruitful, + postage, × in, + kid, + lamb, (+) man, meet, + mighty, + nephew, old, (+) people, + rebel, + robber, × servant born, × soldier, son, + spark, + steward, + stranger, × surely, them of, + tumultuous one, + valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
H1121.outline:
- son, grandson, child, member of a group
- son, male child
- grandson
- children (pl. - male and female)
- youth, young men (pl.)
- young (of animals)
- sons (as characterisation, i.e. sons of injustice [for un- righteous men] or sons of God [for angels]
- people (of a nation) (pl.)
- of lifeless things, i.e. sparks, stars, arrows (fig.)
- a member of a guild, order, class

H1122.gloss: the same as «01121»; Ben, an Israelite:--Ben.
H1122.outline:
Ben = "son"
- a Levite, one of the porters appointed by David for the ark

H1124.gloss: (Aramaic) or bnah (Aramaic) {ben-aw'}; corresponding to «01129»; to build:--build, make.
H1124.outline:
- to build
- (P'al) to build
- (Ithp'il) to be built

H1125.gloss: from «01121» and «040»; (the) son of Abinadab; Ben-Abinadab, an Israelite:--the son of Abinadab.
H1125.outline:
Ben-Abinadab = "son of Abinadab"
- an officer of Solomon

H1126.gloss: from «01121» and «0205»; son of my sorrow; Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin:--Ben-oni.
H1126.outline:
Ben-oni = "son of my sorrow"
- the name given to Benjamin by Rachel

H1127.gloss: from «01121» and «01397»; son of (the) hero; Ben- Geber, an Israelite:--the son of Geber.
H1127.outline:
Ben-geber = "the son of Geber" or "the son of a man"
- an officer of Solomon

H1128.gloss: from «01121» and a derivative of «01856»; son of piercing (or of a lance); Ben-Deker, an Israelite:--the son of Dekar.
H1128.outline:
Ben-dekar = "son of stabbing" or "son of Dekar"
- an officer of Solomon

H1129.gloss: a primitive root; to build (literally and figuratively):--(begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), × surely.
H1129.outline:
- to build, rebuild, establish, cause to continue
- (Qal)
- to build, rebuild
- to build a house (ie, establish a family)
- (Niphal)
- to be built
- to be rebuilt
- established (of restored exiles) (fig.)
- established (made permanent)
- to be built up (of childless wife becoming the mother of a family through the children of a concubine)

H1130.gloss: from «01121» and «01908»; son of Hadad; Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings:--Ben-hadad.
H1130.outline:
Ben-hadad = "son of [the false god] Hadad"
- the king of Syria, contemporary with Asa of Judah
- the son of Hazael, also king of Syria

H1131.gloss: from «01129»; built up; Binnui, an Israelite:--Binnui.
H1131.outline:
Binnui = "built up"
- an exile returnee with Zerubbabel, son of Henadad, who assisted at the reparation of the wall of Jerusalem, under Nehemiah
- a Levite in time of Ezra, father of Noadiah
- another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife
- still another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife

H1132.gloss: from «01121» and «02105»; son of Zocheth; Ben- Zocheth, an Israelite:--Ben-zoketh.
H1132.outline:
Ben-zoheth = "son of Zoheth"
- one of the tribe of Judah

H1133.gloss: from «01121» and «02354»; son of Chur; Ben-Chur, an Israelite:--the son of Hur.
H1133.outline:
Ben-hur = "son of whiteness" or "son of Chur"
- a man who was commissariat officer for Solomon in Mount Ephraim

H1134.gloss: from «01121» and «02428»; son of might; Ben-Chail, an Israelite:--Ben-hail.
H1134.outline:
Ben-hail = "son of strength" or "son (man) of might"
- a ruler (prince) under Jehoshaphat

H1135.gloss: from «01121» and «02605»; son of Chanan; Ben- Chanan, an Israelite:--Ben-hanan.
H1135.outline:
Ben-hanan = "son of favour"
- one of the tribe of Judah

H1136.gloss: from «01121» and «02617»; son of kindness; Ben- Chesed, an Israelite:--the son of Hesed.
H1136.outline:
Ben-hesed = "son of mercy"
- an officer of Solomon

H1137.gloss: from «01129»; built; Bani, the name of five Israelites:--Bani.
H1137.outline:
Bani = "built"
- a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors
- a Levite of the line of Merari, and forefather to Ethan
- a man of Judah of the line of Pharez
- "children of Bani" returned from captivity with Zerubbabel
- one or up to three Levites in Nehemiah's time

H1138.gloss: or (fuller) Buwniy {boo-nee'}; from «01129»; built; Bunni or Buni, an Israelite:--Bunni.
H1138.outline:
Bunni = "built"
- a Levite in the time of Nehemiah
- another Levite of earlier date

H1139.gloss: from the plural construction of «01121» and «01300»; sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine:--Bene-barak.
H1139.outline:
Bene-barak = "sons of lightning"
- a city in Dan

H1141.gloss: or (prolonged) Bnayahuw {ben-aw-yaw'-hoo}; from «01129» and «03050»; Jah has built; Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites:-- Benaiah.
H1141.outline:
Benaiah = "Jehovah has built" or "Yahweh has built up"
- one of David's mighty warriors, son of Jehoiada the chief priest, a Levite, set by David over his bodyguard, later having remained faithful to Solomon during Adonijah's attempt on the crown, was raised into the place of Joab as commander-in-chief of the army
- the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite, one of David's thirty mighty warriors, and the captain of the eleventh monthly course
- a Simeonite, a prince of the families of Simeon
- a Levite in the time of David who played with a psaltery on Alamoth
- a priest in the time of David, appointed to blow the trumpet before the ark
- a Levite of the sons of Asaph
- a Levite in the time of Hezekiah
- Four Israelites in the time of Ezra who had taken strange wives
- the father of Pelatiah

H1142.gloss: from the plural of «01121» and «03292»; sons of Yaakan; Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert:--Bene-jaakan.
H1142.outline:
Bene-jaakan = "sons of twisting"
- an Israelite place of encampment in the wilderness (same as 0885)

H1143.gloss: dual of «0996»; a double interval, i.e. the space between two armies:--+ champion.
H1143.outline:
- between, space between two armies
- man of the space between armies, i.e. champion (of Goliath) (meton)

H1144.gloss: from «01121» and «03225»; son of (the) right hand; Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory:--Benjamin.
H1144.outline:
Benjamin = "son of the right hand"
- Jacob's and Rachel's youngest son, Joseph's full brother
- son of Bilhan, great-grandson of Benjamin
- a Benjamite, one of the sons of Harim, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife
- the tribe descended from Benjamin, the son of Jacob

H1145.gloss: sometimes (with the article inserted) Ben-ha-yminiy {ben-hah-yem-ee-nee'}; with «0376» inserted (1 Sam. 9:1) Ben-miysh Ymiyniy {ben-eesh' yem-ee-nee'}; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened (1 Sam. 9:4; Esth. 2:5) eIysh Ymiyniy {eesh yem-ee-nee'}; a man of Jemini, or (1 Sam. 20:1) simply Yminiy {yem-ee-nee'}; a Jeminite; (plural Bniy Ymiyniy {ben- ay' yem-ee-nee'}; patron from «01144»; a Benjaminite, or descendent of Benjamin:--Benjamite, of Benjamin.
H1145.outline:
Benjamite - "a son of the right hand"
- one of the tribe of Benjamin

H1148.gloss: probably from «01121» with pron. suff.; our son; Beninu, an Israelite:--Beninu.
H1148.outline:
Beninu = "our son"
- a returning Levite exile who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah

H1149.gloss: (Aramaic) of uncertain affinity; to be enraged:--be angry.

H1150.gloss: or Bincah {bin-aw'}; of uncertain derivation; Bina or Binah, an Israelite:--Binea, Bineah.

H1151.gloss: from «01121» and «05971» with pronomial suffix; son of my people; Ben-Ammi, a son of Lot:--Ben-ammi.
H1151.outline:
Ben-ami = "son of my people"
- son of Lot, born to his second daughter, progenitor of the Ammonites

H1152.gloss: from «05475» and «03050» with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah; Besodejah, an Israelite:--Besodeiah.
H1152.outline:
Besodeiah = "with the counsel of Jehovah" or "in the secret of the Lord"
- father of one of the repairers of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah

H1153.gloss: from «0947»; domineering; Besai, one of the Nethinim:--Besai.
H1153.outline:
Besai = "my treading"
- a temple slave (or group of slaves) who returned with Zerubbabel

H1154.gloss: from an unused root meaning to be sour; an immature grape:--unripe grape.

H1156.gloss: (Aramaic) or b ah (Aramaic) {beh-aw'}; corresponding to «01158»; to seek or ask:--ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek.
H1156.outline:
- to ask, seek, request, desire, pray, make petition
- (P'al)
- to ask, request
- to seek (for favour)

H1157.gloss: from «05704» with prepositional prefix; in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.:--about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within.
H1157.outline:
- behind, through, round about, on behalf of, away from, about
- through (of action)
- behind (with verbs of shutting)
- about (with verbs of fencing)
- on behalf of (metaph. especially with Hithpael)

H1158.gloss: a primitive root; to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask:--cause, inquire, seek up, swell out.
H1158.outline:
- to seek out, swell, cause to swell, boil up, enquire
- (Qal)
- to seek, enquire
- to cause to boil up
- (Niphal)
- to be searched out
- to be swelling, bulging, swelling out

H1159.outline:
- petition, request
- prayer (always in Jewish liturgy)

H1160.gloss: from «01197» (in the sense of burning); a lamp; Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam:--Beor.
H1160.outline:
Beor = "burning"
- father of Balaam
- father of Bela, king of Edom

H1162.gloss: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple:--Boaz.
H1162.outline:
Boaz = "fleetness"
- ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi
- name of the left of two brazen pillars, 18 cubits high, erected in the porch of Solomon's temple

H1163.gloss: a primitive root; to trample down, i.e. (figuratively) despise:--kick.
H1163.outline:
- to kick, kick at
- (Qal)
- to kick
- to kick at
- to desire (fig.)

H1165.gloss: from «01197» (in the sense of eating): cattle:--beast, cattle.

H1166.gloss: a primitive root; to be master; hence, (as denominative from «01167») to marry:--have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, × wife).
H1166.outline:
- to marry, rule over, possess, own
- (Qal)
- to marry, be lord (husband) over
- to rule over
- (Niphal) to be married

H1167.gloss: from «01166»; a master; hence, a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense):--+ archer, + babbler, + bird, captain, chief man, + confederate, + have to do, + dreamer, those to whom it is due, + furious, those that are given to it, great, + hairy, he that hath it, have, + horseman, husband, lord, man, + married, master, person, + sworn, they of.
H1167.outline:
- owner, husband, lord
- owner
- a husband
- citizens, inhabitants
- rulers, lords
- (noun of relationship used to characterise - ie, master of dreams)
- lord (used of foreign gods)

H1168.gloss: the same as «01167»; Baal, a Phoenician deity:--Baal, (plural) Baalim.
H1168.outline:
Baal = "lord" n pr m
- supreme male divinity of the Phoenicians or Canaanites
- a Reubenite
- the son of Jehiel and grandfather of Saul n pr loc
- a town of Simeon, probably identical to Baalath-beer

H1170.gloss: from «01168» and «01285»; Baal of (the) covenant; Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites:--Baal-berith.
H1170.outline:
Baal-berith = "lord of the covenant"
- a god of the Philistines

H1171.gloss: from «01168» and «01409»; Baal of Fortune; Baal-Gad, a place in Syria:--Baal-gad.
H1171.outline:
Baal-gad = "lord of fortune"
- a city noted for Baal-worship, located at the most northern or northwestern point to which Joshua's victories extended

H1172.gloss: feminine of «01167»; a mistress:--that hath, mistress.
H1172.outline:
- mistress, female owner
- sorceress, necromancer (noun of relationship)

H1173.gloss: the same as «01172»; Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine:--Baalah.
H1173.outline:
Baalah = "mistress"
- another name for Kirjath-jearim or Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab
- a town in the south of Judah, also called Balah and Bilhah

H1174.gloss: from «01167» and «01995»; possessor of a multitude; Baal-Hamon, a place in Palestine:--Baal-hamon.
H1174.outline:
Baal-hamon = "lord (possessor) of abundance"
- the site of Solomon's vineyard

H1175.gloss: plural of «01172»; mistresses; Bealoth, a place in Palestine:--Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from «05927» with prepositional prefix).
H1175.outline:
Baalath or Bealoth = "mistresses"
- a town in south Judah

H1176.gloss: from «01168» and «02070»; Baal of (the) Fly; Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites:--Baal-zebub.
H1176.outline:
Baal-zebub = "lord of the fly"
- a Philistine deity worshipped at Ekron

H1177.gloss: from «01167» and «02603»; possessor of grace; Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite:--Baal-hanan.
H1177.outline:
Baal-hanan = "Baal is gracious"
- an early king of Edom
- one of David's officers, a Gederite, who had the superintendence of his olive and sycamore plantations

H1178.gloss: from «01167» and a modification of «02691»; possessor of a village; Baal-Chatsor, a place in Palestine:--Baal-hazor.
H1178.outline:
Baal-hazor = "lord of the village"
- a town on the border between Ephraim and Benjamin, apparent location of a sheep farm of Absalom and location of Amnon's murder

H1179.gloss: from «01167» and «02768»; possessor of Hermon; Baal-Chermon, a place in Palestine:--Baal-hermon.
H1179.outline:
Baal-hermon or Baal-chermon = "lord of destruction"
- a city near or on Mount Hermon, named as a seat of Baal worship

H1180.gloss: from «01167» with pron. suff.; my master; Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah:--Baali.
H1180.outline:
Baali = "my lord"
- a deity in the northern kingdom, variation of the name 'Baal'

H1181.gloss: from the plural of «01168» and the plural of «01116»; Baals of (the) heights; Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan:--lords of the high places.
H1181.outline:
Baale-bamoth = "the lords of the high places"
- the people of Arnon, east of Jordan

H1182.gloss: from «01168» and «03045»; Baal has known; Beeljada, an Israelite:--Beeliada.
H1182.outline:
Beeliada = "the lord knows"
- a son of David, born in Jerusalem, elsewhere named 'Eliada'

H1183.gloss: from «01167» and «03050»; Jah (is) master; Bealjah, an Israelite:--Bealiah.
H1183.outline:
Bealiah = "Jehovah is master"
- a Benjamite who went over to David at Ziklag and was one of David's mighty warriors

H1184.gloss: from the plural of «01167» and «03063»; masters of Judah; Baale-Jehudah, a place in Palestine:--Baale of Judah.
H1184.outline:
Baale-Judah = "the lords of Judah"
- a place in Judah named for the Baalim, also known as Kirjath-jearim, Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab

H1185.gloss: probably from a derivative of «05965» with prepositional prefix; in exultation; Baalis, an Ammonitish king:--Baalis.
H1185.outline:
Baalis = "lord of the banner: in causing the joy"
- king of the Ammonites at the time of the destruction of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar

H1186.gloss: from «01168» and «04583»; Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare «01010»); Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan:--Baal-meon.
H1186.outline:
Baal-meon = "lord of the habitation"
- a town in Reuben, mentioned in connection with Nebo, and in the time of Ezekiel, Moabite

H1187.gloss: from «01168» and «06465»; Baal of Peor; Baal-Peor, a Moabitish deity:--Baal-peor.
H1187.outline:
Baal-peor = "lord of the gap"
- the deity worshipped at Peor with probable licentious rites

H1188.gloss: from «01167» and the plural of «06556»; possessor of breaches; Baal-Peratsim, a place in Palestine:--Baal- perazim.
H1188.outline:
Baal-perazim = "lord of the breaks"
- the site of a victory of David over the Philistines, and of a great destruction of their images; also called 'Mount Perazim'

H1189.gloss: from «01168» and «06828» (in the sense of cold) (according to others an Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter; Baal-Tsephon, a place in Eqypt:--Baal-zephon.
H1189.outline:
Baal Tsphon or Baal-zephon = "lord of the north"
- a place in Egypt near the Red Sea where Pharaoh and his army were destroyed during the Exodus

H1190.gloss: from «01168» and «08031»; Baal of Shalishah, Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine:--Baal-shalisha.
H1190.outline:
Baal-shalisha = "thrice-great lord"
- a place in Ephraim near Gilgal

H1191.gloss: a modification of «01172»; mistressship; Baalath, a place in Palestine:--Baalath.

H1192.gloss: from «01172» and «0875»; mistress of a well; Baalath-Beer, a place in Palestine:--Baalath-beer.
H1192.outline:
Baalath-beer = "mistress of the well"
- a town in the south part of Judah, given to Simeon, which also bore the name of 'Ramath-negeb'

H1193.gloss: from «01167» and «08558»; possessor of (the) palm-tree; Baal-Tamar, a place in Palestine:--Baal-tamar.
H1193.outline:
Baal-tamar = "lord of the palms"
- a place near Gibeah in Benjamin

H1194.gloss: probably a contraction of «01010»; Beon, a place East of the Jordan:--Beon.
H1194.outline:
Beon = "in the dwelling: indwelling"
- a place or city in Reuben

H1195.gloss: the same as «01196»; Banana, the name of four Israelite:--Baana, Baanah.
H1195.outline:
Baana or Baanah = "in the affliction"
- the son of Ahilud, Solomon's commissariat officer in Jezreel and the north of the Jordan valley
- another of Solomon's officers
- father of Zadok who assisted in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah

H1196.gloss: from a derivative of «06031» with prepositional prefix; in affliction:--Baanah, the name of four Israelites:--Baanah.
H1196.outline:
Baana or Baanah = "in affliction"
- a Benjamite, son Rimmon, who with his brother Rechab murdered Ish-bosheth. For this, killed by David, mutilated bodies hung up over the pool at Hebron
- a Netophathite, father of Heleb or Heled, one of David's mighty warriors
- the head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel
- a chief of the people

H1197.gloss: a primitive root; to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating); also (as denominative from «01198») to be(-come) brutish:--be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set ((on fire)), waste.
H1197.outline:
- to burn, consume, kindle, be kindled
- (Qal)
- to begin to burn, be kindled, start burning
- to burn, be burning
- to burn, consume
- Jehovah's wrath, human wrath (fig.)
- (Piel)
- to kindle, burn
- to consume, remove (of guilt) (fig.)
- (Hiphil)
- to kindle
- to burn up
- to consume (destroy)
- (Pual) to burn v denom
- to be stupid, brutish, barbarous
- (Qal) to be stupid, dull-hearted, unreceptive
- (Niphal) to be stupid, dull-hearted
- (Piel) to feed, graze
- (Hiphil) to cause to be grazed over

H1198.gloss: from «01197»; properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid:--brutish (person), foolish.

H1199.gloss: from «01198»; brutish: Baara, an Israelitish woman:--Baara.
H1199.outline:
Baara = "brutish"
- one of the wives of Shaharaim, a Benjamite

H1201.gloss: from an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness; Basha, a king of Israel:--Baasha.
H1201.outline:
Baasha = "wicked"
- third king of the northern kingdom of Israel and the founder of its second dynasty having killed the second king, Nadab

H1202.gloss: from «06213» and «03050» with a prepositional prefix; in (the) work of Jah; Baasejah, an Israelite:--Baaseiah.
H1202.outline:
Baaseiah = "in the service of Jehovah"
- a Gershonite Levite, one of the forefathers of Asaph the singer

H1203.gloss: from «06251» (as singular of «06252») with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth; Beeshterah, a place East of the Jordan:--Beeshterah.
H1203.outline:
Beeshterah = "with increase"
- a Levitical city in Manasseh, east of the Jordan; probably identical with 'Ashtaroth'

H1204.gloss: a primitive root; to fear:--affright, be (make) afraid, terrify, trouble.
H1204.outline:
- to terrify, startle, fall upon, dismay, be overtaken by sudden terror
- (Niphal) to be terrified
- (Piel)
- to fall upon, overwhelm
- to terrify

H1206.gloss: probably the same as «0948»; mud (as whitish clay):--mire.

H1207.gloss: intensive from «01206»; a swamp:--fen, mire(-ry place).

H1208.gloss: from «01219»; inaccessible, i.e. lofty:--vintage (by confusion with «01210»).

H1209.gloss: perhaps the same as «01153»; Betsai, the name of two Israelites:--Bezai.
H1209.outline:
Bezai = "conqueror"
- a chief of the returning exiles in the time of Ezra

H1210.gloss: from «01219»; clipped, i.e. the grape crop:--vintage.

H1211.gloss: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel; an onion:--onion.

H1212.gloss: probably from «06738» and «0410» with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God; Betsalel, the name of two Israelites:--Bezaleel.
H1212.outline:
Bezaleel = "in the shadow (i.e. protection) of God"
- son of Uri and grandson of Hur; a skilled Judahite artisan in all works of metal, wood, and stone and one of the architects of the tabernacle
- an Israelite, one of the sons of Pahath-moab, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife

H1213.gloss: or Batsliyth {bats-leeth'}; from the same as «01211»; a peeling; Batsluth or Batslith, an Israelite:--Bazlith, Bazluth.
H1213.outline:
Bazlith or Bazluth = "asking"
- a head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel

H1214.gloss: a primitive root to break off, i.e. (usually) plunder; figuratively, to finish, or (intransitively) stop:--(be) covet(- ous), cut (off), finish, fulfill, gain (greedily), get, be given to (covetousness), greedy, perform, be wounded.
H1214.outline:
- to cut off, break off, gain by unrighteous violence, get, finish, be covetous, be greedy
- (Qal)
- to cut off
- to stop
- to gain wrongfully or by violence
- (Piel)
- to cut off, sever
- to finish, complete, accomplish
- to violently make gain of

H1215.gloss: from «01214»; plunder; by extension, gain (usually unjust):--covetousness, (dishonest) gain, lucre, profit.
H1215.outline: - profit, unjust gain, gain (profit) acquired by violence

H1216.gloss: a primitive root; perhaps to swell up, i.e. blister:--swell.

H1217.gloss: from «01216»; dough (as swelling by fermentation):--dough, flour.

H1218.gloss: from «01216»; a swell of ground; Botscath, a place in Palestine:--Bozcath, Boskath.
H1218.outline:
Bozkath or Boscath = "rocky height"
- a city in Judah in the lowlands toward the Philistines, home of Josiah's mother

H1219.gloss: a primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from «01210») to gather grapes; also to be isolated (i.e. inaccessible by height or fortification):--cut off, (de-)fenced, fortify, (grape) gather(-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold.
H1219.outline:
- to gather, restrain, fence, fortify, make inaccessible, enclose
- (Qal)
- to cut off
- fortified, cut off, made inaccessible (pass participle)
- secrets, mysteries, inaccessible things (subst)
- (Niphal) to be withheld
- (Piel) to fortify

H1220.gloss: from «01219»; strictly a clipping, i.e. gold (as dug out):--gold defence.

H1221.gloss: the same as «01220», an inaccessible spot; Betser, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite:--Bezer.
H1221.outline:
Bezer = "gold ore" or "remote fortress" n pr m
- son of Zophah, one of the heads of the houses of Asher n pr loc
- a city of refuge in Reuben in the downs on the east of the Jordan

H1223.gloss: feminine from «01219»; an enclosure, i.e. sheep fold:--Bozrah.

H1224.gloss: the same as «01223»; Botsrah, a place in Edom:--Bozrah.
H1224.outline:
Bozrah = "sheepfold" or "fortress"
- a town in Edom
- a town in Moab

H1226.gloss: feminine intensive from «01219»; restraint (of rain), i.e. drought:--dearth, drought.

H1227.gloss: the same as «01228»; Bakbuk, one of the Nethinim:--Bakbuk.
H1227.outline:
Bakbuk = "bottle"
- a head of a family of temple-slaves returning from exile with Zerubbabel

H1228.gloss: from «01238»; a bottle (from the gurgling in emptying):--bottle, cruse.

H1229.gloss: from «01228» and «03050»; emptying (i.e. wasting) of Jah; Bakbukjah, an Israelite:--Bakbukiah.
H1229.outline:
Bakbukiah = "wasting of Jehovah"
- a Levite in the time of Nehemiah

H1230.gloss: reduplicated from «01239»; searcher; Bakbakkar, an Israelite:--Bakbakkar.
H1230.outline:
Bakbakkar = "searcher"
- a Levite, apparently a descendant of Asaph

H1231.gloss: from «01238»; wasteful; Bukki, the name of two Israelites:--Bukki.
H1231.outline:
Bukki = "wasting"
- son of Abishua and father of Uzzi, fifth from Aaron in the line of the high priests
- son of Jogli, prince of the tribe of Dan, one of the ten men chosen to apportion the land of Canaan between the tribes

H1232.gloss: from «01238» and «03050»; wasting of Jah; Bukkijah, an Israelite:--Bukkiah.
H1232.outline:
Bukkiah = "Jehovah has emptied"
- a Kohathite Levite, of the sons of Heman, one of the musicians in the temple

H1234.gloss: a primitive root; to cleave; generally, to rend, break, rip or open:--make a breach, break forth (into, out, in pieces, through, up), be ready to burst, cleave (asunder), cut out, divide, hatch, rend (asunder), rip up, tear, win.
H1234.outline:
- to split, cleave, break open, divide, break through, rip up, break up, tear

- to cleave, cleave open
- to break through, break into
- (Niphal)

- to be broken into

- to break into

- (Hithpael) to burst (themselves) open, cleave asunder

H1235.gloss: from «01234»; a section (half) of a shekel, i.e. a beka (a weight and a coin):--bekah, half a shekel.
H1235.outline:
- half, part also called "shekel of the sanctuary" or "holy shekel"
- half a shekel (meton) There appears to be at least three different shekels, one of silver, gold and copper. See a Bible Dictionary for a complete treatment of the subject.

H1237.gloss: from «01234»; properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains:--plain, valley.

H1238.gloss: a primitive root; to pour out, i.e. to empty, figuratively, to depopulate; by analogy, to spread out (as a fruitful vine):--(make) empty (out), fail, × utterly, make void.
H1238.outline:
- to empty
- (Qal)
- to empty, lay waste
- to make void (fig.)
- (Niphal) to be emptied
- (Polel) to empty out, devastate

H1239.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to plough, or (generally) break forth, i.e. (figuratively) to inspect, admire, care for, consider:--(make) inquire (-ry), (make) search, seek out.
H1239.outline:
- to seek, enquire, consider
- (Piel)
- to seek, look for
- to consider, reflect

H1240.outline:
- to seek, enquire
- (Pael) to enquire
- (Ithpael) to let search be made

H1241.gloss: from «01239»; beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd:-- beeve, bull (+ -ock), + calf, + cow, great (cattle), + heifer, herd, kine, ox.
H1241.outline:
- cattle, herd, oxen, ox

- herd (particular one)
- head of cattle (individually)

H1242.gloss: from «01239»; properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning:--(+) day, early, morning, morrow.
H1242.outline:
- morning, break of day
- morning
- of end of night
- of coming of daylight
- of coming of sunrise
- of beginning of day
- of bright joy after night of distress (fig.)
- morrow, next day, next morning

H1243.gloss: intensive from «01239»; a looking after:--seek out.

H1244.gloss: from «01239»; properly, examination, i.e. (by implication) punishment:--scourged.

H1245.gloss: a primitive root; to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after:--ask, beg, beseech, desire, enquire, get, make inquisition, procure, (make) request, require, seek (for).
H1245.outline:
- to seek, require, desire, exact, request
- (Piel)
- to seek to find
- to seek to secure
- to seek the face
- to desire, demand
- to require, exact
- to ask, request
- (Pual) to be sought

H1247.gloss: (Aramaic) corresponding to «01121»; a son, grandson, etc.:--X  old, son.

H1248.gloss: borrowed (as a title) from «01247»; the heir (apparent to the throne):--son.

H1249.gloss: from «01305» (in its various senses); beloved; also pure, empty:--choice, clean, clear, pure.
H1249.outline:
- pure, clear, sincere
- clean, empty adv
- purely

H1250.gloss: or bar {bar}; from «01305» (in the sense of winnowing); grain of any kind (even while standing in the field); by extens. the open country:--corn, wheat.

H1253.gloss: the same as «01252»; vegetable lye (from its cleansing); used as a soap for washing, or a flux for metals:--X never so, purely.
H1253.outline: - lye, potash, alkali used in smelting metal

H1254.gloss: a primitive root; (absolutely) to create; (qualified) to cut down (a wood), select, feed (as formative processes):-- choose, create (creator), cut down, dispatch, do, make (fat).
H1254.outline:
- to create, shape, form
- (Qal) to shape, fashion, create (always with God as subject)
- of heaven and earth
- of individual man
- of new conditions and circumstances
- of transformations

- of heaven and earth

H1255.gloss: a variation of «04757»; Berodak-Baladan, a Babylonian king:--Berodach-baladan.Birliy.
H1255.outline:
Berodach-baladan = "worshipper of Baal"
- king of Babylon in the days of Hezekiah

H1256.gloss: from «01254» and «08050»; Jah has created; Berajah, an Israelite:--Beraiah.
H1256.outline:
Beraiah = "Jehovah has created"
- son of Shimhi, a chief man of Benjamin

H1257.gloss: by reduplication from «01250»; a fowl (as fattened on grain):--fowl.
H1257.outline:
- (CLBL) fowl, birds
- (BDB/TWOT) birds fattened for table of Solomon

H1260.gloss: from «01258»; hail; Bered, the name of a place south of Palestine, also of an Israelite:--Bered.
H1260.outline:
Bered = "hail" n pr m
- a son or descendant of Ephraim n pr loc
- a place in the south of Palestine, near Kadesh, near the well Lahairoi

H1262.gloss: a primitive root; to select; also (as denominative from «01250») to feed; also (as equivalent to «01305») to render clear (Eccl. 3:18):--choose, (cause to) eat, manifest, (give) meat.
H1262.outline:
- to eat, consume
- (Qal) to eat
- (Piel) for eating, devouring
- (Hiphil) to cause to eat

H1263.gloss: passive participle from «01288»; blessed; Baruk, the name of three Israelites:--Baruch.
H1263.outline:
Baruch = "blessed"
- friend, amanuensis, and faithful attendant of Jeremiah
- a priest, the son of Zabbai who assisted Nehemiah in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem
- a priest, or family of priests, who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
- son of Col-hozeh, a descendant of Perez or Pharez, the son of Judah

H1264.gloss: probably of foreign origin; damask (stuff of variegated thread):--rich apparel.

H1265.gloss: of uncertain derivation; a cypress (?) tree; hence, a lance or a musical instrument (as made of that wood):--fir (tree).
H1265.outline:
- cypress, fir, juniper, pine
- a noble tree (lit.)
- of stateliness (fig.)
- material for temple

H1266.gloss: a variation of «01265»; the cypress (or some elastic tree):--fir.

H1268.gloss: or Berothay {bay-ro-that'-ee}; probably from «01266»; cypress or cypresslike; Berothah or Berothai, a place north of Palestine:--Berothah, Berothai.
H1268.outline:
Berothah or Berothai = "cypress grove"
- a place near Hamath
- a city belonging to Hadadezer

H1269.gloss: probably feminine plural from an unused root (apparently mean to pierce); holes; Birzoth, an Israelite:--Birzavith (from the marg.).
H1269.outline:
Birzavith or Birzath = "in leanness: choice olive"
- a descendant of Asher

H1270.gloss: perhaps from the root of «01269»; iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement:--(ax) head, iron.
H1270.outline:
- iron
- iron
- iron ore
- as material of furniture, utensils, implements
- tool of iron
- harshness, strength, oppression (fig.)

H1271.gloss: from «01270»; iron-hearted; Barzillai, the name of three Israelites:--Barzillai.
H1271.outline:
Barzillai = "my iron"
- a Gileadite leader who helped David defeat Absalom's rebellion
- a priest, son-in-law to Barzillai the Gileadite
- an Israelite from Mahalath whose son Adriel married Michal, Saul's daughter

H1272.gloss: a primitive root; to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly:--chase (away); drive away, fain, flee (away), put to flight, make haste, reach, run away, shoot.
H1272.outline:
- to go through, flee, run away, chase, drive away, put to flight, reach, shoot (extend), hurry away

- to go, pass through

- (Hiphil)
- to pass through
- to cause to flee, put to flight
- to drive away

H1273.gloss: by transposition for «0978»; a Barchumite, or native of Bachurim:--Barhumite.
H1273.outline:
Barhumite = "son of the blackened: in the pitied"
- a person from Bahurim, a village apparently on or close to the road leading up from the Jordan valley to Jerusalem, and near the south boundary of Benjamin

H1274.outline:
- fat
- (TWOT) fat, fatter, fed, firm, plenteous, rank

H1275.gloss: probably by contraction from «0882»; Beri, an Israelite:--Beri.
H1275.outline:
Beri = "a well"
- son of Zophah, of the tribe of Asher

H1276.gloss: of uncertain derivation; (only in the plural and with the article) the Berites, a place in Palestine:--Berites.
H1276.outline:
Berites = "my well: of the well"
- a tribe who are named with Abel and Beth-maachah, and who were therefore doubtless situated in the north of Palestine

H1277.gloss: from «01254» (in the sense of «01262»); fatted or plump:--fat ((fleshed), -ter), fed, firm, plenteous, rank.
H1277.outline:
- fat
- (TWOT) fat, fatter, fed, firm, plenteous, rank

H1278.gloss: feminine from «01254»; a creation, i.e. a novelty:--new thing.
H1278.outline: - a creation, created thing, new thing, marvel

H1280.outline:
- bar

- of city gates
- of tribulation, a fortress, of the earth as a prison (fig.)

H1281.gloss: or (shortened) bariach {baw-ree'-akh}; from «01272»; a fugitive, i.e. the serpent (as fleeing), and the constellation by that name:--crooked, noble, piercing.

H1282.gloss: the same as «01281»; Bariach, an Israelite:--Bariah.
H1282.outline:
Bariah = "fleeing" or "fugitive"
- son of Shemaiah and descendant of the royal family of Judah

H1283.gloss: apparently from the feminine of «07451» with a prepositional prefix; in trouble; Beriah, the name of four Israelites:-- Beriah.
H1283.outline:
Beriah = "with a friend"
- a son of Asher
- a son of Ephraim
- a Benjamite
- a Levite

H1284.gloss: patronymically from «01283»; a Beriite (collectively) or descendants of Beriah:--Beerites.
H1284.outline:
Beriites = "in evil"
- one of the family of Beriah

H1285.gloss: from «01262» (in the sense of cutting (like «01254»)); a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh):--confederacy, (con-)feder(-ate), covenant, league.
H1285.outline:
- covenant, alliance, pledge
- between men

- constitution, ordinance (monarch to subjects)

Berith = "covenant"

- to bless, kneel

- to be blessed

H1292.gloss: from «01288» and «0410», God has blessed; Barakel, the father of one of Job's friends:--Barachel.

H1293.gloss: from «01288»; benediction; by implication prosperity:--blessing, liberal, pool, present.

- blessing

- blessing, praise of God
- a gift, present
- treaty of peace

H1294.gloss: the same as «01293»; Berakah, the name of an Israelite, and also of a valley in Palestine:--Berachah.

- lightning

H2729.gloss: a primitive root; to shudder with terror; hence, to fear; also to hasten (with anxiety):--be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble.
H2729.outline:
- to tremble, quake, move about, be afraid, be startled, be terrified
- (Qal)
- to tremble, quake (of a mountain)
- to tremble (of people)
- to be anxiously careful
- to go or come trembling (with prep)
- (Hiphil)
- to cause to tremble
- to drive in terror, rout (an army)

H2731.gloss: feminine of «02730»; fear, anxiety:--care, × exceedingly, fear, quaking, trembling.
H2731.outline:
- fear, anxiety, quaking, trembling, (extreme) anxiety, anxious care
- trembling, quaking
- anxious care

H2732.gloss: the same as «02731»; Charadah, a place in the Desert:--Haradah.
H2732.outline:
Haradah = "fear"
- a desert station of Israel in the wilderness; site unknown

H2733.gloss: patrial from a derivative of «02729» (compare «05878»); a Charodite, or inhabitant of Charod:--Harodite.
H2733.outline:
Harodite = see Harod "trembling"
- a resident or descendant of Harod otherwise unknown; two of David's 37 guards, Shammah and Elika, called Harodites

H2734.gloss: a primitive root (compare «02787»); to glow or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to blaze up, of anger, zeal, jealousy:--be angry, burn, be displeased, × earnestly, fret self, grieve, be (wax) hot, be incensed, kindle, × very, be wroth. See «08474».

H2735.gloss: from «02356» and a collateral (masculine) form of «01412», with the article interposed; hole of the cleft: Chor-hag-Gidgad, a place in the Desert:--Hor-hagidgad.
H2735.outline:
Hor-hagidgad = "cavern of Gidgad"
- a desert station of Israel in the wilderness; site unknown

H2736.gloss: ; from «02734» and «03050»; fearing Jah; Charhajah, an Israelite:--Harhaiah.
H2736.outline:
Harhaiah = "fear of Jehovah"
- father of Uzziel who was one of the builders of the wall in Nehemiah's time

H2737.gloss: from an unused root meaning to perforate; properly, pierced, i.e. a bead of pearl, gems or jewels (as strung):--chain.
H2737.outline: - a beaded necklace, string of beads

H2738.gloss: or (shortened) charul {khaw-rool'}; apparently, a passive participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly; properly, pointed, i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed: nettle.
H2738.outline: - nettles, weeds, kind of weed (perhaps chickpea)

H2739.gloss: from passive participle of «02763» and «0639»; snub-nosed; Charumaph, an Israelite:--Harumaph.
H2739.outline:
Harumaph = "split nose"
- father of Jedaiah, one of the builders of the wall in Nehemiah's time

H2740.gloss: or (shortened) charon {khaw-rone'}; from «02734»; a burning of anger:--sore displeasure, fierce(-ness), fury, (fierce) wrath(-ful).
H2740.outline:
- anger, heat, burning (of anger)
- always used of God's anger

H2741.gloss: a patrial from (probably) a collateral form of «02756»; a Charuphite or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph):--Haruphite.
H2741.outline:
Haruphite = "native of Haruph"
- an inhabitant of Hariph

H2742.gloss: or charuts {khaw-roots'}; passive participle of «02782»; properly, incised or (active) incisive; hence (as noun masculine or feminine) a trench (as dug), gold (as mined), a threshing-sledge (having sharp teeth); (figuratively) determination; also eager:--decision, diligent, (fine) gold, pointed things, sharp, threshing instrument, wall.
H2742.outline:
adj
- sharp-pointed, sharp, diligent n m
- strict decision, decision
- trench, moat, ditch
- gold (poetical)

H2743.gloss: the same as «02742»; earnest; Charuts, an Israelite:--Haruz.
H2743.outline:
Haruz = "zealous"
- a man of Jotbah, father of Meshullemeth, wife of Manasseh and mother of Amon

H2744.gloss: a fuller form of «02746»; inflammation; Charchur, one of the Nethinim:--Harhur.
H2744.outline:
Harhur = "inflammation"
- head of a family returning from exile with Zerubbabel

H2745.gloss: from the same as «02775»; perhaps shining; Charchas, an Israelite:--Harhas.
H2745.outline:
Harhas = "very poor"
- grandfather of Shallum, the husband of Huldah, the prophetess

H2746.outline: - extreme heat, inflammation, violent heat, fever

H2747.gloss: from a primitive root meaning to engrave; a chisel or graver; also a style for writing:--graving tool, pen.
H2747.outline:
- an engraving tool, stylus, chisel, graving tool
- graving tool
- stylus

H2748.gloss: from the same as «02747»; a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles):--magician.
H2748.outline:
- diviner, magician, astrologer
- engraver, writer (only in derivative sense of one possessed of occult knowledge)

H2750.gloss: from «02734»; a burning (i.e. intense) anger:--fierce, × great, heat.

H2751.gloss: from the same as «02353»; white bread:--white.

H2752.gloss: from «02356»; cave-dweller or troglodyte; a Chorite or aboriginal Idumaean:--Horims, Horites.
H2752.outline:
Horite = "cave dweller"
- the inhabitants of Mount Seir
- the inhabitants of Edom (in later times)

H2753.gloss: or Chowriy {kho-ree'}; the same as «02752»; Chori, the name of two men:--Hori.
H2753.outline:
Hori = "cave dweller"
- a Horite, son of Lotan, the son of Seir
- a Simeonite, father of Shaphat

H2754.gloss: or charit {khaw-reet'}; from the same as «02747»; properly, cut out (or hollow), i.e. (by implication) a pocket:--bag, crisping pin.

H2755.gloss: from the plural of «02716» and the plural of «03123»; excrements of doves {or perhaps rather the plural of a single word charapyown {khar-aw-yone'}; of similar or uncertain derivation, probably a kind of vegetable:--doves' dung.

H2756.gloss: from «02778»; autumnal; Chariph, the name of two Israelites:--Hariph.
H2756.outline:
Hariph = "a plucking off"
- head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel
- a head of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah

H2757.gloss: or charits {khaw-reets'}; from «02782»; properly, incisure or (passively) incised (compare «02742»); hence, a threshing-sledge (with sharp teeth): also a slice (as cut):--+ cheese, harrow.
H2757.outline: - a cut, thing cut, sharp instrument, sharp cutting instrument, harrow, hoe

H2758.gloss: from «02790»; ploughing or its season:--earing (time), ground.

H2759.gloss: from «02790» in the sense of silence; quiet, i.e. sultry (as feminine noun, the sirocco or hot east wind):--vehement.

H2760.gloss: a primitive root; to braid (i.e. to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in a net:--roast.
H2760.outline:
- (Qal) to set in motion, start
- (CLBL) to roast

H2761.gloss: (Aramaic) a root probably allied to the equivalent of «02787»; to scorch:--singe.

H2762.gloss: from «02760»; properly, a net, i.e. (by analogy) lattice:--lattice.
H2762.outline: - lattice, other opening through which one may look

H2763.gloss: a primitive root; to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physical and reflexive, to be blunt as to the nose:--make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).
H2763.outline:
- to ban, devote, destroy utterly, completely destroy, dedicate for destruction, exterminate
- (Hiphil)
- to prohibit (for common use), ban
- to consecrate, devote, dedicate for destruction
- to exterminate, completely destroy
- (Hophal)
- to be put under the ban, be devoted to destruction
- to be devoted, be forfeited
- to be completely destroyed
- to split, slit, mutilate (a part of the body)
- (Qal) to mutilate
- (Hiphil) to divide

H2764.gloss: or (Zecheriah 14:11) cherem {kheh'-rem}; from «02763»; physical (as shutting in) a net (either literally or figuratively); usually a doomed object; abstr. extermination:--(ac-)curse(-d, -d thing), dedicated thing, things which should have been utterly destroyed, (appointed to) utter destruction, devoted (thing), net.

H2765.gloss: from «02763»; devoted; Chorem, a place in Palestine:--Horem.
H2765.outline:
Horem = "sacred"
- one of the fortified towns in Naphtali

H2766.outline:
Harim = "dedicated"
- a priest in the time of David who had charge of the 3rd course
- head of a family of exiles totalling 1017 who returned with Zerubbabel
- another head of a family of exiles totalling 320 who returned with Zerubbabel
- a priest in the time of Nehemiah
- a ruler of the people under Nehemiah

H2767.gloss: from «02763»; devoted; Chormah, a place in Palestine:--Hormah.
H2767.outline:
Hormah = "devotion"
- a town of the Canaanites, conquered by Joshua, allotted to Judah, and located in the south of Judah

H2768.gloss: from «02763»; abrupt; Chermon, a mount of Palestine:--Hermon.
H2768.outline:
Hermon = "a sanctuary"
- a mountain on the northeastern border of Palestine and Lebanon and overlooking the border city of Dan

H2769.gloss: plural of «02768»; Hermons, i.e. its peaks:--the Hermonites.
H2769.outline:
Hermonites = see Hermon "a sanctuary"
- the name for the three summits of Mount Hermon located on the border of Palestine and Lebanon

H2771.gloss: from «02787»; parched; Charan, the name of a man and also of a place:--Haran.
H2771.outline:
Haran = "mountaineer" n pr m
- a son of Caleb by his concubine Ephah n pr loc
- the city to which Abraham migrated when he left Ur of the Chaldees and where he stayed until his father died before leaving for the promised land; located in Mesopotamia in Padan-aram at the foot of Mount Masius between the Khabour and the Euphrates

H2772.gloss: patrial from «02773»; a Choronite or inhabitant of Choronaim:--Horonite.
H2772.outline:
Horonite = "native of Horonaim"
- an inhabitant of Horonaim in Moab
- the designation of Sanballat, the opponent of Nehemiah

H2773.gloss: dual of a derivative from «02356»; double cave-town; Choronajim, a place in Moab:--Horonaim.
H2773.outline:
Horonaim = "two caves"
- a town of Moab

H2774.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Charnepher, an Israelite:--Harnepher.
H2774.outline:
Harnepher = "panting"
- a son of Zophah of the tribe of Asher

H2775.gloss: or (with a directive enclitic) charcah (khar'- saw}; from an unused root meaning to scrape; the itch; also (perhaps from the mediating idea of «02777») the sun:--itch, sun.

H2776.gloss: the same as «02775»; shining; Cheres, a mountain in Palestine:--Heres.
H2776.outline:
Heres = "the sun"
- a mountain inhabited by Amorites in Moab; the place where Gideon turned back from chasing the Midianites

H2777.gloss: from «02775» (apparently in the sense of a red tile used for scraping); a potsherd, i.e. (by implication) a pottery; the name of a gate at Jerusalem:--east.

H2778.gloss: a primitive root; to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; denominative (from «02779») to spend the winter:--betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid.
H2778.outline:
- to reproach, taunt, blaspheme, defy, jeopardise, rail, upbraid
- (Qal) to reproach
- (Piel) to reproach, defy, taunt
- (Qal) to winter, spend harvest time, remain in harvest time
- (Niphal) to acquire, be betrothed

H2779.gloss: from «02778»; properly, the crop gathered, i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season; figuratively, ripeness of age:--cold, winter (-house), youth.

H2780.outline:
Hareph = "a plucking off"
- a son of Caleb and father of Bethgader

H2781.gloss: from «02778»; contumely, disgrace, the pudenda:--rebuke, reproach(-fully), shame.
H2781.outline:
- reproach, scorn
- taunt, scorn (upon enemy)
- reproach (resting upon condition of shame, disgrace)
- a reproach (an object)

H2782.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to point sharply, i.e. (literally) to wound; figuratively, to be alert, to decide:--bestir self, decide, decree, determine, maim, move.
H2782.outline:
- to cut, sharpen, decide, decree, determine, maim, move, be decisive, be mutilated
- (Qal)
- to cut, mutilate
- to sharpen
- to decide
- (Niphal) to be decisive

H2783.gloss: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02782» in the sense of vigor; the loin (as the seat of strength):--loin.

H2784.gloss: of uncertain derivation; a fetter; figuratively, a pain:--band.
H2784.outline:
- bond, fetter, pang, hands
- bonds
- pangs

H2785.gloss: from «02782»; a sour grape (as sharp in taste):--kernel.
H2785.outline: - kernels, seeds, insignificant vine product, grape seeds?

H2786.gloss: a primitive root; to grate the teeth:--gnash.

H2787.gloss: a primitive root; to glow, i.e. literally (to melt, burn, dry up) or figuratively (to show or incite passion:--be angry, burn, dry, kindle.
H2787.outline:
- to burn, be hot, be scorched, be charred
- (Qal)
- to be hot, be scorched
- to burn, be burned
- (Niphal)
- to be scorched, be burned
- to burn
- to be dry, be angry
- (Pilpel) to cause to burn

H2789.gloss: a collateral form mediating between «02775» and «02791»; a piece of pottery:--earth(-en), (pot-)sherd, + stone.
H2789.outline: - earthenware, clay pottery, shard, potsherd, earthen vessel

H2790.gloss: a primitive root; to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness):--X altogether, cease, conceal, be deaf, devise, ear, graven, imagine, leave off speaking, hold peace, plow(-er, man), be quiet, rest, practise secretly, keep silence, be silent, speak not a word, be still, hold tongue, worker.
H2790.outline:
- to cut in, plough, engrave, devise
- (Qal)
- to cut in, engrave
- to plough
- to devise
- (Niphal) to be ploughed
- (Hiphil) to plot evil
- to be silent, be dumb, be speechless, be deaf
- (Qal)
- to be silent
- to be deaf
- (Hiphil)
- to be silent, keep quiet
- to make silent
- to be deaf, show deafness
- (Hithpael) to remain silent

H2791.gloss: from «02790»; magical craft; also silence:--cunning, secretly.
H2791.outline:
adv
- silently, secretly n m
- magic art, magician

H2792.outline:
Heresh = "mute"
- a Levite attached to the tabernacle

H2793.gloss: from «02790»; a forest (perhaps as furnishing the material for fabric):--bough, forest, shroud, wood.
H2793.outline: - wood, wooded height, forest, wooded area

H2794.gloss: active participle of «02790»; a fabricator or mechanic:--artificer.

H2796.gloss: from «02790»; a fabricator or any material:--artificer, (+) carpenter, craftsman, engraver, maker, + mason, skilful, (+) smith, worker, workman, such as wrought.
H2796.outline:
- craftsman, artisan, engraver, graver, artificer
- graver, artificer
- skilful to destroy (warriors) (fig.)

H2797.gloss: from «02792»; magician; Charsha, one of the Nethinim:--Harsha.
H2797.outline:
Harsha = "mute"
- head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel

H2798.gloss: plural of «02796»; mechanics, the name of a valley in Jerusalem:--Charashim, craftsmen.
H2798.outline:
Charashim or Harashim = "valley of craftsmen"
- a valley near Lydda, a few miles east of Joppa, founded by Joab of Othniel's family

H2800.gloss: the same as «02799»; Charosheth, a place in Palestine:--Harosheth.
H2800.outline:
Harosheth = "woodland"
- a city in the north of the land of Canaan on the west coast of the lake Merom

H2802.gloss: from «02801» (but equivalent to «02793»); forest; Chereth, a thicket in Palestine:--Hereth.
H2802.outline:
Hareth = "forest"
- a forest whose site is now unknown

H2803.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (gen.) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute:--(make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.
H2803.outline:
- to think, plan, esteem, calculate, invent, make a judgment, imagine, count
- (Qal)
- to think, account
- to plan, devise, mean
- to charge, impute, reckon
- to esteem, value, regard
- to invent
- (Niphal)
- to be accounted, be thought, be esteemed
- to be computed, be reckoned
- to be imputed
- (Piel)
- to think upon, consider, be mindful of
- to think to do, devise, plan
- to count, reckon
- (Hithpael) to be considered

H2805.gloss: from «02803»; a belt or strap (as being interlaced):--curious girdle.
H2805.outline:
- girdle, band, ingenious work
- ingenious work - the name of the girdle or band of the ephod

H2806.gloss: from «02803» and «01777»; considerate judge; Chasbaddanah, an Israelite:--Hasbadana.
H2806.outline:
Hashbadana = "considerate judge"
- one of the men who stood on the left of Ezra while he read the law to the people

H2808.gloss: from «02803»; properly, contrivance; by implication, intelligence:--account, device, reason.

H2809.gloss: the same as «02808»; Cheshbon, a place East of the Jordan:--Heshbon.
H2809.outline:
Heshbon = "stronghold"
- the capital city of Sihon, king of the Amorites, located on the western border of the high plain and on the border line between the tribes of Reuben and Gad

H2810.gloss: from «02803»; a contrivance, i.e. actual (a warlike machine) or mental (a machination):--engine, invention.

H2811.gloss: or Chashabyahuw {khash-ab-yaw'-hoo}; from «02803» and «03050»; Jah has regarded; Chashabjah, the name of nine Israelites:--Hashabiah.
H2811.outline:
Hashabiah = "Jehovah has considered"
- a Merarite Levite
- the 4th of the 6 sons of Jeduthun who had charge of the 12th course
- one of the descendants of Hebron the son of Kohath
- the son of Kemuel, who was prince of the tribe of Levi in the time of David
- a Levite, one of the chiefs of his tribe who officiated for Josiah at his great passover feast
- a Merarite Levite, one of the chief priests who accompanied Ezra from Babylon; ruler of half the circuit of Keilah and one who repaired a portion of the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah. He sealed the covenant of reformation after the return from captivity
- a Levite, son of Bunni in the time of Nehemiah
- a Levite, son of Mattaniah in the time of Nehemiah
- a priest of the family of Hilkiah in the days of Joiakim, son of Jeshua

H2812.gloss: feminine of «02808»; inventiveness; Chashnah, an Israelite:--Hashabnah.
H2812.outline:
Hashabnah = "Jehovah has considered"
- one of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah

H2813.gloss: from «02808» and «03050»; thought of Jah; Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites:--Hashabniah.
H2813.outline:
Hashabniah = "whom Jehovah regards"
- the father of Hattush, repairer of the wall
- a Levite who was among those who officiated at the great fast under Ezra and Nehemiah when the covenant was sealed

H2814.gloss: a primitive root; to hush or keep quiet:--hold peace, keep silence, be silent, (be) still.
H2814.outline:
- to be silent, quiet, still, inactive
- (Qal) to be silent, be still
- (Hiphil)
- to be silent, exhibit silence
- to show inactivity, be inactive
- to make silent, make quiet, cause to be still

H2815.gloss: from «02803»; intelligent; Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites:--Hashub, Hasshub.
H2815.outline:
Hashub = "considerate"
- a Merarite Levite chief, son of Azrikam
- a son of Pahath-moab who assisted in the repair of the wall of Jerusalem
- a man who assisted in the repair of the wall of Jerusalem; may be same as 2 above
- one of the heads of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah

H2816.gloss: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02821»; the dark:--darkness.

H2817.gloss: or Chasuphao {khas-oo-faw'}; from «02834»; nakedness; Chasupha, one of the Nethinim:--Hashupha, Hasupha.
H2817.outline:
Hasupha or Hashupha = "stripped"
- head of the family of temple slaves returning from exile in the 1st caravan

H2818.gloss: (Aramaic) a collateral root to one corresponding to «02363» in the sense of readiness; to be necessary (from the idea of convenience) or (transitively) to need:--careful, have need of.
H2818.outline:
v
- (P'al) to need, have need n
- (P'al) the thing needed

H2819.gloss: from a root corresponding to «02818»; necessity:--be needful.
H2819.outline: - things needed, requirements, that which is required

H2820.gloss: a primitive root; to restrain or (reflex.) refrain; by implication, to refuse, spare, preserve; also (by interch. with «02821») to observe:--assuage, × darken, forbear, hinder, hold back, keep (back), punish, refrain, reserve, spare, withhold.
H2820.outline:
- to withhold, restrain, hold back, keep in check, refrain
- (Qal)
- to withhold, keep back, keep for oneself, keep from, hold in check, refrain, spare, reserve
- to restrain, check
- (Niphal) to assuage, be spared

H2821.gloss: a primitive root; to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken:--be black, be (make) dark, darken, cause darkness, be dim, hide.
H2821.outline:
- to be or become dark, grow dim, be darkened, be black, be hidden
- (Qal)
- to be or grow dark
- to have a dark colour
- to grow dim
- (Hiphil)
- to make dark, cause to be dark
- to hide, conceal
- to obscure, confuse (fig.)

H2822.gloss: from «02821»; the dark; hence (literally) darkness; figuratively, misery, destruction, death, ignorance, sorrow, wickedness:--dark(-ness), night, obscurity.

H2825.gloss: or chashekah {khash-ay-kaw'}; from «02821»; darkness; figuratively, misery:--darkness.

H2826.gloss: a primitive root; to make (intrans. be) unsteady, i.e. weak:--feeble.

H2827.gloss: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to «02826»; to weaken, i.e. crush:--subdue.

H2828.gloss: from the same as «02831»; enriched; Chashum, the name of two or three Israelites:--Hashum.
H2828.outline:
Hashum = "rich"
- head of a family of 223 exiles returning with Zerubbabel
- one of the priests or Levites who stood on Ezra's left while he read the law

H2829.gloss: the same as «02831»; opulent; Cheshmon, a place in Palestine:--Heshmon.
H2829.outline:
Heshmon = "rich soil"
- a town in the extreme south of Judah; site uncertain

H2830.gloss: of uncertain derivation; probably bronze or polished spectrum metal:--amber.
H2830.outline: - a shining substance, amber or electrum or bronze (uncertain)

H2831.gloss: from an unused root (probably meaning firm or capacious in resources); apparently wealthy:--princes.

H2832.gloss: feminine of «02831»; fertile; Chasmonah, a place in the Desert:--Hashmonah.
H2832.outline:
Hashmonah = "fatness"
- a station of Israel in the wilderness

H2833.gloss: from an unused root probably meaning to contain or sparkle; perhaps a pocket (as holding the Urim and Thummim), or rich (as containing gems), used only of the gorget of the highpriest:--breastplate.
H2833.outline:
- breastplate, breastpiece
- sacred pouch of the high priest designed to hold the Urim and Thummim

H2834.gloss: a primitive root; to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid):--make bare, clean, discover, draw out, take, uncover.
H2834.outline:
- to strip, strip off, lay bare, make bare, draw out
- (Qal)
- to strip off
- to strip, lay bare
- to draw (water), skim, take from the surface

H2835.gloss: from «02834»; properly, drawn off, i.e. separated; hence, a small company (as divided from the rest):--little flock.

H2836.gloss: a primitive root; to cling, i.e. join, (figuratively) to love, delight in; elliptically (or by interchangeable for «02820») to deliver:--have a delight, (have a ) desire, fillet, long, set (in) love.
H2836.outline:
- (Qal) to love, be attached to, long for
