- the group of Assyrian colonists who were planted in the cities of Samaria after the captivity of the northern kingdom of Israel; identity uncertain

H2969.gloss: a primitive root; to be suitable:--appertain.
H2969.outline: - (Qal) to pertain to, befit, be befitting

H2970.gloss: or Ya.azanyahuw {yah-az-an-yaw'-hoo}; from «0238» and «03050»; heard of Jah; Jaazanjah, the name of four Israelites:-- Jaazaniah. Compare «03153».
H2970.outline:
Jaazaniah = "Jehovah hears"
- a Judean, son of the Maachathite, a captain of the Judean forces who visited Gedaliah at Mizpah after Gedaliah had been appointed governor of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar

H2971.gloss: from «0215»; enlightener; Jair, the name of four Israelites:--Jair.
H2971.outline:
Jair = "he enlightens"
- a descendant of Manasseh who conquered many towns during the time of the conquest
- the Gileadite, a judge of Israel for 22 years during the time of the judges; father of 30 sons
- a Benjamite, son of Kish, and father of Mordecai
- father of Elhanan, one of David's mighty warriors

H2972.gloss: patronymically from «02971»; a Jairite or descendant of Jair:--Jairite.
H2972.outline:
Jairite = "descendant of Jair"
- a descendant of Jair
- Ira the Jairite was a priest to David

H2973.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to be slack, i.e. (figuratively) to be foolish:--dote, be (become, do) foolish(-ly).
H2973.outline:
- to be foolish, become fools, act foolishly, show wicked folly
- (Niphal)
- to show wicked folly
- to become fools

H2974.gloss: a primitive root (probably rather the same as «02973» through the idea of mental weakness); properly, to yield, especially assent; hence (pos.) to undertake as an act of volition:--assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, ×  willingly, would.
H2974.outline:
- to begin, make a beginning, show willingness, undertake to do, be pleased, be determined
- (Hiphil)
- to agree to, show willingness, acquiesce, accept an invitation, be willing
- to undertake
- to resolve, be pleased, be determined

H2975.gloss: of Egyptian origin; a channel, e.g. a fosse, canal, shaft; specifically the Nile, as the one river of Egypt, including its collateral trenches; also the Tigris, as the main river of Assyria:--brook, flood, river, stream.
H2975.outline:
- river, stream, canal, Nile, Nile-canal
- stream, river (Nile)
- Nile-arms, Nile-canals
- watercourses
- shafts (mining)
- river (in general)

H2976.gloss: a primitive root; to desist, i.e. (figuratively) to despond:--(cause to) despair, one that is desperate, be no hope.
H2976.outline:
- to despair
- (Niphal) to be despaired, be desperate
- (Piel) to cause to despair interj
- it is hopeless!

H2977.gloss: or {yo-she-yaw'-hoo}; from the same root as «0803» and «03050»; founded of Jah; Joshijah, the name of two Israelites:-- Josiah.
H2977.outline:
Josiah = "whom Jehovah heals"
- son of Amon by Jedidah who succeeded his father to the throne of Judah and reigned for 31 years; his reign is noteworthy for the great revivals back to the worship of Jehovah which he led
- a returned exile and son of Zephaniah at whose house took place the solemn and symbolical crowning of Joshua the high priest in the time of Zechariah the prophet

H2979.gloss: from the same as «0871»; stepping; Jeatherai, an Israelite:--Jeaterai.
H2979.outline:
Jeaterai = "whom Jehovah leads"
- a Gershonite Levite, son of Zerah

H2980.gloss: a primitive root; to bawl:--cry out.

H2981.gloss: from «02986»; produce, i.e. a crop or (figuratively) wealth:--fruit, increase.

H2982.gloss: from «0947»; trodden, i.e. threshing-place; Jebus, the aboriginal name of Jerusalem:--Jebus.
H2982.outline:
Jebus = "threshing place"
- an early name for Jerusalem, the city of the Jebusites; also 'Jebusi'

H2983.gloss: patrial from «02982»; a Jebusite or inhabitant of Jebus:--Jebusite(-s).
H2983.outline:
Jebusite = "descendants of Jebus"
- descendants of the 3rd son of Canaan who lived in or around the site of Jebus, the early name for Jerusalem

H2984.outline:
Ibhar = "Jehovah chooses"
- one of the sons of David, born in Jerusalem

H2985.gloss: from «0995»; intelligent; Jabin, the name of two Canaanitish kings:--Jabin.
H2985.outline:
Jabin = "whom God observes"
- a king of Hazor who organised a confederacy of the northern princes against Joshua; confederacy routed by the waters of Merom
- another king of Hazor whose general, Sisera, was defeated by Barak

H2986.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to flow; causatively, to bring (especially with pomp):--bring (forth), carry, lead (forth).
H2986.outline:
- to bring, lead, carry, conduct, bear along
- (Hiphil)
- to bear along, bring
- to carry away, lead away
- to lead, conduct
- (Hophal)
- to be borne along
- to be borne (to the grave)
- to be brought, be led, be conducted

H2989.gloss: the same as «02988»; Jabal, an antediluvian:--Jabal.
H2989.outline:
Jabal = "stream of water"
- the son of Lamech by Adah and brother of Jubal; described as the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle

H2991.gloss: from «01104» and «05971»; devouring people; Jibleam, a place in Palestine:--Ibleam.
H2991.outline:
Ibleam = "devouring the people"
- a city of Manasseh apparently located in the territory of either Issachar or Asher

H2992.gloss: a primitive root of doubtful meaning; used only as a denominative from «02993»; to marry a (deceased) brother's widow:--perform the duty of a husband's brother, marry.
H2992.outline:
- (Piel) to perform levirate marriage, perform the duty of a brother-in-law
- the duty due to a brother who died childless - to marry his widow and have a son for his name

H2993.gloss: from (the orig. of) «02992»; a brother-in-law:--husband's brother.

H2994.gloss: feminine participle of «02992»; a sister-in-law:--brother's wife, sister in law.

H2995.gloss: from «01129» and «0410»: built of God; Jabneel, the name of two places in Palestine:--Jabneel.
H2995.outline:
Jabneel = "God causes to build"
- a town in Judah on the northern boundary near the sea
- a town in Naphtali on the boundary in upper Galilee

H2996.gloss: from «01129»; a building; Jabneh, a place in Palestine:--Jabneh.
H2996.outline:
Jabneh = "building of God"
- a Philistine city

H2997.gloss: from «01129» and «03050»; built of Jah; Jibnejah, an Israelite:--Ibneiah.
H2997.outline:
Ibneiah = "Jehovah builds"
- a Benjamite, son of Jehoram

H2998.gloss: from «01129» and «03050»; building of Jah; Jibnijah, an Israelite:--Ibnijah.
H2998.outline:
Ibnijah = "whom Jehovah will build up"
- a Benjamite

H2999.gloss: probably from «01238»; pouring forth; Jabbok, a river east of the Jordan:--Jabbok.
H2999.outline:
Jabbok = "emptying"
- a stream which intersects the mountain range of Gilead, and falls into the Jordan on the east about midway between the Sea of Galilee and the Dead Sea

H3000.gloss: from «01288» and «03050»: blessed of Jah; Jeberekjah, an Israelite:--Jeberechiah.
H3000.outline:
Jeberechiah = "Jehovah blesses"
- father of a Zechariah, in the reign of Ahaz and time of Isaiah

H3001.gloss: a primitive root; to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage):--be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do)  shame(-fully), × utterly, wither (away).
H3001.outline:
- to make dry, wither, be dry, become dry, be dried up, be withered
- (Qal)
- to be dry, be dried up, be without moisture
- to be dried up
- (Piel) to make dry, dry up
- (Hiphil)
- to dry up, make dry 1c
- to dry up (water) 1c
- to make dry, wither 1c
- to exhibit dryness

H3003.gloss: the same as «03002» (also Yabeysh {yaw-bashe'}; often with the addition of «01568», i.e. Jabesh of Gilad); Jobesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:--Jobesh ((-Gilead)).
H3003.outline:
Jabesh = "dry" n pr loc
- a town in the territory of Gilead; according to Eusebius, it is beyond the Jordan, 6 miles (10 km) from Pella, on the mountain road to Gerasa; site unknown but may be modern 'Wadi Yabes' n pr m
- father of Shallum, the 15th king of the northern kingdom

H3005.gloss: from the same as «01314»; fragrant; Jibsam, an Israelite:--Jibsam.
H3005.outline:
Jibsam = "pleasant"
- one of the sons of Tola and a grandson of Issachar

H3006.gloss: a variation of «03004»; dry ground:--dry land.

H3007.outline:
- the earth (as a planet)
- dry land

H3008.gloss: from «01350»; avenger; Jigal, the name of three Israelites:--Igal, Igeal.
H3008.outline:
Igal or Igeal = "He redeems"
- son of Joseph and a spy from the tribe of Issachar
- son of Nathan of Zobah, one of David's mighty warriors
- a son of Shemaiah and descendant of Zerubbabel

H3009.gloss: a primitive root; to dig or plow:--husbandman.

H3011.gloss: feminine from «01361»; hillock; Jogbehah, a place East of the Jordan:--Jogbehah.
H3011.outline:
Jogbehah = "lofty"
- one of the cities east of the Jordan which was built and fortified by the tribe of Gad

H3012.gloss: from «01431» and «03050»; magnified of Jah; Jigdaljah, an Israelite:--Igdaliah.
H3012.outline:
Igdaliah = "Jehovah is great"
- a prophet or holy man and father of Hanan in the time of Josiah

H3013.gloss: a primitive root; to grieve:--afflict, cause grief, grieve, sorrowful, vex.
H3013.outline:
- to afflict, grieve, suffer, cause grief
- (Niphal) grieved, grieving (participle)
- (Piel) to grieve
- (Hiphil) to cause grief, cause sorrow

H3014.gloss: a primitive root (probably rather the same as «03013» through the common idea of dissatisfaction); to push away; -be removed.
H3014.outline: - (Hiphil) to repel, thrust away, push away

H3017.gloss: probably from «01481»; a lodging; Jagur, a place in Palestine:--Jagur.
H3017.outline:
Jagur = "he sojourns"
- a town of Judah, one of those farthest to the south, on the frontier of Edom

H3018.gloss: from «03021»; toil; hence, a work, produce, property (as the result of labor):--labour, work.
H3018.outline:
- toil, work
- product, produce, acquired property (as a result of work)

H3020.outline:
Jogli = "he is exiled"
- a Danite and father of Bukki who was one of the 12 rulers charged with the conquest of Canaan

H3021.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to gasp; hence, to be exhausted, to tire, to toil:--faint, (make to) labour, (be) weary.
H3021.outline:
- to toil, labour, grow weary, be weary
- (Qal)
- to toil, labour
- to grow weary, be weary
- (Piel) to weary, make weary, cause to go toilsomely
- (Hiphil) to make to toil, make weary, cause to be weary

H3022.gloss: from «03021»; earnings (as the product of toil); -that which he laboured for.

H3023.gloss: from «03021»; tired; hence (transitive) tiresome:--full of labour, weary.

H3025.gloss: a primitive root; to fear:--be afraid, fear.

H3026.gloss: (Aramaic) from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to gather) and a derivation of a root corresponding to «07717»; heap of the testimony; Jegar-Sahadutha, a cairn East of the Jordan:--Jegar-Sahadutha.
H3026.outline:
Jegar-sahadutha = "witness heap"
- the mound of stones raised as witness between Jacob and Laban, called by Jacob in Hebrew 'Galeed'

H3027.gloss: a primitive word; a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.), in distinction from «03709», the closed one); used (as noun, adverb, etc.) in a great variety of applications, both literally and figuratively, both proximate and remote (as follows):--(+ be) able, × about, + armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, × bounty, + broad, (broken-)handed, × by, charge, coast, + consecrate, + creditor, custody, debt, dominion, × enough, + fellowship, force, × from,  hand(-staves, -y work), × he, himself, × in, labour, + large, ledge, (left-)handed, means, × mine, ministry, near, × of, × order, ordinance, × our, parts, pain, power, × presumptuously, service, side, sore, state, stay, draw with strength, stroke, + swear, terror, × thee, × by them, × themselves, × thine own, × thou, through, × throwing, + thumb, times, × to, × under, × us, × wait on, (way-)side, where, + wide, × with (him, me, you), work, + yield, ×  yourselves.
H3027.outline:
- hand
- hand (of man)
- strength, power (fig.)
- side (of land), part, portion (metaph.) (fig.)
- (various special, technical senses)
- sign, monument
- part, fractional part, share
- time, repetition
- axle-trees, axle
- stays, support (for laver)
- tenons (in tabernacle)
- a phallus, a hand (meaning unsure)
- wrists

H3030.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Jidalah, a place in Palestine:--Idalah.
H3030.outline:
Idalah = "memorial of God"
- a town in Zebulun between Shimron and Bethlehem, site unknown

H3031.gloss: from the same as «01706»; perhaps honeyed; Jidbash, an Israelite:--Idbash.
H3031.outline:
Idbash = "stout"
- one of the 3 sons of Abi-etam, a descendant of Judah

H3032.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to handle (compare «03034»), i.e. to throw, e.g. lots:--cast.
H3032.outline:
v
- (Qal) to throw lots, cast lots n
- love, loving-one, friend

H3033.gloss: from «03039»; properly, affection; concretely, a darling object:--dearly beloved.
H3033.outline: - one dearly loved, beloved one, object of love

H3034.gloss: a primitive root; used only as denominative from «03027»; literally, to use (i.e. hold out) the hand; physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands):--cast (out), (make) confess(-ion), praise, shoot, (give) thank(-ful, -s, -sgiving).
H3034.outline:
- to throw, shoot, cast
- (Qal) to shoot (arrows)
- (Piel) to cast, cast down, throw down
- (Hiphil)
- to give thanks,, laud, praise
- to confess, confess (the name of God)
- (Hithpael)
- to confess (sin)
- to give thanks

H3035.outline:
Iddo = "timely" or "lovely"
- son of Zechariah, ruler of the tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan in the time of David
- a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H3036.outline:
Jadon = "thankful"
- a Meronothite and one of the builders of the walls of Jerusalem

H3037.gloss: from «03045»; knowing; Jaddua, the name of two Israelites:--Jaddua.
H3037.outline:
Jaddua = "knowing"
- one of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
- son and successor in the high priesthood of Jonathan, Jeshua, or Johanan; the last of the high priests mentioned in the OT, probably living in the time of Alexander the Great

H3038.gloss: or Yduthuwn {yed-oo-thoon'}; or Ydiythuwn {yed-ee-thoon'}; probably from «03034»; laudatory; Jeduthun, an Israelite:--Jeduthun.
H3038.outline:
Jeduthun = "praising"
- a Levite of the family of Merari and the chief of one of the 3 choirs of the temple whose descendants also formed one of the perpetual temple choirs; he is named at the beginning of 3 Psalms (39, 62,
- either as the composer or the recipient of those Psalms but most likely as the leader of the choir by which those Psalms were to be sung

H3039.gloss: from the same as «01730»; loved:--amiable,  (well-)beloved, loves.
H3039.outline:
n m
- one beloved, beloved adj
- lovely

H3040.gloss: feminine of «03039»; beloved; Jedidah, an Israelitess:--Jedidah.
H3040.outline:
Jedidah = "beloved"
- the wife of king Amon and mother of king Josiah

H3041.gloss: from «03039» and «03050»; beloved of Jah; Jedidejah, a name of Solomon:--Jedidiah.
H3041.outline:
Jedidiah = "beloved of Jehovah"
- the name given to Solomon through Nathan the prophet

H3042.gloss: from «03034» and «03050»; praised of Jah; Jedajah, the name of two Israelites:--Jedaiah.
H3042.outline:
Jedaiah = "praised of Jehovah"
- a Simeonite, forefather of Ziza
- son of Harumaph and one who took part in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem

H3043.gloss: from «03045» and «0410»; knowing God; Jediael, the name of three Israelites:--Jediael.
H3043.outline:
Jediael = "God makes known"
- a chief patriarch of the tribe of Benjamin; maybe the same as 'Ashbel'
- the 2nd son of Meshelemiah and a Korahite gatekeeper
- son of Shimri and one of David's mighty warriors
- one of the chiefs of the thousands of Manasseh who joined David on his march to Ziklag; maybe the same man as 3 above

H3045.gloss: a primitive root; to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.) (as follow):--acknowledge, acquaintance(-ted with), advise, answer, appoint, assuredly, be aware, (un-)awares, can(-not), certainly, comprehend, consider, ×  could they, cunning, declare, be diligent, (can, cause to) discern, discover, endued with, familiar friend, famous, feel, can have, be (ig-)norant, instruct, kinsfolk, kinsman, (cause to let, make) know, (come to give, have, take) knowledge, have (knowledge), (be, make, make to be, make self) known, + be learned, + lie by man, mark, perceive, privy to, ×  prognosticator, regard, have respect, skilful, shew, can (man of) skill, be sure, of a surety, teach, (can) tell, understand, have (understanding), × will be, wist, wit, wot.
H3045.outline:
- to know
- (Qal)
- to know 1a
- to know, learn to know 1a
- to perceive 1a
- to perceive and see, find out and discern 1a
- to discriminate, distinguish 1a
- to know by experience 1a
- to recognise, admit, acknowledge, confess 1a
- to consider
- to know, be acquainted with
- to know (a person carnally)
- to know how, be skilful in
- to have knowledge, be wise
- (Niphal)
- to be made known, be or become known, be revealed
- to make oneself known
- to be perceived
- to be instructed
- (Piel) to cause to know
- (Poal) to cause to know
- (Pual)
- to be known
- known, one known, acquaintance (participle)
- (Hiphil) to make known, declare
- (Hophal) to be made known
- (Hithpael) to make oneself known, reveal oneself

H3046.gloss: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03045»:--certify, know, make known, teach.
H3046.outline:
- to know
- (P'al) to know
- (Aphel) to let someone know, communicate, inform, cause to know

H3047.outline:
Jada = "He knows"
- a Judahite, son of Onam and brother of Shammai, in the genealogy of the sons of Jerahmeel by his wife Atarah

H3048.gloss: from «03045» and «03050»; Jah has known; Jedajah, the name of two Israelites:--Jedaiah.
H3048.outline:
Jedaiah = "Jehovah has known"
- a priest in Jerusalem
- a man who returned with Zerubbabel
- a ruler of the priests in the days of Jeshua
- a post exilic priest
- one honoured by Jehovah, perhaps one of the above

H3049.gloss: from «03045»; properly, a knowing one; specifically, a conjurer; (by impl) a ghost:--wizard.
H3049.outline:
- a knower, one who has a familiar spirit
- a familiar spirit, soothsayer, necromancer (meton)

H3050.gloss: contraction for «03068», and meaning the same; Jah, the sacred name:--Jah, the Lord, most vehement. Compare names in "-iah," "- jah."
H3050.outline:
- Jah (Jehovah in the shortened form)
- the proper name of the one true God
- used in many compounds
- names beginning with the letters 'Je'
- names ending with 'iah' or 'jah'

H3051.gloss: a primitive root; to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come:--ascribe, bring, come on, give, go, set, take.
H3051.outline:
- to give, provide, ascribe, come
- (Qal)
- to give
- to set, place
- to provide (with reflexive)
- to ascribe (glory)
- to grant, permit, come now

H3052.gloss: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03051»; -deliver, give, lay, + prolong, pay, yield.
H3052.outline:
- to give, provide
- (P'al)
- to give
- to place, lay (foundations)
- (Hithp'al)
- to be given
- to be paid

H3053.gloss: from «03051»; properly, what is given (by Providence), i.e. a lot:--burden.

H3054.gloss: denominative from a form corresponding to «03061»; to Judaize, i.e. become Jewish:--become Jews.
H3054.outline: - (Hithpael) to become a Jew (in fact or in fraud), become Judaised

H3055.gloss: a briefer form of one corresponding to «03061»; Jehud, a place in Palestine:--Jehud.
H3055.outline:
Jehud = "beauty"
- a town in Dan, located between Baalath and Bene-berak and 8 miles east of Joppa

H3056.gloss: perhaps from a form corresponding to «03061»; Judaistic; Jehdai, an Israelite:--Jehdai.
H3056.outline:
Jahdai "whom he will place"
- one of the family of Caleb

H3057.outline:
adj f
- the Jewess or n pr f (CLBL) Jehudijah = "Jewess"
- a Calebite, the wife of one named Ezra

H3058.gloss: from «03068» and «01931»; Jehovah (is) He; Jehu, the name of five Israelites:--Jehu.
H3058.outline:
Jehu = "Jehovah is He"
- the king of the northern kingdom Israel who overthrew the dynasty of Omri
- son of Hanani and an Israelite prophet in the time of Baasha and Jehoshaphat
- the Antothite, a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors
- a descendant of Judah of the house of Hezron
- son of Josibiah and a chief of the tribe of Simeon

H3059.gloss: from «03068» and «0270»; Jehovah-seized; Jehoachaz, the name of three Israelites:--Jehoahaz. Compare «03099».
H3059.outline:
Jehoahaz = "Jehovah has seized"
- a king of Judah and son of Josiah
- a king of the northern kingdom of Israel and son of Jehu
- a king of Judah and son of Jehoram (Ahaziah)

H3060.gloss: from «03068» and (perhaps) «0784»; Jehovah-fired; Jehoash, the name of two Israelite kings:--Jehoash. Compare «03101».
H3060.outline:
Jehoash = "given by the Lord"
- son of king Ahaziah and the 8th king of Judah
- son of king Jehoahaz and the 12th king of the northern kingdom of Israel

H3061.gloss: (Aramaic) contracted from a form corresponding to «03063»; properly, Judah, hence, Judaea:--Jewry, Judah, Judea.
H3061.outline: - Judah - the territory of the tribe of Judah

H3062.gloss: (Aramaic) patrial from «03061»; a Jehudaite (or Judaite), i.e. Jew:--Jew.

H3063.gloss: from «03034»; celebrated; Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory:--Judah.
H3063.outline:
Judah = "praised"
- the son of Jacob by Leah
- the tribe descended from Judah the son of Jacob
- the territory occupied by the tribe of Judah
- the kingdom comprised of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin which occupied the southern part of Canaan after the nation split upon the death of Solomon
- a Levite in Ezra's time
- an overseer of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
- a Levite musician in the time of Nehemiah
- a priest in the time of Nehemiah

H3064.gloss: patronymically from «03063»; a Jehudite (i.e. Judaite or Jew), or descendant of Jehudah (i.e. Judah):--Jew.

H3065.gloss: the same as «03064»; Jehudi, an Israelite:--Jehudi.
H3065.outline:
Jehudi = "Jew"
- son of Nethaniah and servant of king Jehoiakim

H3066.gloss: feminine of «03064»; the Jewish (used adverbially) language:--in the Jews' language.
H3066.outline: - in the Jewish language, in Hebrew

H3067.gloss: the same as «03066»; Jewess; Jehudith, a Canaanitess:--Judith.
H3067.outline:
Judith = "Jewess" or "praised"
- the daughter of Beeri the Hittite and wife of Esau

H3068.gloss: from «01961»; (the) self-Existent or Eternal; Jehovah, Jewish national name of God:--Jehovah, the Lord. Compare «03050», «03069».
H3068.outline:
Jehovah = "the existing One"
- the proper name of the one true God
- unpronounced except with the vowel pointings of 0136

H3069.gloss: a variation of «03068» (used after «0136», and pronounced by Jews as «0430», in order to prevent the repetition of the same sound, since they elsewhere pronounce «03068» as «0136»):--God.
H3069.outline:
- Jehovah - used primarily in the combination 'Lord Jehovah'
- equal to 03068 but pointed with the vowels of 0430

H3070.gloss: from «03068» and «07200»; Jehovah will see (to it); Jehovah-Jireh, a symbolical name for Mount Moriah:--Jehovah- jireh.
H3070.outline:
Jehovah-jireh = "Jehovah sees"
- symbolic name given by Abraham to Mount Moriah in commemoration of the interposition of the angel of Jehovah who prevented the sacrifice of Isaac and provided a substitute

H3071.gloss: from «03068» and «05251» with the prononimal suffix; Jehovah (is) my banner; Jehovah-Nissi, a symbolical name of an altar in the Desert:--Jehovah-nissi.
H3071.outline:
Jehovah-nissi = "Jehovah is my banner"
- the name given by Moses to the altar which he built in commemoration of the discomfiture of the Amalekites

H3072.gloss: from «03068» and «06664» with pronominal suffix; Jehovah (is) our right; Jehovah-Tsidkenu, a symbolical epithet of the Messiah and of Jerusalem:--the Lord our righteousness.
H3072.outline:
Jehovah is our righteousness
- a sacred name symbolically applied to Jerusalem and the Messiah

H3073.gloss: from «03068» and «07965»; Jehovah (is) peace; Jehovah-Shalom, a symbolical name of an altar in Palestine:  -Jehovah-shalom.
H3073.outline:
Jehovah-shalom = "Jehovah is peace"
- the name of a sacred altar built by Gideon in Ophrah

H3074.gloss: from «03068» and «08033» with directive enclitic; Jehovah (is) thither; Jehovah-Shammah, a symbolic title of Jerusalem:--Jehovah-shammah.
H3074.outline:
Jehovah-shammah = "Jehovah is there"
- a symbolic name for Jerusalem

H3075.gloss: from «03068» and «02064»; Jehovah-endowed; Jehozabad, the name of three Israelites:--Jehozabad. Compare «03107».
H3075.outline:
Jehozabad = "Jehovah has endowed"
- son of Shomer, a Moabitish woman, who murdered Joash, king of Judah
- a Benjamite, captain of 180,000 armed men, in the days of Jehoshaphat
- a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David

H3076.gloss: from «03068» and «02603»; Jehovah-favored; Jehochanan, the name of eight Israelites:--Jehohanan, Johanan. Compare «03110».
H3076.outline:
Jehohanan = "Jehovah has graced"
- a Korhite Levite and one of the doorkeepers to the tabernacle in the time of David
- a captain of Judah under king Jehoshaphat

H3077.gloss: from «03068» and «03045»; Jehovah-known; Jehojada, the name of three Israelites:--Jehoiada. Compare «03111».
H3077.outline:
Jehoiada = "Jehovah knows"
- father of Benaiah, David's mighty warrior
- leader of the priests who joined David at Hebron
- high priest at the time of Athaliah's usurpation of the throne of Judah; hid Joash, the king's son, for six years and eventually replaced him on the throne of Judah
- second priest, or sagan, to Seraiah the high priest

H3078.gloss: from «03068» and «03559»; Jehovah will establish; Jehojakin, a Jewish king:--Jehoiachin. Compare «03112».
H3078.outline:
Jehoiachin = "Jehovah establishes"
- king of Judah, son of Jehoiakim, and the next to last king of Judah before the Babylonian captivity; kingship lasted for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar who took him to Babylon and imprisoned him for 36 years when he was finally released

H3079.gloss: from «03068» abbreviated and «06965»; Jehovah will raise; Jehojakim, a Jewish king:--Jehoiakim. Compare «03113».
H3079.outline:
Jehoiakim = "Jehovah raises up"
- son of Josiah and the third from the last king of Judah; subject vassel of Nebuchadnezzar who reigned for 11 years before he died a violent death either in combat or by the hands of his own subjects

H3080.gloss: from «03068» and «07378»; Jehovah will contend; Jehojarib, the name of two Israelites:--Jehoiarib. Compare «03114».
H3080.outline:
Jehoiarib = "Jehovah contends"
- A priest in Jerusalem
- the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in David's time

H3081.gloss: from «03201»; potent; Jehukal, an Israelite:  -Jehucal. Compare «03116».
H3081.outline:
Jehucal = "Jehovah is able"
- a son of Shelemiah and a servant of king Zedekiah whom he sent to Jeremiah to entreat his prayers and advice

H3082.gloss: from «03068» and «05068»; Jehovah-largessed; Jehonadab, the name of an Israelite and of an Arab:--Jehonadab, Jonadab. Compare «03122».
H3082.outline:
Jehonadab = "Jehovah is willing"
- a son of Rechab, chief of the Rechabites, in the time of Jehu and Ahab
- a nephew of David

H3083.gloss: from «03068» and «05414»; Jehovah-given; Jehonathan, the name of four Israelites:--Jonathan. Compare «03129».
H3083.outline:
Jonathan or Jehonathan = "Jehovah has given"
- a son of king Saul and a friend of David
- a son of the high priest Abiathar and the last descendant of Eli of whom we hear
- a nephew of David who like David slew a giant of Gath
- an uncle of David
- one of David's mighty warriors
- one of David's treasurers
- a scribe in the time of Jeremiah
- a Levite and father of Zechariah, a priest who blew the trumpet at the dedication of the wall
- a son or descendant of Gershom, the son of Moses, and a priest to the tribe of Dan
- a son of Kareah and a brother of Johanan; a Judaite captain after the fall of Jerusalem
- another Judaite father of Peleth
- father of Ebed in the time of Ezra
- son of Asahel in the time of Ezra
- a priest of the family of Melicu in the time of Nehemiah
- son of Joiada and his successor to the high priesthood in the time of Nehemiah

H3084.gloss: a fuller form of «03130»; Jehoseph (i.e. Joseph), a son of Jacob:--Joseph.
H3084.outline:
Joseph = "Jehovah has added"
- the eldest son of Jacob by Rachel

H3085.gloss: from «03068» and «05710»; Jehovah-adorned; Jehoaddah, an Israelite:--Jehoada.
H3085.outline:
Jehoadah = "Jehovah has adorned"
- a descendant of Saul through Jonathan

H3086.gloss: or Yhowaddan {yeh-ho-ad-dawn'}; from «03068» and «05727»; Jehovah-pleased; Jehoaddin or Jehoaddan, an Israelitess:--Jehoaddan.
H3086.outline:
Jehoaddan = "Jehovah delights"
- wife of king Joash and mother of king Amaziah of Judah

H3087.gloss: from «03068» and «06663»; Jehovah-righted; Jehotsadak, an Israelite:--Jehozadek, Josedech. Compare «03136».
H3087.outline:
Jehozadak or Josedech = "Jehovah is righteous"
- grandson of the high priest Hilkiah; son of the high priest Seraiah; and father of the high priest Joshua; he never attained the office of high priest himself because he was carried captive to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar

H3088.gloss: from «03068» and «07311»; Jehovah-raised; Jehoram, the name of a Syrian and of three Israelites:--Jehoram, Joram. Compare «03141».
H3088.outline:
Jehoram or Joram = "Jehovah is exalted"
- son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and himself king of Judah for 8 years; his wife was the wicked Athaliah who was probably the instigator for his returning the nation of Judah to the worship of Baal
- son of king Ahab of the northern kingdom of Israel and king of Israel himself for 12 years; he was murdered by Jehu on the plot of land for which his father had murdered Naboth thus fulfilling the prophecy of Elijah to the very letter
- a priest in the reign of Jehoshaphat

H3089.gloss: from «03068» and «07650»; Jehovah-sworn; Jehosheba, an Israelitess:--Jehosheba. Compare «03090».
H3089.outline:
Jehosheba = "Jehovah has sworn"
- daughter of king Joram of Judah and wife of the high priest Jehoiada
- alternate spelling 'Jehoshabeath' - 03090

H3090.gloss: a form of «03089»; Jehoshabath, an Israelitess:--Jehoshabeath.
H3090.outline:
Jehoshabeath = "Jehovah is an oath"
- daughter of king Joram of Judah and wife of the high priest Jehoiada
- alternate spelling 'Jehosheba - 03089

H3091.gloss: or Yhowshua {yeh-ho-shoo'-ah}; from «03068» and «03467»; Jehovah-saved; Jehoshua (i.e. Joshua), the Jewish leader:--Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare «01954», «03442».
H3091.outline:
Joshua or Jehoshua = "Jehovah is salvation" n pr m
- son of Nun of the tribe of Ephraim and successor to Moses as the leader of the children of Israel; led the conquest of Canaan
- a resident of Beth-shemesh on whose land the Ark of the Covenant came to a stop after the Philistines returned it
- son of Jehozadak and high priest after the restoration
- governor of Jerusalem under king Josiah who gave his name to a gate of the city of Jerusalem

H3092.gloss: from «03068» and «08199»; Jehovah-judged; Jehoshaphat, the name of six Israelites; also of a valley near Jerusalem:--Jehoshaphat. Compare «03146».
H3092.outline:
Jehoshaphat = "Jehovah has judged" n pr m
- son of king Asa and himself king of Judah for 25 years; one of the best, most pious, and prosperous kings of Judah
- son of Nimshi and father of king Jehu of the northern kingdom of Israel
- son of Ahilud and chronicler under David and Solomon
- son of Paruah and one of the 12 commissary officers under Solomon
- a priest and trumpeter in the time of David n pr loc
- symbolical name of a valley near Jerusalem which is the place of ultimate judgment; maybe the deep ravine which separates Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives through which the Kidron flowed

H3093.gloss: probably from the same as «02022»; elated; hence, arrogant:--haughty, proud.

H3094.gloss: from «01984» and «0410»; praising God; Jehallelel, the name of two Israelites:--Jehalellel, Jehalelel.
H3094.outline:
Jehaleleel or Jehalelel = "God is praised"
- a Calebite descendant of Judah
- father of Azariah and a Merarite Levite in the time of Hezekiah

H3095.gloss: from «01986» (in the sense of hardness); a precious stone, probably onyx:--diamond.
H3095.outline:
- a precious stone (known for its hardness)
- perhaps the jasper, onyx, or diamond

H3096.gloss: or Yahtsah {yah'-tsaw}; or (feminine) Yahtsah  {yah-tsaw'}; from an unused root meaning to stamp; perhaps threshing-floor; Jahats or Jahtsah, a place East of the Jordan:--Jahaz, Jahazah, Jahzah.
H3096.outline:
Jahaz or Jahazah or Jahzah = "trodden down"
- a place in Reuben east of the Dead Sea where Israel defeated Sihon king of the Amorites; site uncertain

H3097.gloss: from «03068» and «01»; Jehovah-fathered; Joab, the name of three Israelites:--Joab.
H3097.outline:
Joab = "Jehovah is father"
- son of David's sister Zeruiah and general of David's army
- a Judaite descendant of Kenaz
- a post exilic family

H3098.gloss: from «03068» and «0251»; Jehovah-brothered; Joach, the name of four Israelites:--Joah.
H3098.outline:
Joah = "Jehovah is brother"
- son of Asaph and chronicler to Hezekiah
- a Gershonite son or grandson of Zimmah
- a Korhite, 3rd son of Obed-edom and doorkeeper in the time of David
- son of Joahaz and chronicler to king Josiah

H3099.gloss: a form of «03059»; Joachaz, the name of two Israelites:--Jehoahaz, Joahaz.
H3099.outline:
Joahaz or Jehoahaz = "Jehovah has grasped"
- the father of Joah, Josiah's chronicler

H3100.gloss: from «03068» and «0410»; Jehovah (is his) God; Joel, the name of twelve Israelites:--Joel.
H3100.outline:
Joel = "Jehovah is God"
- son of Pethuel and the 2nd of the 12 minor prophets with a book by his name; probably prophesied in the time of king Uzziah of Judah
- eldest son of Samuel the prophet and father of Heman the singer
- a Simeonite chief
- a Reubenite
- a chief of Gad
- son of Izrahiah and a chief of Issachar
- brother of Nathan of Zobah and one of David's mighty warriors
- son of Pedaiah and a chief of the half tribe of Manasseh west of the Jordan in the time of David
- a son of Nebo who returned with Ezra and had a foreign wife
- a Benjamite, son of Zichri
- a Levite
- a Kohathite Levite in the reign of Hezekiah
- a Gershonite Levite chief in the time of David
- a Gershonite Levite, son of Jehiel and a descendant of Laadan; maybe same as 13

H3101.gloss: or Yoash (2 Chron. 24:1) {yo-awsh'}; a form of «03060»; Joash, the name of six Israelites:--Joash.
H3101.outline:
Joash = "given by the Lord"
- son of king Ahaziah and the 8th king of Judah
- son of king Jehoahaz and the 12th king of the northern kingdom of Israel
- father of Gideon
- a son of king Ahab
- a descendant of Shelah the son of Judah; either the son of Shelah or the son of Jokim
- son of Shemaah of Gibeah who resorted to David at Ziklag

H3102.gloss: perhaps a form of «03103», but more probably by erroneous transcription for «03437»; Job, an Israelite:--Job.
H3102.outline:
Job = "persecuted"
- the 3rd son of Issachar also called 'Jashub'

H3103.gloss: from «02980»; howler; Jobab, the name of two Israelites and of three foreigners:--Jobab.
H3103.outline:
Jobab = "a desert"
- the last in order of the sons of Joktan, a descendant of Shem
- one of the kings of Edom
- the king of Madon, located in northern Canaan, and one of the kings who opposed Joshua during the conquest and who were routed at Meron
- head of a Benjamite house
- another Benjamite

H3104.gloss: or yobel {yob-ale'}; apparently from «02986»; the blast of a horn (from its continuous sound); specifically, the signal of the silver trumpets; hence, the instrument itself and the festival thus introduced:--jubile, ram's horn, trumpet.
H3104.outline:
- ram, ram's horn, trumpet, cornet
- ram (only in combination)
- ram's horn, trumpet
- jubilee year (marked by the blowing of cornets) (meton)

H3106.outline:
Jubal = "stream"
- the son of Lamech by Adah and the inventor of musical instruments

H3107.gloss: a form of «03075»; Jozabad, the name of ten Israelites:--Josabad, Jozabad.
H3107.outline:
Jozabad or Josabad = "Jehovah has endowed"
- a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David
- one of David's mighty warriors
- another of David's mighty warriors
- four other priests or Levites

H3108.gloss: from «03068» and «02142»; Jehovah-remembered; Jozacar, an Israelite:--Jozachar.
H3108.outline:
Jozachar = "Jehovah remembers"
- a servant of king Joash of Judah and one of his murderers
- also called 'Zabad'

H3109.gloss: probably from «03068» and a variation of «02421»; Jehovah-revived; Jocha, the name of two Israelites:--Joha.
H3109.outline:
Joha = "Jehovah gives life"
- one of the sons of Beriah the Benjamite
- the Tizite, one of David's mighty warriors

H3110.gloss: a form of «03076»; Jochanan, the name of nine Israelites:--Johanan.
H3110.outline:
Johanan = "Jehovah has graced"
- a priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim who returned with Zerubbabel
- a Jewish captain after the fall of Jerusalem
- the eldest son of king Josiah
- a post-exilic prince of the line of David
- father of Azariah, priest in Solomon's time
- a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors
- a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors
- a returning exile

H3111.gloss: a form of «03077»; Jojada, the name of two Israelites:--Jehoiada, Joiada.
H3111.outline:
Joiada or Jehoiada = "Jehovah knows"
- son of Paseah, who assisted to repair the old gate of Jerusalem
- son of the high priest Eliashib in the time of Nehemiah

H3112.gloss: a form of «03078»; Jojakin, an Israelite king:--Jehoiachin.
H3112.outline:
Jehoiachin = "Jehovah establishes"
- king of Judah, son of Jehoiakim, and the next to last king of Judah before the Babylonian captivity; kingship lasted for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar who took him to Babylon and imprisoned him for 36 years when he was finally released

H3113.gloss: a form of «03079»; Jojakim, an Israelite:--Joiakim. Compare «03137».
H3113.outline:
Joiakim or Jehoiakim = "Jehovah raises up"
- a priest and son of Jeshua the high priest

H3114.gloss: a form of «03080»; Jojarib, the name of four Israelites:--Joiarib.
H3114.outline:
Joiarib = "Jehovah contends"
- the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in David's time
- a teacher in the time of Ezra
- a Judaite in the time of Nehemiah

H3115.gloss: from «03068» contracted and «03513»; Jehovah-gloried; Jokebed, the mother of Moses:--Jochebed.
H3115.outline:
Jochebed = "Jehovah is glory"
- the daughter of Levi, wife and at the same time aunt of Amram, and the mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam

H3116.gloss: a form of «03081»; Jukal, an Israelite:--Jucal.
H3116.outline:
Jucal = "Jehovah is able"
- a son of Shelemiah and a servant of king Zedekiah whom he sent to Jeremiah to entreat his prayers and advice

H3117.gloss: from an unused root meaning to be hot; a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb):--age, + always, + chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), + elder, × end, + evening, + (for) ever(-lasting, -more), × full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, + old, + outlived, + perpetually, presently, + remaineth, × required, season, × since, space, then, (process of) time, + as at other times, + in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), × whole (+ age), (full) year(-ly), + younger.
H3117.outline:
- day, time, year
- day (as opposed to night)
- day (24 hour period)
- as defined by evening and morning in Genesis 1
- as a division of time 1b
- a working day, a day's journey
- days, lifetime (pl.)
- time, period (general)
- year
- temporal references
- today
- yesterday
- tomorrow

H3118.gloss: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03117»; a day:--day (by day), time.
H3118.outline:
- day
- day always refers to a twenty-four hour period when the word is modified by a definite or cardinal number

H3119.outline:
adv
- by day, in the daytime subst
- daytime

H3120.gloss: probably from the same as «03196»; effervescing (i.e. hot and active); Javan, the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, i.e. Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia:--Javan.
H3120.outline:
Javan = "Ionia" or "Greece" n pr m
- a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah n pr loc
- Greece, Ionia, Ionians
- location of descendants of Javan

H3121.gloss: from the same as «03196»; properly, dregs (as effervescing); hence, mud:--mire, miry.

H3122.gloss: a form of «03082»; Jonadab, the name of an Israelite and of a Rechabite:--Jonadab.
H3122.outline:
Jonadab or Jehonadab = "Jehovah is willing"
- a son of Rechab, chief of the Rechabites, in the time of Jehu and Ahab
- a nephew of David

H3123.gloss: probably from the same as «03196»; a dove (apparently from the warmth of their mating):--dove, pigeon.

H3124.gloss: the same as «03123»; Jonah, an Israelite:--Jonah.
H3124.outline:
Jonah = "dove"
- son of Amittai and a native of Gath-hepher; 5th of the minor prophets who prophesied during the reign of Jeroboam II and whom God sent also to prophecy to Nineveh

H3125.gloss: patronymically from «03121»; a Jevanite, or descendant of Javan:--Grecian.

H3126.gloss: active participle of «03243»; a sucker; hence, a twig (of a tree felled and sprouting):--tender plant.

H3127.gloss: feminine of «03126»; a sprout:--(tender) branch, young twig.

H3128.gloss: from «03123» and «0482» and the plural of «07350»; dove of (the) silence (i.e. dumb Israel) of (i.e. among) distances (i.e. strangers); the title of a ditty (used for a name of its melody):--Jonath-elem-rechokim.
H3128.outline:
Jonath-elem-recho-kim = "the silent dove of far-off places"
- meaning uncertain
- probably name of melody
- only used in title of PS 56

H3129.gloss: a form of «03083»; Jonathan, the name of ten Israelites:--Jonathan.
H3129.outline:
Jonathan or Jehonathan = "Jehovah has given"
- a son of king Saul and a friend of David
- a son of the high priest Abiathar and the last descendant of Eli of whom we hear
- one of David's mighty warriors
- a Levite and father of Zechariah, a priest who blew the trumpet at the dedication of the wall
- a son of Kareah and a brother of Johanan; a Judaite captain after the fall of Jerusalem
- another Judaite
- father of Ebed in the time of Ezra
- son of Asahel in the time of Ezra
- a priest of the family of Melicu in the time of Nehemiah
- son of Joiada and his successor to the high priesthood in the time of Nehemiah

H3130.gloss: future of «03254»; let him add (or perhaps simply active participle adding); Joseph, the name of seven Israelites:--Joseph. Compare «03084».
H3130.outline:
Joseph = "Jehovah has added"
- the eldest son of Jacob by Rachel
- father of Igal, who represented the tribe of Issachar among the spies
- a son of Asaph
- a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
- a priest of the family of Shebaniah in the time of Nehemiah

H3131.gloss: from active participle of «03254» and «03050»; Jah (is) adding; Josiphjah, an Israelite:--Josiphiah.
H3131.outline:
Josiphiah = "Jehovah adds"
- father or ancestor of Shelomith who returned with Ezra

H3132.gloss: perhaps feminine active participle of «03276»; furthermore; Joelah, an Israelite:--Joelah.
H3132.outline:
Joelah = "may he avail"
- son of Jeroham of Gedor and one of David's mighty warriors

H3133.gloss: apparently the active participle of «03259»; appointer; Joed, an Israelite:--Joed.
H3133.outline:
Joed = "Jehovah is witness"
- a Benjamite, son of Pedaiah

H3134.gloss: from «03068» and «05828»; Jehovah (is his) help; Joezer, an Israelite:--Joezer.
H3134.outline:
Joezer = "Jehovah is help"
- a Korhite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag

H3135.gloss: from «03068» and «05789»; Jehovah-hastened; Joash, the name of two Israelites:--Joash.
H3135.outline:
Joash = "Jehovah hastens"
- a Benjamite, son of Becher
- one of the officers in David's court

H3136.gloss: a form of «03087»; Jotsadak, an Israelite:--Jozadak.
H3136.outline:
Jozadak = "Jehovah is righteous"
- grandson of the high priest Hilkiah; son of the high priest Seraiah; and father of the high priest Joshua; he never attained the office of high priest himself because he was carried captive to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar

H3137.gloss: a form of «03113»; Jokim, an Israelite:--Jokim.
H3137.outline:
Jokim = "Jehovah raises up"
- a descendant of Judah

H3138.gloss: active participle of «03384»; sprinkling; hence, a sprinkling (or autumnal showers):--first rain, former (rain).
H3138.outline:
- early rain, autumn shower
- rain which falls in Palestine from late October until early December

H3139.outline:
Jorah = "he instructs"
- the head or ancestor of a family who returned from Babylon with Ezra

H3140.outline:
Jorai = "Jehovah has taught me"
- one of the Gadites dwelling at Gilead in Bashan in the reign of king Jotham of Judah

H3141.gloss: a form of «03088»; Joram, the name of three Israelites and one Syrian:--Joram.
H3141.outline:
Joram = "Jehovah is exalted"
- son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and himself king of Judah for 8 years; his wife was the wicked Athaliah who was probably the instigator for his returning the nation of Judah to the worship of Baal
- son of king Ahab of the northern kingdom of Israel and king of Israel himself for 12 years; he was murdered by Jehu on the plot of land for which his father had murdered Naboth thus fulfilling the prophecy of Elijah to the very letter
- a Levite in the time of David and an ancestor of Shelomith
- son of Toi, king of Hamath

H3142.gloss: from «07725» and «02617»; kindness will be returned; Jushab-Chesed, an Israelite:--Jushab-hesed.
H3142.outline:
Jushab-hesed = "whose love is returned"
- son of Zerubbabel

H3143.gloss: from «03427» and «03050»; Jehovah will cause to dwell; Josibjah, an Israelite:--Josibiah.

H3144.gloss: probably a form of «03145»; Joshah, an Israelite:--Joshah.
H3144.outline:

H3145.gloss: from «03068» and «07737»; Jehovah-set; Joshavjah, an Israelite:--Joshaviah. Compare «03144».
H3145.outline:
Joshaviah = "Jehovah makes equal"

H3146.gloss: a form of «03092»; Joshaphat, an Israelite:--Joshaphat.
H3146.outline:
Joshaphat or Jehoshaphat = "Jehovah judges" n pr m

- a priest and trumpeter in the time of David

H3147.gloss: from «03068» and «08535»; Jehovah (is) perfect; Jotham, the name of three Israelites:--Jotham.
H3147.outline:
Jotham = "Jehovah is perfect"

- son of Jahdai and a descendant of Caleb and Judah

H3148.gloss: active participle of «03498»; properly, redundant; hence, over and above, as adjective, noun, adverb or conjunction (as follows):--better, more(-over), over, profit.
H3148.outline:

- excess, better conj
- besides, moreover, more

H3149.gloss: from an unused root (meaning to sprinkle) and «0410»; sprinkled of God; Jezavel, an Israelite:--Jeziel (from the margin).
H3149.outline:
Jeziel = "the assembly of God"
- a Benjamite and one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag

H3150.gloss: from the same as the first part of «03149» and «03050»; sprinkled of Jah; Jizzijah, an Israelite:--Jeziah.
H3150.outline:
Jeziah = "Jehovah sprinkles"
- a descendant of Parosh who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H3151.gloss: from the same as «02123»; he will make prominent; Jaziz, an Israelite:--Jaziz.
H3151.outline:
Jaziz = "He makes prominent"
- a Hagarite, officer of David in charge of the flocks

H3152.gloss: perhaps from an unused root (meaning to draw up); he will draw out; Jizliah, an Israelite:--Jezliah.
H3152.outline:
Jezliah = "whom God will preserve"
- a Benjamite of the sons of Elpaal

H3153.gloss: or Yzanyahuw {yez-an-yaw'-hoo}; probably for «02970»; Jezanjah, an Israelite:--Jezaniah.
H3153.outline:
Jezaniah = "Jehovah has listened"
- son of Hoshaiah the Maachathite and one of the captains who escaped from Jerusalem during the last siege of the Babylonians; one of the first to return to Gedaliah at Mizpah where he took a prominent part after the assassination of Gedaliah

H3154.gloss: from an unused root mean to ooze; sweat, i.e. (by implication) a sweating dress:--any thing that causeth sweat.

H3155.gloss: a variation for «0250»; a Jizrach (i.e. Ezrachite or Zarchite) or descendant of Zerach:--Izrahite.
H3155.outline:
Izrahite = "descendant of Zerah"
- a descendant of Zerah of Judah

H3156.gloss: from «02224» and «03050»; Jah will shine; Jizrachjah, the name of two Israelites:--Izrahiah, Jezrahiah.
H3156.outline:
Izrahiah or Jezrahiah = "Jehovah will shine"
- a chieftain of Issachar
- a Levite and leader of the chorus at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah

H3157.gloss: from «02232» and «0410»; God will sow; Jizreel, the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites:--Jezreel.
H3157.outline:
Jezreel = "God sows" n pr m
- a descendant of the father or founder of Etam of Judah
- first son of Hosea the prophet n pr loc

- a city in Issachar on the northwest spur of Mount Gilboa

H3158.gloss: patronymically from «03157»; a Jizreelite or native of Jizreel:--Jezreelite.
H3158.outline:
Jezreelite = see Jezreel "sown of God"
- an inhabitant of Jezreel

H3159.outline:
Jezreelitess = see Jezreel "sown of God"
- a female inhabitant of Jezreel

H3160.outline:
Jehubbah = "hidden"

H3161.gloss: a primitive root; to be (or become) one:--join, unite.
H3161.outline:

- (Piel) to unite

H3162.gloss: from «03161»; properly, a unit, i.e. (adverb) unitedly:--alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-)together, withal.

H3163.gloss: from «03162» with pronominal suffix; his unity, i.e. (adverb) together; Jachdo, an Israelite:--Jahdo.

Jahdo = "His unity"

H3164.gloss: from «03162» and «0410»; unity of God; Jachdiel, an Israelite:--Jahdiel.
H3164.outline:
Jahdiel = "my unity is God"

H3165.gloss: from «03162» and «03050»; unity of Jah; Jechdijah, the name of two Israelites:--Jehdeiah.
H3165.outline:
Jehdeiah = "Jehovah is unity"
- a Levite in the time of David
- a Meronothite, officer of David in charge of the she-asses

H3166.gloss: from «02372» and «0410»; beheld of God; Jachaziel, the name of five Israelites:--Jahaziel, Jahziel.
H3166.outline:
Jahaziel = "beheld of God"
- a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
- a priest in the reign of David who helped move the ark
- a Kohathite Levite, 3rd son of Hebron
- a Levite, son of Zechariah, of the sons of Asaph, in the reign of Jehoshaphat
- an ancestor of one of the families who returned from exile with Ezra

H3167.gloss: from «02372» and «03050»; Jah will behold; Jachzejah, an Israelite:--Jahaziah.
H3167.outline:
Jahaziah = "Jehovah views"
- son of Tikvah, apparently a priest and leader during the time of Ezra

H3168.gloss: from «02388» and «0410»; God will strengthen; Jechezkel, the name of two Israelites:--Ezekiel, Jehezekel.
H3168.outline:
Ezekiel or Jehezekel = "God strengthens"
- son of Buzi and a priest and prophet; author of the book by his name; taken captive with Jehoiachin and exiled in Babylon where he prophesied for the next 22 years
- a priest in charge of the 20th course in the time of David

H3169.gloss: or Ychizqiyahuw {yekh-iz-kee-yaw'- hoo}; from «03388» and «03050»; strengthened of Jah; Jechizkijah, the name of five Israelites:--Hezekiah, Jehizkiah. Compare «02396».
H3169.outline:
Hezekiah or Jehizkiah = "Jehovah has made strong"

- head of a family of returning exiles in the time of Nehemiah
- an Ephraimite in the time of Ahaz

H3170.gloss: from the same as «02386»; perhaps protection; Jachzerah, an Israelite:--Jahzerah.
H3170.outline:
Jahzerah = "whom God leads back"

H3171.gloss: or (2 Chron. 29:14) Ychavrel  {yekh-av-ale'}; from «02421» and «0410»; God will live; Jechiel (or Jechavel), the name of eight Israelites:--Jehiel.

Jehiel = "God lives"

H3172.gloss: patronymically from «03171»; a Jechielite or descendant of Jechiel:--Jehieli.
H3172.outline:
Jehieli = "God shall save alive" or "swept away of God"

H3173.gloss: from «03161»; properly, united, i.e. sole; by implication, beloved; also lonely; (feminine) the life (as not to be replaced):--darling, desolate, only (child, son), solitary.

adj

- solitary

H3174.outline:
Jehiah = "Jehovah lives"

H3176.gloss: a primitive root; to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope:--(cause to, have, make to) hope, be pained, stay, tarry, trust, wait.
H3176.outline:

- (Piel)
- to wait, await, tarry

H3177.gloss: from «03176» and «0410»; expectant of God; Jachleel, an Israelite:--Jahleel.
H3177.outline:
Jahleel = "God waits"

H3178.gloss: patronymically from «03177»; a Jachleelite or descendant of Jachleel:--Jahleelites.
H3178.outline:
Jahleelites = "the hope of God"
- descendants of Jahleel of the tribe of Zebulun

H3179.gloss: a primitive root; probably to be hot; figuratively, to conceive:--get heat, be hot, conceive, be warm.

H3181.gloss: probably from «03179»; hot; Jachmai, an Israelite:--Jahmai.
H3181.outline:
Jahmai = "whom Jehovah guards"

H3182.gloss: from an unused root meaning to take off the shoes; unsandalled:--barefoot, being unshod.

Jahzeel = "God divides"

H3184.gloss: patronymically from «03183»; a Jachtseelite (collectively) or descendants of Jachtseel:--Jahzeelites.
H3184.outline:
Jahzeelites = see Jahzeel "God divides"
- the descendants of Jahzeel, the 1st son of Naphtali

H3185.gloss: from «02673» and «0410»; allotted of God; Jachtsiel, an Israelite:--Jahziel. Compare «03183».
H3185.outline:
Jahziel = "God divides"
- the 1st of the 4 sons of Naphtali and founder of the family of Jahzeelites

Jotbath or Jotbathah = "pleasantness"

- to be able
- to prevail

H3203.gloss: and Ykolyahuw {yek-ol-yaw'-hoo}; or (2 Chronicles 26:3) Ykiylyah {yek-ee-leh-yaw'}; from «03201» and «03050»; Jah will enable; Jekoljah or Jekiljah, an Israelitess:--Jecholiah, Jecoliah.
H3203.outline:
Jecoliah or Jecholiah = "Jehovah is able"
- wife of king Amaziah of Judah and mother of king Uzziah (Azariah)

H3204.gloss: and Ykonyahuw {yek-on-yaw'-hoo}; or (Jereremiah 27:20) Ykownyah {yek-o-neh-yaw'}; from «03559» and «03050»; Jah will establish; Jekonjah, a Jewish king:--Jeconiah. Compare «03659».

H3218.gloss: from an unused root meaning to lick up; a devourer; specifically, the young locust:--cankerworm, caterpillar.
H3218.outline:
- young locust (early stage of development)
- caterpillar (as devouring)

H3219.gloss: from «03950»; a travelling pouch (as if for gleanings):-scrip.

H3220.gloss: from an unused root meaning to roar; a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south:--sea (X -faring man, (-shore)), south, west (-ern, side, -ward).

H3224.gloss: perhaps from the same as «03117»; properly, warm, i.e. affectionate; hence, dove (compare «03123»); Jemimah, one of Job's daughters:--Jemimah.
H3224.outline:

H3225.gloss: from «03231»; the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south:--+ left-handed, right (hand, side), south.
H3225.outline:

Jamin = "right hand"

H3230.gloss: from «04427»; he will make king; Jamlek, an Israelite:--Jamlech.
H3230.outline:

n pr m Imna or Imnah or Jimnah = "right hand"
- the 1st born son of Asher
- a Levite, descendant of Imnah, who assisted in the reforms of Hezekiah n patr
- descendants of Imnah, son of Asher

H3233.gloss: from «03231»; right (i.e. at the right hand):  -(on the) right (hand).

H3234.gloss: from «04513»; he will restrain; Jimna, an Israelite:  -Imna.
H3234.outline:
Imna = "He will restrain"
- son of Helem, descendant of Asher, and leader of the tribe of Asher

H3235.gloss: a primitive root; to exchange; by implication, to change places:--boast selves, change.

H4327.outline: - kind, sometimes a species (usually of animals) ++++ Groups of living organisms belong in the same created "kind" if they have descended from the same ancestral gene pool. A new species could arise when a population is isolated and inbreeding occurs. By this definition a new species is not a new "kind" but a further partitioning of an existing "kind".
