H5658.outline:
Abdon = "servile" n pr m
- a judge of Israel in the time of the judges; perhaps the same as 'Bedan'
- a Benjamite, son of Shashak
- a Gibeonite, son of Jehiel and a grandson of Gideon
- son of Micah in the time of king Josiah of Judah; also 'Achbor' n pr loc
- a city in Asher allotted to the Gershonite Levites; located 10 miles (16 km) north of Accho; modern 'Abdeh'

H5660.gloss: from «05647»; serviceable; Abdi, the name of two Israelites:--Abdi.
H5660.outline:
Abdi = "servant of Jehovah"
- a Merarite Levite and ancestor of Ethan the singer
- a Merarite Levite, father of Kish, in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah
- one of the family of Elam who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H5661.gloss: from «05650» and «0410»; servant of God; Abdiel, an Israelite:--Abdiel. Compare «05655».
H5661.outline:
Abdiel = "servant of God"
- a Gadite, son of Guni and father of Ahi and one who settled in the land of Bashan in the time of king Jotham of Judah

H5662.gloss: or mObadyahuw {o-bad-yaw'-hoo}; active participle of «05647» and «03050»; serving Jah; Obadjah, the name of thirteen Israelites:--Obadiah.
H5662.outline:
Obadiah = "servant of Jehovah"
- the 4th of the 12 minor prophets; nothing personal is known of him but it is probable that he was contemporary with Jeremiah, Ezekiel, and Daniel
- the prophetic book by him; prophesies against Edom
- father of Ishmaiah, one of the chiefs of Zebulun in the time of David
- a Merarite Levite overseer of the work of restoring the temple in the time of king Josiah of Judah
- chief of the household of king Ahab of Israel; an devout worshipper of Jehovah who at risk to his own life hid over 100 prophets during the persecution of Jezebel
- a descendant of David
- a chief of the tribe of Issachar
- a Benjamite, one of the 6 sons of Azel and a descendant of king Saul
- a Levite, son of Shemaiah and a descendant of Jeduthun
- a Gadite chief, the 2nd of the lion-faced Gadites who joined David at Ziklag
- a prince of Judah in the time of king Jehoshaphat of Judah
- a priest, son of Jehiel of the sons of Joab who returned from exile with Ezra
- a gatekeeper in the time of Nehemiah
- one of the men who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
- perhaps the same as 12

H5663.gloss: from «05650» and «04428»; servant of a king; Ebed-Melek, a eunuch of Zedekeah:--Ebed-melech.
H5663.outline:
Ebed-melech = "servant of the king"
- an Ethiopian eunuch in the service of king Zedekiah, through whose interference Jeremiah was released from prison

H5664.gloss: the same as «05665»; Abed-Nego, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions:--Abed-nego.
H5664.outline:
Abed-nego = "servant of Nebo"
- the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Abednego; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord
- also, 'Azariah' (05838 or 05839)

H5665.gloss: (Aramaic) of foreign origin;  Abed-Nego, the name of Azariah:--Abed-nego.
H5665.outline:
Abed-nego = "servant of Nebo"
- the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Abednego; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord
- also, 'Azariah' (05838 or 05839)

H5666.gloss: a primitive root; to be dense:--be (grow)  thick(-er).
H5666.outline:
- to be thick, be fat, be gross
- (Qal) to be fat, be thick, be gross

H5667.outline: - pledge, a thing given as security, article pledged as security for debt

H5668.gloss: or rabur {aw-boor'}; passive participle of «05674»; properly, crossed, i.e. (abstractly) transit; used only adverbially, on account of, in order that:--because of, for (...'s sake), (intent) that, to.
H5668.outline:
prep
- for the sake of, on account of, because of, in order to conj
- in order that

H5669.gloss: the same as «05668»; passed, i.e. kept over; used only of stored grain:--old corn.

H5670.gloss: a primitive root; to pawn; causatively, to lend (on security); figuratively, to entangle:--borrow, break (ranks), fetch (a pledge), lend, × surely.
H5670.outline:
- to take a pledge, give a pledge (for a debt)
- (Qal) to take a pledge, give a pledge (for a debt)
- (Piel) to interchange
- (Hiphil) to cause to give a pledge

H5671.gloss: from «05670»; something pledged, i.e. (collectively) pawned goods:--thick clay (by a false etym.).

H5672.gloss: or mobiy {ob-ee'}; from «05666»; density, i.e. depth or width:--thick(-ness). Compare «05645».

H5673.gloss: (Aramaic) from «05648»; labor or business:--affairs, service, work.
H5673.outline:
- work, service, ritual, worship
- work, administration
- ritual, service

H5674.gloss: a primitive root; to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation):--alienate, alter, × at all, beyond, bring (over, through), carry over, (over-)come (on, over), conduct (over), convey over, current, deliver, do away, enter, escape, fail, gender, get over, (make) go (away, beyond, by, forth, his way, in, on, over, through), have away (more), lay, meddle, overrun, make partition, (cause to, give, make to, over) pass(-age, along, away, beyond, by, -enger, on, out, over, through), (cause to, make) + proclaim(-amation), perish, provoke to anger, put away, rage, + raiser of taxes, remove, send over, set apart, + shave, cause to (make) sound, ×  speedily, × sweet smelling, take (away), (make to) transgress(-or), translate, turn away, (way-)faring man, be wrath.
H5674.outline:
- to pass over or by or through, alienate, bring, carry, do away, take, take away, transgress
- (Qal)
- to pass over, cross, cross over, pass over, march over, overflow, go over
- to pass beyond
- to pass through, traverse 1a
- passers-through (participle) 1a
- to pass through (the parts of victim in covenant)
- to pass along, pass by, overtake and pass, sweep by 1a
- passer-by (participle) 1a
- to be past, be over
- to pass on, go on, pass on before, go in advance of, pass along, travel, advance
- to pass away 1a
- to emigrate, leave (one's territory) 1a
- to vanish 1a
- to perish, cease to exist 1a
- to become invalid, become obsolete (of law, decree) 1a
- to be alienated, pass into other hands
- (Niphal) to be crossed
- (Piel) to impregnate, cause to cross
- (Hiphil)
- to cause to pass over, cause to bring over, cause to cross over, make over to, dedicate, devote
- to cause to pass through
- to cause to pass by or beyond or under, let pass by
- to cause to pass away, cause to take away
- (Hithpael) to pass over

H5676.gloss: from «05674»; properly, a region across; but used only adverbially (with or without a preposition) on the opposite side (especially of the Jordan; ususally meaning the east):--X against, beyond, by, × from, over, passage, quarter, (other, this) side, straight.
H5676.outline:
- region beyond or across, side
- region across or beyond
- side, opposite side

H5677.gloss: the same as «05676»; Eber, the name of two patriarchs and four Israelites:--Eber, Heber.
H5677.outline:
Eber or Heber = "the region beyond"
- son of Salah, great grandson of Shem, father of Peleg and Joktan
- a Gadite chief
- a Benjamite, son of Elpaal and descendant of Sharahaim
- a Benjamite, son of Shashak
- a priest in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua

H5678.gloss: feminine of «05676»; an outburst of passion:--anger, rage, wrath.
H5678.outline:
- outpouring, overflow, excess, fury, wrath, arrogance
- overflow, excess, outburst
- arrogance
- overflowing rage or fury

H5679.gloss: from «05674»; a crossing-place:--ferry, plain (from the margin).

H5680.gloss: patronymic from «05677»; an Eberite (i.e. Hebrew) or descendant of Eber:--Hebrew(-ess, woman).
H5680.outline:
Hebrew = "one from beyond" n pr
- a designation of the patriarchs and the Israelites adj
- a designation of the patriarchs and the Israelites

H5681.gloss: the same as «05680»; Ibri, an Israelite:--Ibri.
H5681.outline:
Ibri = "Hebrew"
- a Merarite Levite of the family of Jaaziah in the time of David

H5682.gloss: plural of «05676»; regions beyond; Abarim, a place in Palestine:--Abarim, passages.
H5682.outline:
Abarim = "regions beyond"
- a mountain or range of mountains on the east of the Jordan, in the land of Moab, opposite to Jericho; Mount Nebo is part of this range

H5683.gloss: from «05676»; transitional; Ebron, a place in Palestine:--Hebron. Perhaps a clerical error for «05658».
H5683.outline:
Hebron = "alliance"
- a city of Judah located in the mountains 20 (32 km) miles south of Jerusalem and 20 (32 km) miles north of Beersheba

H5684.gloss: feminine of «05683»; Ebronah, place in the Desert:--Ebronah.
H5684.outline:
Ebronah = "passage"
- one of the stations of the Israelites in the wilderness immediately preceding Ezion-geber

H5685.gloss: a primitive root; to dry up:--be rotten.

H5686.gloss: a primitive root; to interlace, i.e. (figuratively) to pervert:--wrap up.

H5687.gloss: or rabowth {aw-both'}; from «05686»; intwined, i.e. dense:--thick.
H5687.outline: - having interwoven foliage, leafy, dense with foliage

H5688.gloss: or rabowth {ab-oth'}; or (feminine) tabothah {ab- oth-aw'}; the same as «05687»; something intwined, i.e. a string, wreath or foliage:--band, cord, rope, thick bough (branch), wreathen (chain).
H5688.outline:
- cord, rope, cordage, foliage, interwoven foliage
- cord, rope, cordage, chain
- interwoven foliage

H5689.gloss: a primitive root; to breathe after, i.e. to love (sensually):--dote, lover.
H5689.outline:
- (Qal) to have inordinate affection or lust
- lust (participle)
- paramours (participle as subst)

H5690.gloss: from «05689»; love (concretely), i.e. amative words:--much love, very lovely.

H5692.gloss: from «05746»; an ash-cake (as round):--cake (upon the hearth).
H5692.outline:
- disc or cake (of bread)
- cake of hot stones (cake baked on hot stones)

H5693.gloss: passive part (but with active sense) of an unused root meaning to twitter: probably the swallow:--swallow.
H5693.outline:
- name of a bird
- perhaps a thrush, swallow, crane

H5694.gloss: from the same as «05696»; something round, i.e. a ring (for the ears):--earring.
H5694.outline:
- hoop, ring, earring
- adornment for men or women

H5695.gloss: from the same as «05696»; a (male) calf (as frisking round), especially one nearly grown (i.e. a steer):--bullock, calf.

H5696.gloss: or magowl {aw-gole'}; from an unused root meaning to revolve, circular:--round.

H5697.gloss: feminine of «05695»; a (female) calf, especially one nearly grown (i.e. a heifer):--calf, cow, heifer.

H5698.gloss: the same as «05697»; Eglah, a wife of David:--Eglah.
H5698.outline:
Eglah = "a heifer"
- a wife of David and mother of Ithream

H5699.gloss: from the same as «05696»; something revolving, i.e. a wheeled vehicle:--cart, chariot, wagon

H5700.gloss: from «05695»; vituline; Eglon, the name of a place in Palestine and of a Moabitish king:--Eglon.
H5700.outline:
Eglon = "calf-like" n pr m
- king of Moab who oppressed the children of Israel for 18 years before he was killed by the judge Ehud n pr loc
- a royal city in Canaan that opposed the conquest; located in the low lands of Judah

H5701.gloss: a primitive root; to be sad:--grieve.

H5702.gloss: a primitive root; to debar, i.e. from marriage:--stay.
H5702.outline: - (Niphal) to shut oneself in or off or up

H5703.gloss: from «05710»; properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition):--eternity, ever(- lasting, -more), old, perpetually, + world without end.
H5703.outline:
- perpetuity, for ever, continuing future
- ancient (of past time)
- for ever (of future time)
- of continuous existence
- for ever (of God's existence)

H5704.gloss: properly, the same as «05703» (used as a preposition, adverb or conjunction; especially with a preposition); as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with):--against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to),  for(-asmuch as), (hither-)to, + how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, (+ as) yet.
H5704.outline:
prep
- as far as, even to, until, up to, while, as far as
- of space
- as far as, up to, even to
- in combination
- from...as far as, both...and (with 'min' - from)
- of time
- even to, until, unto, till, during, end
- of degree
- even to, to the degree of, even like conj
- until, while, to the point that, so that even

H5705.gloss: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05704»; × and, at, for, (hither-)to, on till, (un-)to, until, within.
H5705.outline:
prep
- even to, until, up to, during conj
- until, up to the time that, ere that

H5706.gloss: the same as «05703» in the sense of the aim of an attack; booty:--prey.

H5707.gloss: contracted from «05749» ; concretely, a witness; abstractly, testimony; specifically, a recorder, i.e. prince:--witness.
H5707.outline:
- witness
- witness, testimony, evidence (of things)
- witness (of people)

H5708.gloss: from an unused root meaning to set a period (compare «05710», «05749»); the menstrual flux (as periodical); by implication (in plural) soiling:--filthy.
H5708.outline:
- menstruation
- filthy rag, stained garment (fig. of best deeds of guilty people)

H5709.gloss: (Aramaic) or adah (Aramaic) {ad-aw'}; corresponding to «05710»:--alter, depart, pass (away), remove, take (away).
H5709.outline:
- to pass on, pass away
- (P'al)
- to pass on, pass over
- to pass away
- (Aphel) to take away, remove, depose

H5710.gloss: a primitive root; to advance, i.e. pass on or continue; causatively, to remove; specifically, to bedeck (i.e. bring an ornament upon):--adorn, deck (self), pass by, take away.
H5710.outline:
- to pass on, advance, go on, pass by, remove
- (Qal) to pass on, put on
- (Hiphil) to remove

H5711.gloss: from «05710»; ornament; Adah, the name of two women:--Adah.
H5711.outline:
Adah = "ornament"
- the 1st of the 2 wives of Lamech and mother of Jabal and Jubal
- a Hittitess, 1 of the 3 wives of Esau and mother of Eliphaz
- also called 'Bashemath'

H5712.gloss: feminine of «05707» in the original sense of fixture; a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse, or generally, a family or crowd):--assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare «05713».

H5713.gloss: feminine of «05707» in its techn. sense; testimony:-- testimony, witness. Compare «05712».
H5713.outline:
- testimony, witness
- always plural and always of laws as divine testimonies

H5714.gloss: or iIddowo {id-do'}; or tIddiy  {id-dee'}; from «05710»; timely; Iddo (or Iddi), the name of five Israelites:--Iddo. Compare «03035», «03260».
H5714.outline:
Iddo = "His witness"
- father of Abinadab, an officer of Solomon
- grandfather of the prophet Zechariah
- a Gershonite Levite, son of Joah
- a priest in the time of Nehemiah
- a seer in the time of king Jeroboam of the northern kingdom of Israel
- son of Zechariah, ruler of the tribe of Manasseh in the time of David
- a chief of the temple slaves who assembled at Casiphia at the time of the 2nd caravan from Babylon

H5716.gloss: from «05710» in the sense of trappings; finery; generally an outfit; specifically, a headstall:--X excellent, mouth, ornament.

H5717.gloss: from «05716» and «0410»; ornament of God; Adiel, the name of three Israelites:--Adiel.
H5717.outline:
Adiel = "ornament of God"
- a prince of the Simeon of the family of Shimei in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah
- a priest, ancestor of Maasiai
- ancestor of Azmaveth, the treasurer of David

H5718.gloss: or mAdayahuw {ad-aw-yaw'-hoo}; from «05710» and «03050»; Jah has adorned; Adajah, the name of eight Israelites:--Adaiah.
H5718.outline:
Adaiah = "Jehovah has adorned Himself"
- maternal grandfather of king Josiah of Judah and native of Boscath in the lowlands of Judah
- a Gershonite Levite and ancestor of Asaph
- a Benjamite, son of Shimhi
- a priest, son of Jehoram
- ancestor of Maaseiah, one of the captains who supported Jehoiada
- a descendant of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
- a descendant of another Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
- a descendant of Pharez of the tribe of Judah

H5720.gloss: the same as «05719»; Adin, the name of two Israelites:--Adin.
H5720.outline:
Adin = "dainty" or "delicate"
- ancestor of a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel
- a chief among the returned exiles who signed the covenant with Nehemiah

H5721.outline:
Adina = "slender"
- a chief of the Reubenites, and a captain of David

H5722.gloss: probably from «05719» in the original sense of slender (i.e. a spear); his spear:--Adino.
H5722.outline:
Adino = "his ornament"
- one of David's mighty warriors

H5723.gloss: dual of a feminine of «05706»; double prey; Adithajim, a place in Palestine:--Adithaim.
H5723.outline:
Adithaim = "double ornament"
- a town in the lowland of Judah

H5724.gloss: probably from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Adlai, an Israelite:--Adlai.
H5724.outline:
Adlai = "justice of Jehovah"
- ancestor of Shaphat, the overseer of David's herds

H5725.gloss: probably from the passive participle of the same as «05724»; Adullam, a place in Palestine:--Adullam.
H5725.outline:
Adullam = "justice of the people"
- a town of the Canaanites allotted to Judah and lying in the lowlands; site of the cave where David hid

H5726.gloss: patrial from «05725»; an Adullamite or native of Adullam:--Adullamite.
H5726.outline:
Adullamite = see Adullam "justice of the people"
- an inhabitant of Adullam

H5727.gloss: a primitive root; to be soft or pleasant; figuratively and reflexively, to live voluptuously:--delight self.

H5728.gloss: or radennah {ad-en'-naw}; from «05704» and «02004»; till now:--yet.

H5729.gloss: from «05727»; pleasure; Eden, a place in Mesopotamia:--Eden.
H5729.outline:
Eden = "pleasure"
- a place conquered by Assyria; probably located in the northwest of Mesopotamia

H5730.gloss: or (feminine) aednah {ed-naw'}; from «05727»; pleasure:--delicate, delight, pleasure. See also «01040».

H5731.gloss: the same as «05730» (masculine); Eden, the region of Adam's home:--Eden.
H5731.outline:
Eden= "pleasure" n pr m loc
- the first habitat of man after the creation; site unknown n pr m
- a Gershonite Levite, son of Joah in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah

H5732.gloss: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of «05708»; a set time; technically, a year:--time.

H5733.gloss: from «05727»; pleasure; Adna, the name of two Israelites:--Adna.
H5733.outline:
Adna = "rest" or "pleasure"
- one of the family of Pahath-moab who returned with Ezra and married a foreign wife
- a priest, descendant of Harim in the days of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua

H5734.gloss: from «05727»; pleasure; Adnah, the name of two Israelites:--Adnah.
H5734.outline:
Adnah = "pleasure"
- a Manassite who deserted from Saul and joined David at Ziklag
- a captain in charge of over 300,000 men of Judah in the time of Jehoshaphat

H5735.gloss: from «05712»; festival; Adadah, a place in Palestine:--Adadah.
H5735.outline:
Adadah = "festival" or "boundary"
- one of the towns in the extreme south of Judah

H5736.gloss: a primitive root; to be (causatively, have) redundant:--be more, odd number, be (have) over (and above), overplus, remain.
H5736.outline:
- to remain over, be in excess
- (Qal)
- to be in excess 1a
- excess (subst) 1a
- surplus (participle)
- (Hiphil) to have a surplus

H5737.gloss: a primitive root; to arrange, as a battle, a vineyard (to hoe); hence, to muster and so to miss (or find wanting):--dig, fail, keep (rank), lack.
H5737.outline:
- to help
- (Qal) to help
- to hoe
- (Niphal) to be hoed
- to be lacking, fail
- (Niphal)
- to be lacking
- to leave lacking
- (Piel) to leave lacking

H5738.gloss: from «05737»; an arrangement (i.e. drove); Eder, an Israelite:--Ader.
H5738.outline:
Ader = "flock"
- a Benjamite, son of Beriah, chief of the inhabitants of Aijalon
- also 'Eder'

H5739.gloss: from «05737»; an arrangement, i.e. muster (of animals):--drove, flock, herd.
H5739.outline:
- flock, herd
- flock
- herds, flocks and herds

H5740.gloss: the same as «05739»; Eder, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine:--Edar, Eder.
H5740.outline:
Eder = "a flock" n pr m
- a Merarite Levite in the time of David n pr loc
- a town in the extreme south of Judah on the border of Edom; site unknown

H5741.gloss: from «05739» and «0410»; flock of God; Adriel, an Israelite:--Adriel.
H5741.outline:
Adriel = "flock of God"
- son of Barzillai, and the man to whom Saul gave his daughter Merab in marriage although she was already promised to David

H5742.gloss: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a lentil:--lentile.

H5743.gloss: a primitive root; to be dense or dark, i.e. to becloud:--cover with a cloud.

H5744.gloss: active participle of «05647»; serving; Obed, the name of five Israelites:--Obed.
H5744.outline:
Obed = "serving"
- son of Boaz by Ruth and the grandfather of David
- a Judaite, a descendant of Jarha, the Egyptian slave of Sheshan, in the line of Jerahmeel
- a Judaite, father of Azariah, one of the captains of hundreds who joined with Jehoiada in the revolution by which Athaliah fell
- one of David's mighty warriors
- son of Shemaiah and a gatekeeper of the temple

H5745.gloss: of foreign derivation; Obal, a son of Joktan:--Obal.
H5745.outline:
Obal = "stripped bare"
- a son of Joktan and the founder of an Arab tribe

H5746.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to gyrate; but used only as a denominative from «05692», to bake (round cakes on the hearth):--bake.

H5747.gloss: probably from «05746»; round; Og, a king of Bashan:--Og.
H5747.outline:
Og = "long-necked"
- the Amorite king of Bashan and one of the last representatives of the giants of Rephaim

H5748.gloss: or buggab {oog-gawb'}; from «05689» in the original sense of breathing; a reed-instrument of music:--organ.
H5748.outline:
- a musical instrument
- perhaps a flute, reed-pipe, or panpipes

H5749.gloss: a primitive root; to duplicate or repeat; by implication, to protest, testify (as by reiteration); intensively, to encompass, restore (as a sort of reduplication):--admonish, charge, earnestly, lift up, protest, call (take) to record, relieve, rob, solemnly, stand upright, testify, give warning, (bear, call to, give, take to) witness.
H5749.outline:
- to return, repeat, go about, do again
- (Piel) to surround, go round and round
- (Pilel) to restore, relieve
- (Hithpalel) to be restored
- to bear witness
- (Qal) to bear witness, say again and again
- (Hiphil)
- to testify, bear witness
- to cause to testify, take or call as witness, invoke
- to protest, affirm solemnly, warn, exhort or enjoin solemnly, admonish, charge
- (Hophal) to protest, give warning

H5750.gloss: or rod {ode}; from «05749»; properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more:--again, × all life long, at all, besides, but, else, further(-more), henceforth, (any) longer, (any) more(-over), × once, since, (be) still, when, (good, the) while (having being), (as, because, whether, while) yet (within).
H5750.outline:
subst

- an inhabitant of Aroer

H6201.gloss: a primitive root; to droop; hence, to drip:--drop (down).
H6201.outline:
- to drop, drip
- (Qal) to drop, trickle

H6202.gloss: a primitive root (identical with «06201» through the idea of sloping); properly, to bend downward; but used only as a denominative from «06203», to break the neck; hence (figuratively) to destroy:--that is beheaded, break down, break (cut off, strike off) neck.
H6202.outline: - (Qal) to break the neck (of an animal)

H6203.gloss: from «06202»; the nape or back of the neck (as declining); hence, the back generally (whether literal or figurative):-- back ((stiff-)neck((-ed).
H6203.outline:
- neck, back of the neck, back
- back of the neck
- of fleeing foe
- of apostasy (fig.)
- stiff of neck, obstinate (fig.)

H6204.gloss: feminine of «06203»; mane; Orpah, a Moabites:--Orpah.
H6204.outline:
Orpah = "gazelle"
- a Moabite woman, wife of Chilion, the son of Naomi, and sister-in- law of Ruth

H6205.gloss: probably from «06201»; gloom (as of a lowering sky):--(gross, thick) dark (cloud, -ness).
H6205.outline: - cloud, heavy or dark cloud, darkness, gross darkness, thick darkness

H6206.gloss: a primitive root; to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass:--be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly.
H6206.outline:
- to tremble, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, break, be terrified, cause to tremble
- (Qal)
- to cause to tremble, terrify
- to tremble, feel dread
- (Niphal) to be awesome, be terrible
- (Hiphil)
- to regard or treat with awe, regard or treat as awful
- to inspire with awe, terrify

H6207.gloss: a primitive root; to gnaw, i.e. (figuratively) eat (by hyberbole); also (participle) a pain:--fleeing, sinew.

H6208.gloss: patrial from an unused name meaning a tush; an Arkite or inhabitant of Erek:--Arkite.
H6208.outline:
Arkite = see Arki "gnawing"
- an inhabitant of Arki or Arka

H6209.gloss: a primitive root; to bare; figuratively, to demolish:--make bare, break, raise up (perhaps by clerical error for raze), ×  utterly.
H6209.outline:
- to strip, make bare, strip oneself
- (Qal) to strip, strip oneself
- (Poel) to lay bare
- (Hithpalpel) to be utterly stripped, be utterly laid bare
- (Pilpel) break

H6210.gloss: from an unused root meaning perhaps to arch; a couch (properly, with a canopy):--bed(-stead), couch.

H6212.gloss: from an unused root meaning to glisten (or be green); grass (or any tender shoot):--grass, herb.

H6213.gloss: a primitive root; to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application (as follows):--accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be busy, × certainly, have the charge of, commit, deal (with), deck, + displease, do, (ready) dress(-ed), (put in) execute(-ion), exercise, fashion, + feast, (fight-)ing man, + finish, fit, fly, follow, fulfill, furnish, gather, get, go about, govern, grant, great, + hinder, hold ((a feast)), ×  indeed, + be industrious, + journey, keep, labour, maintain, make, be meet, observe, be occupied, offer, + officer, pare, bring (come) to pass, perform, pracise, prepare, procure, provide, put, requite, × sacrifice, serve, set, shew, × sin, spend, × surely, take, × thoroughly, trim, × very, + vex, be (warr-)ior, work(-man), yield, use.
H6213.outline:
- to do, fashion, accomplish, make
- (Qal)
- to do, work, make, produce 1a
- to do 1a
- to work 1a
- to deal (with) 1a
- to act, act with effect, effect
- to make 1a
- to make 1a
- to produce 1a
- to prepare 1a
- to make (an offering) 1a
- to attend to, put in order 1a
- to observe, celebrate 1a
- to acquire (property) 1a
- to appoint, ordain, institute 1a
- to bring about 1a
- to use 1a
- to spend, pass
- (Niphal)
- to be done
- to be made
- to be produced
- to be offered
- to be observed
- to be used
- (Pual) to be made
- (Piel) to press, squeeze

H6214.gloss: from «06213» and «0410»; God has made; Asahel, the name of four Israelites:--Asahel.
H6214.outline:
Asahel = "God-made"
- nephew of David, son of David's sister Zeruiah, and brother of Joab and Abishai; swift of foot he was killed by Abner when he pursued him in battle and caught him
- a Levite in the reign of king Jehoshaphat of Judah who went through the kingdom giving instruction in the law
- a Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah in charge of the tithes and dedicated things in the temple
- a priest, father of Jonathan, in the time of Ezra

H6215.gloss: apparently a form of the passive participle of «06213» in the original sense of handling; rough (i.e. sensibly felt); Esav, a son of Isaac, including his posterity:--Esau.
H6215.outline:
Esau = "hairy"
- eldest son of Isaac and Rebecca and twin brother of Jacob; sold the birthright for food when he was hungry and the divine blessing went to Jacob; progenitor of the Arab peoples

H6217.gloss: or mashuq {aw-shook'}; passive participle of «06231»; used in plural masculine as abstractly, tyranny:--oppressed(-ion). (Doubtful.)

H6218.gloss: or masor {aw-sore'}; from «06235»; ten; by abbrev. ten strings, and so a decachord:--(instrument of) ten (strings, -th).
H6218.outline:
- ten, decade
- ten, tenth
- ten-stringed, harp

H6220.outline:
Ashvath = "sleek"
- one of the sons of Japhlet of the tribe of Asher

H6221.gloss: from «06213» and «0410»; made of God; Asiel, an Israelite:--Asiel.
H6221.outline:
Asiel = "made by God"
- a Simeonite and ancestor of Jehu

H6222.gloss: from «06213» and «03050»; Jah has made; Asajah, the name of three or four Israelites:--Asaiah.
H6222.outline:
Asaiah = "made by Jehovah"
- a prince of the tribe of Simeon in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah
- a servant of king Josiah of Judah
- a Merarite Levite, chief of his family, in the time of David

H6223.gloss: from «06238»; rich, whether literal or figurative (noble):--rich (man).
H6223.outline:
adj
- rich, wealthy n
- the rich, the wealthy, rich man

H6224.gloss: from «06235»; tenth; by abbreviation, tenth month or (feminine) part:--tenth (part).

H6225.gloss: a primitive root; to smoke, whether literal or figurative:--be angry (be on a) smoke.
H6225.outline:
- to smoke, be angry, be wroth
- (Qal)
- to smoke
- to fume, be wroth, be furious

H6227.gloss: from «06225»; smoke, literally or figuratively (vapor, dust, anger):--smoke(-ing).
H6227.outline:
- smoke
- smoke
- in metaphor, simile
- smoke (fig.)

H6228.gloss: the same as «06227»; Ashan, a place in Palestine:--Ashan.
H6228.outline:
Ashan = "smoke"
- a city in the lowland of Judah later mentioned as belonging to Simeon

H6229.gloss: a primitive root (identical with «06231»); to press upon, i.e. quarrel; --strive with.

H6230.outline:
Esek = "contention"
- a well which the herdsmen of Isaac dug in the valley of Gerar

H6231.gloss: a primitive root (compare «06229»); to press upon, i.e. oppress, defraud, violate, overflow:--get deceitfully, deceive, defraud, drink up, (use) oppress((-ion)), -or), do violence (wrong).
H6231.outline:
- to press upon, oppress, violate, defraud, do violence, get deceitfully, wrong, extort
- (Qal)
- to oppress, wrong, extort
- to oppress
- (Pual) to be exploited, be crushed

H6232.outline:
Eshek = "oppressor"
- a Benjamite, late descendant of Saul

H6233.gloss: from «06231»; injury, fraud, (subjectively) distress, (concretely) unjust gain:--cruelly, extortion, oppression, thing (deceitfully gotten).
H6233.outline:
- oppression, extortion, injury
- oppression
- extortion
- gain by extortion

H6235.gloss: masculine of term aasarah {as-aw-raw'}; from «06237»; ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits):--ten, (fif-, seven-)teen.

H6236.gloss: (Aramaic) masculine aasrah (Aramaic). {as-raw'}; corresponding to «06235»; ten:--ten, + twelve.

H6237.gloss: a primitive root (ident. with «06238»); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from «06235»; to tithe, i.e. to take or give a tenth:--X surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), × truly.
H6237.outline:
- to tithe, take the tenth part of, give a tithe, take a tithe
- (Qal) to tithe
- (Piel) to give a tithe
- (Hiphil) to take a tithe

H6238.gloss: a primitive root; properly, to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make) rich:--be(-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make (1 Kings 22:48 marg). See «06240».
H6238.outline:
- to be or become rich or wealthy, enrich, pretend to be rich
- (Qal) to be or become rich
- (Hiphil)
- to make rich
- to gain riches
- (Hithpael) to enrich oneself, pretend to be rich

H6240.gloss: for «06235»; ten (only in combination), i.e. -teen; also (ordinal) -teenth:--(eigh-, fif-, four-, nine-, seven-, six-,  thir-)teen(-th), + eleven(-th), + sixscore thousand, + twelve(-th).
H6240.outline:
- ten, -teen (in combination with other numbers)
- used only in combination to make the numbers 11-19

H6241.gloss: or oissaron {is-saw-rone'}; from «06235»; (fractional) a tenth part:--tenth deal.

H6244.gloss: a primitive root; probably to shrink, i.e. fail:--be consumed.

H6245.gloss: a primitive root; probably to be sleek, i.e. glossy; hence (through the idea of polishing) to excogitate (as if forming in the mind):--shine, think.
H6245.outline:
- (Qal) to be smooth, be shiny, gleam
- (Hithpael) to think

H6249.gloss: apparently masculine plural construction of «06247» in the sense of an afterthought (used only in connection with «06240» in lieu of «0259») eleven or (ordinal) eleventh:--+ eleven(-th).
H6249.outline:
- one, eleven, eleventh
- one as combined with ten (06240)

H6252.gloss: or bAshtaroth {ash-taw-roth'}; plural of «06251»; Ashtaroth, the name of a Sidonian deity, and of a place East of the Jordan:--Asharoth, Astaroth. See also «01045», «06253», «06255».
H6252.outline:
Ashtaroth or Astaroth = "star" n pr f deity
- false goddesses in the Canaanite religion, usually related to fertility cult n pr loc
- a city in Bashan east of the Jordan given to Manasseh
- same as 06255

H6253.gloss: probably for «06251»; Ashtoreth, the Phoenician goddess of love (and increase):--Ashtoreth.
H6253.outline:
Ashtoreth = "star"
- the principal female deity of the Phoenicians worshipped in war and fertility
- also 'Ishtar' of Assyria and 'Astarte' by the Greeks and Romans

H6254.gloss: patrial from «06252»; an Ashterathite or inhabitant of Ashtaroth:--Ashterathite.
H6254.outline:
Ashterathite = see Astaroth "star"
- an inhabitant of the city of Ashtaroth

H6255.gloss: from «06252» and the dual of «07161»; Ashtaroth of (the) double horns (a symbol of the deity); Ashteroth-Karnaim, a place East of the Jordan:--Ashtoreth Karnaim.
H6255.outline:
Ashtoreth-karnaim = "Ashtoreth of the two horns or peaks"
- a city in Bashan east of the Jordan given to Manasseh
- same as 06252

H6256.gloss: from «05703»; time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.:--+ after, (al-)ways, × certain, + continually, + evening, long, (due) season, so (long) as, (even-, evening-, noon-)tide, ((meal-)), what) time, when.
H6256.outline:
- time
- time (of an event)
- time (usual)
- experiences, fortunes
- occurrence, occasion

H6257.gloss: a primitive root; to prepare:--make fit, be ready to become.
H6257.outline:
- to be ready, make ready, prepare
- (Piel) to make ready
- (Hithpael) to be prepared

H6258.gloss: from «06256»; at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive:--henceforth, now, straightway, this time, whereas.

H6260.gloss: or sattud {at-tood'}; from «06257»; prepared, i.e. full grown; spoken only (in plural) of he-goats, or (figuratively) leaders of the people:--chief one, (he) goat, ram.

H6262.gloss: for «06261»; Attai, the name of three Israelites:--Attai.
H6262.outline:
Attai = "opportune"
- a Judaite, grandson of Sheshan the Jerahmeelite by daughter Ahlai whom he gave in marriage to Jarha, his Egyptian slave; his grandson Zabad was one of David's mighty warriors
- one of the lion-faced warriors of Gad, captains of the host, who joined David in the wilderness
- the 2nd son of king Rehoboam of Judah by Maachah, the daughter of Absalom

H6264.gloss: from «06257»; prepared; by implication, skilful; feminine plural the future; also treasure:--things that shall come, ready, treasures.
H6264.outline:
- ready, prepared
- ready
- ready, skilled
- prepared, impending
- prepared, stored up, treasure

H6265.gloss: from «05790» and «03050»; Jah has helped; Athajah, an Israelite:--Athaiah.
H6265.outline:
Athaiah = "Jehovah has helped"
- a descendant of Judah through Perez; dwelt at Jerusalem after the return from exile in Babylon

H6266.gloss: from «06275»; properly, antique, i.e. venerable or splendid:--durable.

H6267.gloss: from «06275»; removed, i.e. weaned; also antique:--ancient, drawn.
H6267.outline:
- removed, weaned, old, ancient, taken away
- removed, weaned
- old, ancient

H6268.outline: - ancient, advanced, aged, old, taken away

H6269.gloss: from an unused root meaning to sojourn; lodging; Athak, a place in Palestine:--Athach.
H6269.outline:
Athach = "lodging place"
- a town in Judah

H6270.gloss: from an unused root meaning to compress; constringent; Athlai, an Israelite:--Athlai.
H6270.outline:
Athlai = "whom Jehovah afflicts"
- one of the sons of Bebai and one who put away his foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H6271.gloss: or mAthalyahuw {ath-al-yaw'-hoo}; from the same as «06270» and «03050»; Jah has constrained; Athaljah, the name of an Israelitess and two Israelites:--Athaliah.
H6271.outline:
Athaliah = "afflicted of the Lord" n pr m
- son of Jeroham of the tribe of Benjamin
- father of Jeshaiah of the sons of Elam who was one of the heads of a family who returned with Ezra from exile n pr f
- the daughter of Ahab and Jezebel and the wife of king Jehoram of Judah; killer of all the members of the royal family of Judah with the exception of one baby named Joash who was hidden by the high priest Jehoiada until 6 years had passed and Jehoiada led the revolution to put him on the throne, overthrowing Athaliah and putting her to death

H6272.gloss: a primitive root; probably to glow, i.e. (figuratively) be desolated:--be darkened.
H6272.outline:
- (Niphal) to be burned up, be scorched
- meaning dubious

H6273.gloss: from an unused root meaning to force; forcible; Othni, an Israelite:--Othni.
H6273.outline:
Othni = "lion of Jehovah"
- a Levite, son of Shemaiah, the first-born of Obed-edom

H6274.gloss: from the same as «06273» and «0410»; force of God; Othniel, an Israelite:--Othniel.
H6274.outline:
Othniel = "lion of God"
- son of Kenaz, younger brother of Caleb, and husband of Achsah the daughter of Caleb and his own niece; first judge of Israel, who after the death of Joshua, delivered the Israelites from the oppression of Chushanrishathaim

H6275.gloss: a primitive root; to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old; specifically, to transcribe:--copy out, leave off, become (wax) old, remove.
H6275.outline:
- to move, proceed, advance, move on, become old, be removed
- (Qal)
- to move
- to advance (in years), grow old and weak
- (Hiphil)
- to move forward, proceed, move on
- to remove
- to transcribe

H6276.outline: - handed forward, advanced, enduring, durable, valuable, eminent, surpassing

H6277.gloss: from «06275» in the sense of license; impudent:--arrogancy, grievous (hard) things, stiff.

H6278.gloss: from «06256» and «07011»; time of a judge; Eth-Katsin, a place in Palestine:--Ittah-kazin (by including directive enclitic).
H6278.outline:
Ittah-kazin = "time of the judge"
- one of the landmarks of the boundary of Zebulun; site unknown

H6279.gloss: a primitive root (rather denominative from «06281»); to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer):--intreat, (make) pray(-er).
H6279.outline:
- to pray, entreat, supplicate
- (Qal) to pray, entreat
- (Niphal) to be supplicated, be entreated
- (Hiphil) to make supplication, plead

H6280.gloss: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) abundant:--deceitful, multiply.
H6280.outline:
- to be abundant
- (Niphal) to be plentiful
- (Hiphil) to multiply, become abundant

H6281.gloss: from «06280»; abundance; Ether, a place in Palestine:--Ether.
H6281.outline:
Ether = "abundant"
- a town in the lowlands of Judah allotted to Simeon

H6282.gloss: from «06280»; incense (as increasing to a volume of smoke); hence (from «06279») a worshipper:--suppliant, thick.

H6284.gloss: a primitive root; to puff, i.e. blow away:--scatter into corners.
H6284.outline:
- to cleave in pieces, break into pieces, shatter
- (Hiphil) to cleave in pieces, dash to pieces

H6285.gloss: feminine of «06311»; properly, mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction, region, extremity:--corner, end, quarter, side.
H6285.outline:
- corner, edge, side, quarter, extremity
- corner
- side

H6286.gloss: a primitive root; to gleam, i.e. (causatively) embellish; figuratively, to boast; also to explain (i.e. make clear) oneself; denominative from «06288», to shake a tree:--beautify, boast self, go over the boughs, glorify (self), glory, vaunt self.
H6286.outline:
- to glorify, beautify, adorn
- (Piel) to glorify, beautify
- (Hithpael)
- to glorify oneself
- to get glory to oneself, be glorified
- (Piel) to go over the boughs

H6287.gloss: from «06286»; an embellishment, i.e. fancy head-dress:--beauty, bonnet, goodly, ornament, tire.

H6288.gloss: or pora'h {po-raw'}; or pu'rah {poo-raw'}; from «06286»; properly, ornamentation, i.e. (plural) foliage (including the limbs) as bright green:--bough, branch, sprig.

H6289.gloss: from «06286»; properly, illuminated, i.e. a glow; as noun, a flush (of anxiety):--blackness.

H6290.gloss: from «06286»; ornamental; Paran, a desert of Arabia:--Paran.
H6290.outline:
Paran = "place of caverns"
- wilderness area bounded on the north by Palestine, on the west by the wilderness of Etham, on the south by the desert of Sinai, and on the east by the valley of Arabah; the exodus was through this area and probably all 18 stops were in this area

H6291.gloss: from an unused root meaning to be torpid, i.e. crude; an unripe fig:--green fig.

H6292.gloss: or piggul {pig-gool'}; from an unused root meaning to stink; properly, fetid, i.e. (figuratively) unclean (ceremonially):--abominable(-tion, thing).
H6292.outline:
- foul thing, refuse
- unclean sacrificial flesh (only use)

H6293.gloss: a primitive root; to impinge, by accident or violence, or (figuratively) by importunity:--come (betwixt), cause to entreat, fall (upon), make intercession, intercessor, intreat, lay, light (upon), meet (together), pray, reach, run.
H6293.outline:
- to encounter, meet, reach, entreat, make intercession
- (Qal)
- to meet, light upon, join
- to meet (of kindness)
- to encounter, fall upon (of hostility)
- to encounter, entreat (of request)
- to strike, touch (of boundary)
- (Hiphil)
- to cause to light upon
- to cause to entreat
- to make entreaty, interpose
- to make attack
- to reach the mark

H6295.gloss: from «06294» and «0410»; accident of God; Pagiel, an Israelite:--Pagiel.
H6295.outline:
Pagiel = "event of God"
- son of Ocran and chief of the tribe of Asher at the time of the exodus

H6296.gloss: a primitive root; to relax, i.e. become exhausted:--be faint.

H6297.gloss: from «06296»; a carcase (as limp), whether of man or beast; figuratively, an idolatrous image:--carcase, corpse, dead body.
H6297.outline:
- corpse, carcass, monument, stela
- corpse (of man)
- carcass (of animals)

H6298.gloss: a primitive root; to come in contact with, whether by accident or violence; figuratively, to concur:--meet (with, together).
H6298.outline:
- to meet, join, encounter
- (Qal) to meet, encounter
- (Niphal) to meet together, meet each other
- (Piel) to meet, encounter

H6299.gloss: a primitive root; to sever, i.e. ransom; gener. to release, preserve:--X at all, deliver, × by any means, ransom, (that are to be, let be) redeem(-ed), rescue, × surely.
H6299.outline:
- to ransom, redeem, rescue, deliver
- (Qal) to ransom
- (Niphal) to be ransomed
- (Hiphil) to allow one to be ransomed
- (Hophal) redeemed

H6300.gloss: from «06299» and «0410»; God has ransomed; Pedahel, an Israelite:--Pedahel.
H6300.outline:
Pedahel = "ransomed by God"
- son of Ammihud and prince of the tribe of Naphtali

H6301.gloss: from «06299» and «06697»; a rock (i.e. God) has ransomed; Pedahtsur, an Israelite:--Pedahzur.
H6301.outline:
Pedahzur = "the Rock has ransomed"
- father of Gamaliel who was the chief of the tribe of Manasseh at the time of the exodus

H6302.gloss: passive participle of «06299». ransomed (and so occurring under «06299»); as abstractly (in plural masculine) a ransom:--(that are) to be (that were) redeemed.

H6303.gloss: from «06299»; ransom; Padon, one of the Nethinim. -- Padon.
H6303.outline:
Padon = "ransom"
- an head or ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned with Zerubbabel

H6304.gloss: or pduth {ped-ooth'}; from «06929»; distinction; also deliverance:--division, redeem, redemption.

H6305.gloss: or Pdayahuw {ped-aw-yaw'-hoo}; from «06299» and «03050»; Jah has ransomed; Pedajah, the name of six Israelites:--Pedaiah.
H6305.outline:
Pedaiah = "Jehovah has ransomed"
- father of Zebudah, the wife of king Josiah and the mother of king Jehoiakim both of Judah
- father of Zerubbabel and brother of Shealtiel who is usually called the father of Zerubbabel probably because of a lack of an heir from Shealtiel who was in the direct line of succession

H6306.gloss: or pidyom {pid-yome'}; also pidyown {pid-yone'}; or pidyon {pid-yone'}; from «06299»; a ransom; --ransom, that were redeemed, redemption.

H6307.gloss: from an unused root meaning to extend; a plateau; or Paddan pAram {pad-dan' ar-awm'}; from the same and «0758»; the table-land of Aram; Paddan or Paddan-Aram, a region of Syria:--Padan, Padan-aram.
H6307.outline:
Padan or Padan-aram = "field"
- a plain or tableland in northern Mesopotamia in Aram, a region of Syria

H6309.gloss: from an unused root meaning to be greasy; suet:--fat.

H6310.gloss: from «06284»; the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to:--accord(-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command(-ment), × eat, edge, end, entry, + file, hole, × in, mind, mouth, part, portion, × (should) say(-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, × spoken, talk, tenor, × to, + two-edged, wish, word.
H6310.outline:
peh
- mouth
- mouth (of man)
- mouth (as organ of speech)
- mouth (of animals)
- mouth, opening, orifice (of a well, river, etc)
- extremity, end pim
- a weight equal to one third of a shekel, occurs only in 1 Sa. 13:21

H6311.gloss: or «0po6» (Job 38:11) {po}; or pow {po}; probably from a primitive inseparable particle "p" (of demonstrative force) and «01931»; this place (French ici), i.e. here or hence:--here, hither, the one (other, this, that) side.
H6311.outline:
- here, from here, hither
- here
- hither

H6312.gloss: or Puvvah {poov-vaw'}; from «06284»; a blast; Puah or Puvvah, the name of two Israelites:--Phuvah, Pua, Puah.
H6312.outline:
Puah or Pua or Phuvah = "splendid"
