She was first married to Herod Philip I, son of Herod the Great, a man in private life; but afterwards formed an unlawful union with Herod Antipas, whom she induced not only to slay John the Baptist but also to make the journey to Rome which ruined him; at last she followed him to exile in Gaul.

G2268.gloss: of Hebrew origin («03470»); Hesaias (i.e. Jeshajah), an Israelite:--Esaias.
G2268.outline:
Isaiah = "Jehovah's help"
- a famous Hebrew prophet who prophesied in the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah

G2269.gloss: of Hebrew origin («06215»); Esau, an Edomite:--Esau.
G2269.outline:
Esau = "hairy"
- was the eldest son of Isaac and twin brother of Jacob

G2270.gloss: from the same as «2272»; to keep still (intransitively), i.e. refrain from labor, meddlesomeness or speech:--cease, hold peace, be quiet, rest.
G2270.outline:
- to keep quiet
- to rest, cease from labour
- to lead a quiet life, said of those who are not running hither and thither, but stay at home and mind their business
- to be silent, i.e. to say nothing, hold one's peace

G2271.gloss: feminine of «2272»; (as noun) stillness, i.e. desistance from bustle or language:--quietness, silence.
G2271.outline:
- quietness
- description of the life of one who stays at home doing his own work, and does not officiously meddle with the affairs of others
- silence

G2272.gloss: a prolonged form of a compound probably of a derivative of the base of «1476» and perhaps «2192»; properly, keeping one's seat (sedentary), i.e. (by implication) still (undisturbed, undisturbing):--peaceable, quiet.

G2274.gloss: from the same as «2276»; to make worse, i.e. vanquish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to rate lower:--be inferior, overcome.
G2274.outline:
- to make less, inferior, to overcome
- to be made inferior
- to overcome, worsted, to be conquered by one, forced to yield to one
- to hold a thing inferior, set below

G2275.gloss: from «2274»; a deterioration, i.e. (objectively) failure or (subjectively) loss:--diminishing, fault.
G2275.outline:
- a diminution, decrease: i.e. defeat
- loss, as respects to salvation

G2276.gloss: neuter of comparative of heka (slightly) used for that of «2556»; worse (as noun); by implication, less (as adverb):--less, worse.

G2277.gloss: third person singular imperative of «1510»; let him (or it) be:--let ... be.

G2278.gloss: from «2279»; to make a loud noise, i.e. reverberate:--roar, sound.
G2278.outline:
- to sound
- used of the roaring of the sea

G2279.gloss: of uncertain affinity; a loud or confused noise ("echo"), i.e. roar; figuratively, a rumor:--fame, sound.
G2279.outline:
- a sound, noise
- spoken of the roar of the sea waves
- rumour, report

G2280.gloss: of uncertain origin; Thaddaeus, one of the Apostles:--Thaddaeus.
G2280.outline:
Thaddaeus = "large hearted, courageous"
- one of the twelve apostles. From a comparison with the catalogue of apostles in Lk 6:16, and Acts 1:13, is seems that Judas, Lebbaeus and Thaddaeus were the same person, and the writer of the book of Jude.

G2281.gloss: probably prolonged from «251»; the sea (genitive case or specially):--sea.
G2281.outline:
- the sea
- used of the sea in general
- used specifically of the Mediterranean Sea or the Red Sea

G2282.gloss: probably akin to thallo (to warm); to brood, i.e. (figuratively) to foster:--cherish.
G2282.outline:
- to warm, keep warm
- to cherish with tender love, to foster with tender care

G2283.gloss: of Hebrew origin («08559»); Thamar (i.e. Tamar), an Israelitess:--Thamar.
G2283.outline:
Tamar = "palm tree"
- the wife of the two sons of Judah, Er and Onan.

G2284.gloss: from «2285»; to stupefy (with surprise), i.e. astound:--amaze, astonish.
G2284.outline:
- to be astonished
- to astonish, terrify
- to be amazed
- to be frightened

G2285.gloss: akin to an obsolete tapho (to dumbfound); stupefaction (by surprise), i.e. astonishment:--X amazed, + astonished, wonder.

G2287.gloss: from (the feminine form of) «2288» and «5342»; death-bearing, i.e. fatal:--deadly.

G2288.gloss: from «2348»; (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively):--X deadly, (be...) death.
G2288.outline:
- the death of the body
- that separation (whether natural or violent) of the soul and the body by which the life on earth is ended
- with the implied idea of future misery in hell
- the power of death
- since the nether world, the abode of the dead, was conceived as being very dark, it is equivalent to the region of thickest darkness i.e. figuratively, a region enveloped in the darkness of ignorance and sin
- metaph., the loss of that life which alone is worthy of the name,
- the misery of the soul arising from sin, which begins on earth but lasts and increases after the death of the body in hell
- the miserable state of the wicked dead in hell
- in the widest sense, death comprising all the miseries arising from sin, as well physical death as the loss of a life consecrated to God and blessed in him on earth, to be followed by wretchedness in hell

G2289.gloss: from «2288» to kill (literally or figuratively):--become dead, (cause to be) put to death, kill, mortify.
G2289.outline:
- to put to death
- metaph.
- to make to die i.e. destroy, render extinct
- by death to be liberated from the bond of anything, literally to be made dead in relation to (something)

G2290.gloss: a primary verb; to celebrate funeral rites, i.e. inter:--bury.

G2291.gloss: of Hebrew origin («08646»); Thara (i.e. Terach), the father of Abraham:--Thara.

G2292.gloss: another form for «2293»; to exercise courage:--be bold, × boldly, have confidence, be confident. Compare «5111».
G2292.outline:
- to be of good courage, be of good cheer
- to be bold

G2293.gloss: from «2294»; to have courage:--be of good cheer (comfort). Compare «2292».
G2293.outline: - to be of good courage, be of good cheer

G2295.gloss: apparently from a form of «2300»; wonder (properly concrete; but by implication, abstract):--admiration.
G2295.outline:
- a wonderful thing, a marvel
- wonder
- to wonder [with great wonder i.e.] exceedingly

G2296.gloss: from «2295»; to wonder; by implication, to admire:--admire, have in admiration, marvel, wonder.
G2296.outline:
- to wonder, wonder at, marvel
- to be wondered at, to be had in admiration

G2297.gloss: from «2295»; wondrous, i.e. (neuter as noun) a miracle:--wonderful thing.

G2298.gloss: from «2296»; wondered at, i.e. (by implication) wonderful:--marvel(-lous).
G2298.outline:
- wonderful, marvellous
- worthy of pious admiration, admirable, excellent
- passing human comprehension
- causing amazement joined with terror
- marvellous
- extraordinary, striking, surprising

G2300.gloss: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to look closely at, i.e. (by implication) perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to visit:--behold, look (upon), see. Compare «3700».
G2300.outline:
- to behold, look upon, view attentively, contemplate (often used of public shows)
- of important persons that are looked on with admiration
- to view, take a view of
- in the sense of visiting, meeting with a person
- to learn by looking, to see with the eyes, to perceive

G2301.gloss: from «2302»; to expose as a spectacle:--make a gazing stock.
G2301.outline:
- to bring upon the stage
- to set forth as a spectacle, expose to contempt

G2302.gloss: from «2300»; a place for public show ("theatre"), i.e. general audience-room; by implication, a show itself (figuratively):--spectacle, theatre.
G2302.outline:
- a theatre, a place in which games and dramatic spectacles are exhibited, and public assemblies held (for the Greeks used the theatre also as a forum)
- a public show
- metaph., a man who is exhibited to be gazed at and made sport of

G2303.gloss: probably neuter of «2304» (in its original sense of flashing); sulphur:--brimstone.
G2303.outline:
- brimstone
- divine incense, because burning brimstone was regarded as having power to purify, and to ward off disease

G2304.gloss: from «2316»; godlike (neuter as noun, divinity): - divine, godhead.
G2304.outline:
- a general name of deities or divinities as used by the Greeks
- spoken of the only and true God, trinity
- of Christ
- Holy Spirit
- the Father

G2307.gloss: from the prolonged form of «2309»; a determination (properly, the thing), i.e. (actively) choice (specially, purpose, decree; abstractly, volition) or (passively) inclination:-- desire, pleasure, will.
G2307.outline:
- what one wishes or has determined shall be done
- of the purpose of God to bless mankind through Christ
- of what God wishes to be done by us
- commands, precepts
- will, choice, inclination, desire, pleasure

G2308.gloss: from «2309»; determination (properly, the act), i.e. option:--will.

G2309.gloss: apparently strengthened from the alternate form of «138»; to determine (as an active option from subjective impulse; whereas «1014» properly denotes rather a passive acquiescence in objective considerations), i.e. choose or prefer (literally or figuratively); by implication, to wish, i.e. be inclined to (sometimes adverbially, gladly); impersonally for the future tense, to be about to; by Hebraism, to delight in:--desire, be disposed (forward), intend, list, love, mean, please, have rather, (be) will (have, -ling, - ling(-ly)).
G2309.outline:
- to will, have in mind, intend
- to be resolved or determined, to purpose
- to desire, to wish
- to love
- to like to do a thing, be fond of doing
- to take delight in, have pleasure

G2310.gloss: from a derivative of «5087»; something put down, i.e. a substruction (of a building, etc.), (literally or figuratively):--foundation.
G2310.outline:
- laid down as a foundation, the foundation (of a building, wall, city)
- metaph. the foundations, beginnings, first principals
- of institution or system of truth

G2311.gloss: from «2310»; to lay a basis for, i.e. (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate:--(lay the) found(- ation), ground, settle.
G2311.outline:
- to lay the foundation, to found
- to make stable, establish

G2312.gloss: from «2316» and «1321»; divinely instructed:--taught of God.

G2313.gloss: from «2314»; to resist deity:--fight against God.

G2314.gloss: from «2316» and «3164»; an opponent of deity:--to fight against God.

G2315.gloss: from «2316» and a presumed derivative of «4154»; divinely breathed in:--given by inspiration of God.
G2315.outline:
- inspired by God
- the contents of the scriptures

G2316.gloss: of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with «3588») the supreme Divinity; figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very:--X exceeding, God, god(-ly, -ward).
G2316.outline:
- a god or goddess, a general name of deities or divinities
- the Godhead, trinity
- God the Father, the first person in the trinity
- Christ, the second person of the trinity
- Holy Spirit, the third person in the trinity
- spoken of the only and true God
- refers to the things of God
- his counsels, interests, things due to him
- whatever can in any respect be likened unto God, or resemble him in any way
- God's representative or viceregent
- of magistrates and judges

G2318.gloss: from «2316» and «4576»; reverent of God, i.e. pious:--worshipper of God.

G2319.gloss: from «2316» and the base of «4767»; hateful to God, i.e. impious:--hater of God.
G2319.outline: - hateful to God, exceptionally impious and wicked

G2320.outline:
- deity
- the state of being God, Godhead

G2321.gloss: from «2316» and «5384»; friend of God; Theophilus, a Christian:--Theophilus.
G2321.outline:
Theophilus = "friend of God"
- the person to whom Luke addressed his Gospel and the book of Acts

G2322.gloss: from «2323»; attendance (specially, medical, i.e. cure); figuratively and collectively, domestics:--healing, household.
G2322.outline:
- service rendered by one to another
- spec. medical service: curing, healing
- household service
- body of attendants, servants, domestics

G2323.gloss: from the same as «2324»; to wait upon menially, i.e. (figuratively) to adore (God), or (specially) to relieve (of disease):--cure, heal, worship.
G2323.outline:
- to serve, do service
- to heal, cure, restore to health

G2324.gloss: apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivative of the base of «2330»; a menial attendant (as if cherishing):--servant.
G2324.outline:
- an attendant, servant: of God
- spoken of Moses discharging the duties committed to him by God

G2325.gloss: from «2330» (in the sense of the crop); to harvest:--reap.
G2325.outline:
- to reap, harvest
- proverbial expression for sowing and reaping
- cut off, destroy
- as crops are cut down with a sickle

G2326.outline:
- harvest, the act of reaping
- fig. of the gathering of men into the kingdom of God
- referring to time of reaping, the final judgment, when the righteous are gathered into the kingdom of God and the wicked are cast into hell for ever

G2328.outline:
- to make warm, to heat
- to warm one's self

G2330.gloss: from a primary thero (to heat); properly, heat, i.e. summer:--summer.

G2331.gloss: from «2332»; a Thessalonican, i.e. inhabitant of Thessalonice:--Thessalonian.

G2332.gloss: from Thessalos (a Thessalian) and «3529»; Thessalonice, a place in Asia Minor:--Thessalonica.
G2332.outline:
Thessalonica = "victory of falsity"
- a famous and populous city, situated on the Thermaic Gulf, the capital of the second division of Macedonia and the residence of a Roman governor and quaestor

G2333.gloss: of uncertain origin; Theudas, an Israelite:--Theudas.
G2333.outline:
Theudas = "God-given"
- the name of an insurgent mentioned in Gamaliel's speech before the Jewish council, Acts 5:35-39, at the time of the arraignment of the apostles. He appeared, according to Luke's account, at the head of about four hundred men. He was probably one of the insurrectionary chiefs or fanatics by whom the land was overrun in the last year of Herod's reign. Josephus speaks of a Theudas who played a similar part at the time of Claudius, about A.D. 44; but the Theudas mentioned by Luke must be a different person from the one spoken of by Josephus.

G2334.gloss: from a derivative of «2300» (perhaps by addition of «3708»); to be a spectator of, i.e. discern, (literally, figuratively (experience) or intensively (acknowledge)):--behold, consider, look on, perceive, see. Compare «3700».
G2334.outline:
- to be a spectator, look at, behold
- to view attentively, take a view of, survey
- to view mentally, consider
- to see
- to perceive with the eyes, to enjoy the presence of one
- to discern, descry
- to ascertain, find out by seeing

G2335.gloss: from the same as «2334»; spectatorship, i.e. (concretely) a spectacle:--sight.
G2335.outline:
- a viewing, beholding
- that which is viewed, a spectacle, sight

G2336.outline:
- that which a thing is put or laid away, a receptacle, repository, chest, box
- used of the sheath of a sword

G2337.gloss: from thele (the nipple); to suckle, (by implication) to suck:--(give) suck(-ling).
G2337.outline:
- to give the breast, give suck, to suckle
- to suck

G2338.gloss: from the same as «2337»; female:--female, woman.
G2338.outline:
- of the female sex
- a woman, a female

G2339.gloss: from ther (a wild animal, as game); hunting, i.e. (figuratively) destruction:--trap.
G2339.outline:
- a hunting of wild beasts to destroy them
- metaph. of preparing destruction for men

G2340.gloss: from «2339»; to hunt (an animal), i.e. (figuratively) to carp at:--catch.
G2340.outline:
- to go a hunting, to hunt, to catch in hunting
- metaph. to lay wait for, strive to ensnare, catch artfully

G2341.gloss: from a compound of «2342» and «3164»; to be a beast-fighter (in the gladiatorial show), i.e. (figuratively) to encounter (furious men):--fight with wild beasts.

G2342.gloss: diminutive from the same as «2339»; a dangerous animal:--(venomous, wild) beast.
G2342.outline:
- an animal
- a wild animal, wild beast, beast
- metaph. a brutal, bestial man, savage, ferocious

G2343.gloss: from «2344»; to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively):--lay up (treasure), (keep) in store, (heap) treasure (together, up).
G2343.outline:
- to gather and lay up, to heap up, store up
- to accumulate riches
- to keep in store, store up, reserve
- metaph. so to live from day to day as to increase either the bitterness or the happiness of one's consequent lot

G2344.gloss: from «5087»; a deposit, i.e. wealth (literally or figuratively):--treasure.
G2344.outline:
- the place in which good and precious things are collected and laid up
- a casket, coffer, or other receptacle, in which valuables are kept
- a treasury
- storehouse, repository, magazine
- the things laid up in a treasury, collected treasures

G2345.gloss: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary thigo (to finger); to manipulate, i.e. have to do with; by implication, to injure:--handle, touch.
G2345.outline:
- to touch, handle
- to do violence to, injury

G2346.gloss: akin to the base of «5147»; to crowd (literally or figuratively):--afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble.
G2346.outline:
- to press (as grapes), press hard upon
- a compressed way
- narrow straitened, contracted
- metaph. to trouble, afflict, distress

G2347.gloss: from «2346»; pressure (literally or figuratively):--afflicted(-tion), anguish, burdened, persecution, tribulation, trouble.
G2347.outline:
- a pressing, pressing together, pressure
- metaph. oppression, affliction, tribulation, distress, straits

G2348.gloss: a strengthened form of a simpler primary thano than'-o (which is used for it only in certain tenses); to die (literally or figuratively):--be dead, die.
G2348.outline:
- to die, to be dead
- metaph. to be spiritually dead

G2350.gloss: from «2351»; to be in tumult, i.e. disturb, clamor:--make ado (a noise), trouble self, set on an uproar.
G2350.outline:
- to make a noise or uproar, be turbulent
- to disturb, throw into confusion
- to be troubled in mind
- to wail tumultuously

G2351.gloss: from the base of «2360»; a disturbance:--tumult, uproar.
G2351.outline:
- a noise, tumult, uproar
- of persons wailing
- of a clamorous and excited multitude
- of riotous persons
- a tumult, as a breach of public order

G2352.gloss: a primary verb; to crush:--bruise. Compare «4486».
G2352.outline: - to break, break in pieces, shatter, smite through

G2353.gloss: from «5142»; stock (as raised on a farm):--cattle.
G2353.outline:
- whatever is fed or nursed
- a ward, nursling, child
- a flock, cattle, esp. sheep and goats

G2354.outline:
- to mourn, to lament
- of singers of dirges, [to wail]
- to bewail, deplore

G2356.gloss: from a derivative of «2357»; ceremonial observance:--religion, worshipping.
G2356.outline:
- religious worship
- esp. external, that which consists of ceremonies
- religious discipline, religion

G2357.gloss: probably from the base of «2360»; ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), i.e. pious:--religious.
G2357.outline:
- fearing or worshipping God
- to tremble
- trembling, fearful

G2358.gloss: from a prolonged compound of the base of «2360»; and a derivative of «680» (meaning a noisy iambus, sung in honor of Bacchus); to make an acclamatory procession, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer or (by Hebraism) to give victory:--(cause) to triumph (over).
G2358.outline:
- to triumph, to celebrate a triumph
- cause one to triumph

G2359.gloss: genitive case trichos, etc.; of uncertain derivation; hair:--hair. Compare «2864».
G2359.outline:
- the hair of the head
- the hair of animals

G2360.gloss: from threomai to wail; to clamor, i.e. (by implication) to frighten:--trouble.
G2360.outline:
- to cry aloud, make a noise by outcry
- in the NT, to trouble, frighten
- to be troubled in mind, to be frightened, alarmed

G2361.gloss: perhaps from «5142» (in the sense of thickening); a clot:--great drop.
G2361.outline: - a large thick drop, esp. of clotted blood

G2362.gloss: from thrao (to sit); a stately seat ("throne"); by implication, power or (concretely) a potentate:--seat, throne.
G2362.outline:
- a throne seat
- a chair of state having a footstool
- assigned in the NT to kings, hence, kingly power or royalty
- metaph. to God, the governor of the world
- to the Messiah, Christ, the partner and assistant in the divine administration 1b
- hence divine power belonging to Christ
- to judges i.e. tribunal or bench
- to elders

G2363.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Thyatira, a place in Asia Minor:--Thyatira.
G2363.outline:
Thyatira = "odour of affliction"
- a colony of Macedonia Greeks, situated between Sardis and Pergamos on the river Lycus; its inhabitants gained their living by traffic and the art of dyeing in purple

G2364.gloss: apparently a primary word (compare "daughter"); a female child, or (by Hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant):--daughter.
G2364.outline:
- a daughter
- a daughter of God
- acceptable to God, rejoicing in God's peculiar care and protection
- with the name of a place, city, or region
- denotes collectively all its inhabitants and citizens
- a female descendant

G2366.gloss: from «2380» (in the sense of blowing) a storm:--tempest.

G2367.gloss: from a derivative of «2380» (in the sense of blowing; denoting a certain fragrant tree); made of citron-wood:--thyine.
G2367.outline: - the citrus, an odoriferous North African tree used as incense, prized by the ancient Greeks and Romans on account of the beauty of its wood for various ornamental purposes

G2368.gloss: from «2370»; an aroma, i.e. fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication, the burning itself:--incense, odour.

G2369.gloss: from a derivative of «2370»; a place of fumigation, i.e. the alter of incense (in the Temple):--censer.
G2369.outline:
- a utensil for fumigating or burning incense
- an altar of incense

G2370.gloss: from a derivative of «2380» (in the sense of smoking); to fumigate, i.e. offer aromatic fumes:--burn incense.

G2371.gloss: from a presumed compound of «2372» and «3164»; to be in a furious fight, i.e. (figuratively) to be exasperated:--be highly displeased.
G2371.outline:
- to carry on war with great animosity
- to be very angry, be exasperated

G2372.gloss: from «2380»; passion (as if breathing hard):--fierceness, indignation, wrath. Compare «5590».
G2372.outline:
- passion, angry, heat, anger forthwith boiling up and soon subsiding again
- glow, ardour, the wine of passion, inflaming wine (which either drives the drinker mad or kills him with its strength)

G2373.gloss: from «2372»; to put in a passion, i.e. enrage:--be wroth.
G2373.outline:
- to cause one to become incensed, to provoke to anger
- to be wroth

G2374.gloss: apparently a primary word (compare "door"); a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively):--door, gate.
G2374.outline:
- a door
- the vestibule
- used of any opening like a door, an entrance, way or passage into
- in a parable or metaphor
- the door through which sheep go in and out, the name of him who brings salvation to those who follow his guidance
- "an open door" is used of the opportunity of doing something
- the door of the kingdom of heaven (likened to a palace) denotes the conditions which must be complied with in order to be received into the kingdom of God

G2375.outline: - a shield, a large oblong, four cornered shield

G2377.gloss: from «2374» and ouros (a watcher); a gate- warden:--that kept the door, porter.
G2377.outline:
- a doorkeeper, porter
- a male or female janitor

G2378.gloss: from «2380»; sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively):--sacrifice.

G2379.gloss: from a derivative of «2378»; a place of sacrifice, i.e. an altar (special or genitive case, literal or figurative):--altar.
G2379.outline:
- the altar for slaying and burning of victims used of
- the altar of whole burnt offerings which stood in the court of the priests in the temple at Jerusalem
- the altar of incense which stood in the sanctuary or the Holy Place
- any other altar
- metaph., the cross on which Christ suffered an expiatory death: to eat of this altar i.e. to appropriate to one's self the fruits of Christ's expiatory death

G2380.gloss: a primary verb; properly, to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), i.e. (by implication) to sacrifice (properly, by fire, but genitive case); by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose):--kill, (do) sacrifice, slay.
G2380.outline:
- to sacrifice, immolate
- to slay, kill
- of the paschal lamb
- slaughter

G2381.gloss: of Chaldee origin (compare «08380»); the twin; Thomas, a Christian:--Thomas.
G2381.outline:
Thomas = "a twin"
- one of the apostles

G2382.gloss: of uncertain affinity; the chest ("thorax"), i.e. (by implication) a corslet:--breast-plate.
G2382.outline:
- the breast, the part of the body from the neck to the navel, where the ribs end
- a breastplate or corset consisting of two parts and protecting the body on both sides from the neck to the middle

G2383.gloss: of Hebrew origin («02971»); Jairus (i.e. Jair), an Israelite:--Jairus.
G2383.outline:

G2700.outline: - to shoot down or thrust through with an arrow

G2701.gloss: from «2596» and «5143»; to run down, i.e. hasten from a tower:--run down.

G2702.gloss: from «2596» and «5342» (including its alternate); to bear down, i.e. (figuratively) overcome (with drowsiness); specially, to cast a vote:--fall, give, sink down.
G2702.outline:
- to bear down, bring down, cast down
- to cast a pebble or calculus into the urn
- to give one's vote, to approve
- to be born down, to sink, (from the window to the pavement)
- metaph.
- to be weighted down by, overcome, carried away
- to sink into sleep, drop asleep

G2703.outline: - to flee away, flee for refuge

G2704.gloss: from «2596» and «5351»; to spoil entirely, i.e. (literally) to destroy; or (figuratively) to deprave; --corrupt, utterly perish.
G2704.outline:
- to corrupt, deprave
- corrupted in mind
- to destroy
- to be destroyed, to perish

G2705.outline: - to kiss much, kiss again and again, kiss tenderly

G2706.gloss: from «2596» and «5426»; to think against, i.e. disesteem:--despise.
G2706.outline: - to contemn, despise, disdain, think little or nothing of

G2708.gloss: from «2596» and cheo (to pour); to pour down (out):--pour.
G2708.outline:
- to pour down upon
- pour over, pour upon

G2709.gloss: from «2596» and chthon (the ground); subterranean, i.e. infernal (belonging to the world of departed spirits):--under the earth.
G2709.outline:
- subterranean
- refers to those who dwell in the world below, departed souls

G2710.gloss: from «2596» and «5530»; to overuse, i.e. misuse:--abuse.
G2710.outline:
- to use much or excessively or ill
- to use up, consume by use
- to use fully

G2711.gloss: from «2596» and «5594»; to cool down (off), i.e. refresh:--cool.

G2712.gloss: from «2596» (intensively) and «1497»; utterly idolatrous:--wholly given to idolatry.

G2713.gloss: from «2596» and «1725»; directly opposite:--before, over against.
G2713.outline:
- over against, opposite before
- metaph. before one i.e. he being judge

G2714.gloss: from «2596» and «1799»; directly in front of:--before (the presence of), in the sight of.
G2714.outline:
- over against, before the face of, before the presence of, in the sight of, before
- referring to places
- metaph.
- having one as it were before the eyes, before one as witness
- before God as judge

G2715.gloss: from «2596» and «1850»; to have (wield) full privilege over:--exercise authority.

G2716.gloss: from «2596» and «2038»; to work fully, i.e. accomplish; by implication, to finish, fashion:--cause, to (deed), perform, work (out).
G2716.outline:
- to perform, accomplish, achieve
- to work out i.e. to do that from which something results
- of things: bring about, result in
- to fashion i.e. render one fit for a thing

G2718.gloss: from «2596» and «2064» (including its alternate); to come (or go) down (literally or figuratively):--come (down), depart, descend, go down, land.
G2718.outline:
- to come down, go down
- of one who goes from a higher to a lower locality
- of those who come to a place by a ship

G2719.gloss: from «2596» and «2068» (including its alternate); to eat down, i.e. devour (literally or figuratively):--devour.
G2719.outline:
- to consume by eating, to eat up, devour
- of birds
- of a dragon
- of a man eating up the little book
- metaph.
- to devour i.e. squander, waste: substance
- to devour i.e. forcibly appropriate: widows' property
- to strip one of his goods
- to ruin (by the infliction of injuries)
- by fire, to devour i.e. to utterly consume, destroy
- of the consumption of the strength of body and mind by strong emotions

G2720.gloss: from «2596» and «2116»; to straighten fully, i.e. (figuratively) direct:--guide, direct.
G2720.outline:
- to make straight, guide, direct
- of the removal of the hindrances to coming to one

G2721.gloss: from «2596» and «2186»; to stand over against, i.e. rush upon (assault):--make insurrection against.

G2722.gloss: from «2596» and «2192»; to hold down (fast), in various applications (literally or figuratively):--have, hold (fast), keep (in memory), let, × make toward, possess, retain, seize on, stay, take, withhold.
G2722.outline:
- to hold back, detain, retain
- from going away
- to restrain, hinder (the course or progress of)
- that which hinders, Antichrist from making his appearance
- to check a ship's headway i.e. to hold or head the ship
- to hold fast, keep secure, keep firm possession of
- to get possession of, take
- to possess

G2723.gloss: from «2725»; to be a plaintiff, i.e. to charge with some offence:--accuse, object.
G2723.outline:
- to accuse
- before a judge: to make an accusation
- of an extra-judicial accusation

G2724.gloss: from «2725»; a complaint ("category"), i.e. criminal charge:--accusation (X -ed).

G2725.gloss: from «2596» and «58»; against one in the assembly, i.e. a complainant at law; specially, Satan:--accuser.
G2725.outline:
- an accuser
- a name given to the devil by the rabbis

G2726.gloss: from a compound of «2596» and perhaps a derivative of the base of «5316» (meaning downcast in look); demureness, i.e. (by implication) sadness:--heaviness.
G2726.outline:
- a downcast look expressive of sorrow
- shame, dejection, gloom

G2727.gloss: from «2596» and «2279»; to sound down into the ears, i.e. (by implication) to indoctrinate ("catechize") or (genitive case) to apprise of:--inform, instruct, teach.
G2727.outline:
- to sound towards, sound down upon, resound
- to charm with resounding sound, to fascinate
- to teach orally, to instruct
- to inform by word of mouth
- to be orally informed

G2728.gloss: from «2596» and a derivative of «2447»; to rust down, i.e. corrode:--canker.
G2728.outline: - to rust over, cover with rust

G2729.outline:
- to be strong to another's detriment, to prevail against
- to be superior in strength
- to overcome
- to prevail

G2730.gloss: from «2596» and «3611»; to house permanently, i.e. reside (literally or figuratively):--dwell(-er), inhabitant(-ter).
G2730.outline:
- to dwell, settle
- metaph. divine powers, influences, etc., are said to dwell in his soul, to pervade, prompt, govern it
- to dwell in, inhabit
- God is said to dwell in the temple, i.e. to be always present for worshippers

G2731.gloss: from «2730»; residence (properly, the act; but by implication, concretely, the mansion):--dwelling.

G2732.gloss: from a derivative of «2730»; a dwelling-place:--habitation.

G2733.gloss: residence (properly, the condition; but by implication, the abode itself):--habitation.
G2733.outline:
- dwelling, habitation
- to cause to dwell, to send or bring into an abode
- to give a dwelling to

G2734.gloss: middle voice from a compound of «2596» and a derivative of «3700» (compare «2072»); to mirror oneself, i.e. to see reflected (figuratively):--behold as in a glass.
G2734.outline:
- to show in a mirror, to make to reflect, to mirror
- to look at one's self in a mirror
- to behold one's self in a mirror

G2735.gloss: from a compound of «2596» and a derivative of «3717» (compare «1357»); something made fully upright, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (specially, good public administration):--very worthy deed.
G2735.outline:
- a right action, a successful achievement
- of wholesome public measures or institutions

G2736.gloss: (compare «2737»); adverb from «2596»; downwards:--beneath, bottom, down, under.

G2738.gloss: from «2545»; properly, a burn (concretely), but used (abstractly) of a glow:--heat.
G2738.outline:
- heat
- of painful and burning heat

G2739.outline:
- to burn with heat, to scorch
- to be tortured with intense heat

G2741.gloss: from «2740»; to set on fire:--fervent heat.
G2741.outline:
- to burn up, set fire to
- to suffer with feverish burning, be parched with fever

G2742.outline:
- burning heat
- of the sun
- Eurus, a very dry hot, east wind, scorching and drying up everything

G2743.gloss: from a derivative of «2545»; to brand ("cauterize"), i.e. (by implication) to render unsensitive (figuratively):--sear with a hot iron.
G2743.outline:
- to mark by branding, to brand, branded with their own consciences
- whose souls are branded with the marks of sin
- who carry about with them the perpetual consciousness of sin
- seared
- in a medical sense, to cauterise, remover by cautery

G2744.gloss: from some (obsolete) base akin to that of aucheo (to boast) and «2172»; to vaunt (in a good or a bad sense):--(make) boast, glory, joy, rejoice.
G2744.outline:
- to glory (whether with reason or without)
- to glory on account of a thing
- to glory in a thing

G2745.gloss: from «2744»; a boast (properly, the object; by implication, the act) in a good or a bad sense:--boasting, (whereof) to glory (of), glorying, rejoice(-ing).
G2745.outline:
- that of which one glories or can glory, matter or ground of glorying
- a glorying or boasting

G2746.gloss: from «2744»; boasting (properly, the act; by implication, the object), in a good or a bad sense:--boasting, whereof I may glory, glorying, rejoicing.

G2747.gloss: probably from kegchros (millet); Cenchreae, a port of Corinth:--Cencrea.
G2747.outline:
Cenchrea = "millet"
- the eastern harbour of Corinth (i.e. its harbour on the Saronic Gulf) and the emporium of its trade with the Asiatic shores of the Mediterranean, as Lechaeum on the Corinthian Gulf connected it with Italy and the west

G2748.gloss: of Hebrew origin («06939»); Cedron (i.e. Kidron), a brook near Jerusalem:--Cedron.
G2748.outline:
Cedron or Kidron = "turbid"
- the name of a winter torrent, rising near Jerusalem and flowing down through a valley of Kidron, having the Mount of Olives on the east, into the Dead Sea

G2749.gloss: middle voice of a primary verb; to lie outstretched (literally or figuratively):--be (appointed, laid up, made, set), lay, lie. Compare «5087».
G2749.outline:
- to lie
- of an infant
- of one buried
- of things that quietly cover some spot
- of a city situated on a hill
- of things put or set in any place, in ref. to which we often use "to stand"
- of vessels, of a throne, of the site of a city, of grain and other things laid up together, of a foundation
- metaph.
- to be (by God's intent) set, i.e. destined, appointed
- of laws, to be made, laid down
- lies in the power of the evil one, i.e. is held in subjection by the devil

G2750.gloss: of uncertain affinity; a swathe, i.e. winding-sheet:--graveclothes.
G2750.outline: - a band, either for bed-girth, or for tying up a corpse after it has been swathed in linen

G2751.outline:
- to sheer: a sheep
- to get or let be shorn
- of shearing or cutting short the hair of the head

G2752.outline: - an order, command, spec. a stimulating cry, either that by which animals are roused and urged on by man, as horses by charioteers, hounds by hunters, etc., or that by which a signal is given to men, e.g. to rowers by the master of a ship, to soldiers by a commander (with a loud summons, a trumpet call)

G2753.gloss: from a primary kello (to urge on); "hail"; to incite by word, i.e. order:--bid, (at, give) command(-ment).

G2754.outline:
- vain glory, groundless, self esteem, empty pride
- a vain opinion, error

G2755.gloss: from «2756» and «1391»; vainly glorifying, i.e. self-conceited:--desirous of vain-glory.
G2755.outline: - glorying without reason, conceited, vain glorious, eager for empty glory

G2756.gloss: apparently a primary word; empty (literally or figuratively):--empty, (in) vain.
G2756.outline:
- empty, vain, devoid of truth
- of places, vessels, etc. which contain nothing
- of men
- empty handed
- without a gift
- metaph. destitute of spiritual wealth, of one who boasts of his faith as a transcendent possession, yet is without the fruits of faith
- metaph. of endeavours, labours, acts, which result in nothing, vain, fruitless, without effect
- vain of no purpose

G2757.gloss: from a presumed compound of «2756» and «5456»; empty sounding, i.e. fruitless discussion:--vain.
G2757.outline: - empty discussion, discussion of vain and useless matters

G2758.gloss: from «2756»; to make empty, i.e. (figuratively) to abase, neutralize, falsify:--make (of none effect, of no reputation, void), be in vain.
G2758.outline:
- to empty, make empty
- of Christ, he laid aside equality with or the form of God
- to make void
- deprive of force, render vain, useless, of no effect
- to make void
- cause a thing to be seen to be empty, hollow, false

G2759.gloss: from kenteo (to prick); a point ("centre"), i.e. a sting (figuratively, poison) or goad (figuratively, divine impulse):--prick, sting.
G2759.outline:
- a sting, as that of bees, scorpions, locusts. Since animals wound by their sting and even cause death, Paul attributes death, personified as a sting, i.e. a deadly weapon
- an iron goad, for urging on oxen, horses and other beasts of burden
- hence the proverb, "to kick against the goad", i.e. to offer vain and perilous or ruinous resistance

G2760.gloss: of Latin origin; a centurion, i.e. captain of one hundred soldiers:--centurion.
G2760.outline: - centurion, an officer in the Roman army

G2761.gloss: adverb from «2756»; vainly, i.e. to no purpose:--in vain.

G2762.gloss: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of «2768»; something horn-like, i.e. (specially) the apex of a Hebrew letter (figuratively, the least particle):--tittle.
G2762.outline:
- a little horn
- extremity, apex, point
- used by grammarians of the accents and diacritical points. Jesus used it of the little lines or projections, by which the Hebrew letters in other respects similar differ from one another; the meaning is, "not even the minutest part of the law shall perish".

G2764.gloss: from «2766»; made of clay, i.e. earthen:--of a potter.
G2764.outline:
- of or belonging to a potter
- made of clay, earthen

G2765.gloss: neuter of a presumed derivative of «2766»; an earthenware vessel, i.e. jar:--pitcher.
G2765.outline:
- an earthen vessel, a pot, jar
- a jug or pitcher
- a water pitcher

G2766.gloss: probably from the base of «2767» (through the idea of mixing clay and water); earthenware, i.e. a tile (by analogy, a thin roof or awning):--tiling.
G2766.outline:
- clay, potter's earth
- anything made of clay, earthen ware
- a roofing tile
- the roof itself
- the phrase "through the roof", means through the door in the roof to which a ladder or stairway led up from the street (according to the Rabbis distinguish two ways of entering a house, "the way through the door" and "the way through the roof"

G2767.gloss: prolonged form of a more primary kerao ker-ah'-o (which is used in certain tenses); to mingle, i.e. (by implication) to pour out (for drinking):--fill, pour out. Compare «3396».
G2767.outline:
- to mix, mingle
- to mix wine, water
- to pour out for drinking.

G2768.gloss: from a primary kar (the hair of the head); a horn (literally or figuratively):--horn.
G2768.outline:
- a horn
- of animals
- since animals (esp. bulls) defend themselves with their horns, the horn with the Hebrews (and other nations) is a symbol of strength and courage, and used as such in a variety of phrases
- a mighty and valiant helper, the author of deliverance, of the Messiah
- a projecting extremity in a shape like a horn, a point, apex: as of an altar

G2769.gloss: neuter of a presumed derivative of «2768»; something horned, i.e. (specially) the pod of the carob-tree:--husk.
G2769.outline:
- a little horn
- the name of the fruit, Ceratonia silqua or carobtree (called also John's Bread [from the notion that its pods, which resemble those of the "locust", constituted the food of the Baptist]. This fruit was shaped like a horn and has a sweet taste; it was and is used not only for fattening swine, but as an article of food by the lower classes.

G2770.gloss: from «2771»; to gain (literally or figuratively):--(get) gain, win.
G2770.outline:
- to gain, acquire, to get gain
- metaph.
- of gain arising from shunning or escaping from evil (where we say "to spare one's self", "be spared")
- to gain any one i.e. to win him over to the kingdom of God, to gain one to faith in Christ
- to gain Christ's favour and fellowship

G2771.gloss: of uncertain affinity; gain (pecuniary or genitive case):--gain, lucre.

G2772.gloss: from «2751»; a clipping (bit), i.e. (specially) a coin:--money.
G2772.outline: - small pieces of money, small coin, change, money

G2773.gloss: from a derivative of «2772»; a handler of coins, i.e. money-broker:--changer of money.

G2774.gloss: neuter of a derivative of «2776»; a principal thing, i.e. main point; specially, an amount (of money):--sum.
G2774.outline:
- the chief or main point, the principal thing
- the pecuniary sum total of a reckoning, amount
- the principal, capital, as distinguished from the interest
- a sum of money, sum

G2775.gloss: from the same as «2774»; (specially) to strike on the head:--wound in the head.
G2775.outline:
- to bring under headings, to sum up, to summarise
- to smite or wound in the head, to smite on the cheek

G2776.gloss: from the primary kapto (in the sense of seizing); the head (as the part most readily taken hold of), literally or figuratively:--head.
G2776.outline:
- the head, both of men and often of animals. Since the loss of the head destroys life, this word is used in the phrases relating to capital and extreme punishment.
- metaph. anything supreme, chief, prominent
- of persons, master lord: of a husband in relation to his wife
- of Christ: the Lord of the husband and of the Church
- of things: the corner stone

G2777.gloss: from «2776»; properly, a knob, i.e. (by implication) a roll (by extension from the end of a stick on which the manuscript was rolled):--volume.
G2777.outline:
- a little head
- the highest part, extremity of anything
- as the capital of a column
- the tips or knobs of the wooden rod around which parchments were rolled were called by this word, because they resembled little heads
- the Alexandrian writers transferred the name to the roll or volume itself
- in the roll of the book

G2778.gloss: of Latin origin; properly, an enrollment ("census"), i.e. (by implication) a tax:--tribute.
G2778.outline:
- census (among the Romans, denoting a register and valuation of property in accordance with which taxes were paid), in the NT the tax or tribute levied on individuals and to be paid yearly. (our capitation or poll tax)
- the coin with which the tax is paid, tribute money

G2780.gloss: from «2779» and ouros (a warden); a garden-keeper, i.e. gardener:--gardener.
G2780.outline: - a keeper of a garden, a gardener

G2781.gloss: diminutive from keos (wax); a cell for honey, i.e. (collectively) the comb:--(honey-)comb.

G2782.gloss: from «2784»; a proclamation (especially of the gospel; by implication, the gospel itself):--preaching.
G2782.outline:
- that which is proclaimed by a herald or public crier, a proclamation by herald
- in the NT the message or proclamation of the heralds of God or Christ

G2783.gloss: from «2784»; a herald, i.e. of divine truth (especially of the gospel):--preacher.
G2783.outline: - a herald or messenger vested with public authority, who conveyed the official messages of kings, magistrates, princes, military commanders, or who gave a public summons or demand, and performed various other duties. In the NT God's ambassador, and the herald or proclaimer of the divine word.

G2784.gloss: of uncertain affinity; to herald (as a public crier), especially divine truth (the gospel):--preacher(-er), proclaim, publish.
G2784.outline:
- to be a herald, to officiate as a herald
- to proclaim after the manner of a herald
- always with the suggestion of formality, gravity and an authority which must be listened to and obeyed
- to publish, proclaim openly: something which has been done
- used of the public proclamation of the gospel and matters pertaining to it, made by John the Baptist, by Jesus, by the apostles and other Christian teachers

G2785.gloss: probably from the base of «5490»; a huge fish (as gaping for prey):--whale.
G2785.outline: - a sea monster, whale, huge fish

G2786.gloss: of Chaldee origin (compare «03710»); the Rock; Cephas (i.e. Kepha), a surname of Peter:--Cephas.
G2786.outline:
Cephas = "stone"
- another name for the apostle Peter

G2787.gloss: of uncertain derivation; a box, i.e. the sacred ark and that of Noah:--ark.
G2787.outline:
- a wooden chest or box
- in the NT the ark of the covenant, in the temple at Jerusalem
- of Noah's vessel built in the form of an ark

G2788.outline: - a harp to which praises of God are sung in heaven

G2789.gloss: from «2788»; to play on a lyre:--harp.

G2790.gloss: from «2788» and a derivative of the same as «5603»; a lyre-singer(-player), i.e. harpist:--harper.
G2790.outline: - a harper, one who plays the harp and accompanies it with his voice

G2791.gloss: probably of foreign origin; Cilicia, a region of Asia Minor:--Cilicia.
G2791.outline:
Cilicia = "the land of Celix"
- a maritime province in the southeast of Asia Minor, boarding on Pamphylia in the west, Lycaonia and Cappadocia in the north and Syria in the east. Its capital, Tarsus, was the birth place of Paul

G2792.outline: - cinnamon was a well known aromatic substance, the rind of "Laurus cinnamonum" called "Korunda-gauhah" in Ceylon

G2793.gloss: from «2794»; to undergo peril:--be in danger, be (stand) in jeopardy.
G2793.outline: - to be in jeopardy, to be in danger, to put in peril

G2795.gloss: from kio (poetic for eimi, to go); to stir (transitively), literally or figuratively:--(re-)move(-r), way.
G2795.outline:
- to cause to go, i.e. to move, set in motion
- to be moved, move: of that motion which is evident in life
- to move from a place, to remove
- metaph.
- to move excite
- a riot, disturbance
- to throw into commotion

G2797.gloss: of Hebrew origin («07027»); Cis (i.e. Kish), an Israelite:--Cis.
G2797.outline:
Kish = "a snare"
- the father of Saul, the first king of Israel

G2798.outline:
- a young tender shoot, broken off for grafting
- a branch
- as the Jewish patriarchs are likened to a root, so their posterity are likened to branches

G2799.gloss: of uncertain affinity; to sob, i.e. wail aloud (whereas 1145 is rather to cry silently):--bewail, weep.
G2799.outline:
- to mourn, weep, lament
- weeping as the sign of pain and grief for the thing signified (i.e. for the pain and grief)
- of those who mourn for the dead
- to weep for, mourn for, bewail, one

G2801.outline:
- a fragment, broken piece
- remnants of food

G2802.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Claude, an island near Crete:--Clauda.
G2802.outline:
Clauda = "lame"
- a small island nearly due west of Cape Malta on the south coast of Crete, and nearly due south of Phoenice

G2803.gloss: feminine of «2804»; Claudia, a Christian woman:--Claudia.

G2804.gloss: of Latin origin; Claudius, the name of two Romans:--Claudius.
G2804.outline:
Claudius = "lame"
- C. Caesar the name of the fourth Roman emperor, who came to power in 41 A.D. and was poisoned by his wife Agrippina, in 54 A.D.
- C. Lysias a tribune of the Roman cohort who rescued Paul from the hands of the mob at Jerusalem

G2806.gloss: a primary verb; to break (specially, of bread):--break.
G2806.outline:
- to break
- used in the NT of the breaking of bread or communion

G2807.gloss: from «2808»; a key (as shutting a lock), literally or figuratively:--key.
G2807.outline:
- a key
- since the keeper of the keys has the power to open and to shut
- metaph. in the NT to denote power and authority of various kinds

G2808.gloss: a primary verb; to close (literally or figuratively):--shut (up).
G2808.outline:
- to shut, shut up
- metaph.
- to cause the heavens to withhold rain
- to shut up compassion so that it is like a thing inaccessible to one, to be devoid of pity towards one
- to obstruct the entrance into the kingdom of heaven

G2809.gloss: from «2813»; stealing (properly, the thing stolen, but used of the act):--theft.
G2809.outline:
- thing stolen
- the act of theft

G2810.gloss: probably contracted from Kleopatros (compound of «2811» and «3962»); Cleopas, a Christian:--Cleopas.
G2810.outline:
Cleopas = "of a renowned father"
- one of the two disciples who were going to Emmaus on the day of the resurrection

G2811.gloss: from a shorter form of «2564»; renown (as if being called):--glory.

G2812.gloss: from «2813»; a stealer (literally or figuratively):--thief. Compare «3027».
G2812.outline:
- an embezzler, pilferer
- the name is transferred to false teachers, who do not care to instruct men, but abuse their confidence for their own gain

G2813.outline:
- to steal
- to commit a theft
- take away by theft i.e take away by stealth

G2814.gloss: from «2806»; a limb or shoot (as if broken off):--branch.
G2814.outline:
- a tender and flexible branch
- spec. the shoot or branch of a vine, a vine sprout

G2815.gloss: of Latin origin; merciful; Clemes (i.e. Clemens), a Christian:--Clement.
G2815.outline:
Clement = "mild, merciful"
- a companion of Paul and apparently a member of the church of Philippi. According to tradition, he is identical with that Clement who was bishop of Rome towards the close of the first century.

G2816.gloss: from «2818»; to be an heir to (literally or figuratively):--be heir, (obtain by) inherit(-ance).
G2816.outline:
- to receive a lot, receive by lot
- esp. to receive a part of an inheritance, receive as an inheritance, obtain by right of inheritance
- to be an heir, to inherit
- to receive the portion assigned to one, receive an allotted portion, receive as one's own or as a possession
- to become partaker of, to obtain

G2817.gloss: from «2818»; heirship, i.e. (concretely) a patrimony or (genitive case) a possession:--inheritance.
G2817.outline:
- an inheritance, property received (or to be received) by inheritance
- what is given to one as a possession
- the eternal blessedness of the consummated kingdom of God which is to be expected after the visible return of Christ
- the share which an individual will have in that eternal blessedness

G2818.gloss: from «2819» and the base of «3551» (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. (reflexively) getting by apportionment); a sharer by lot, i.e. inheritor (literally or figuratively); by implication, a possessor:--heir.
G2818.outline:
- one who receives by lot, an heir
- an heir
- in Messianic usage, one who receives his allotted possession by right of sonship
- one who has acquired or obtained the portion allotted to him

G2819.gloss: probably from «2806» (through the idea of using bits of wood, etc., for the purpose; a die (for drawing chances); by implication, a portion (as if so secured); by extension, an acquisition (especially a patrimony, figuratively):--heritage, inheritance, lot, part.
G2819.outline:
- an object used in casting or drawing lots, which was either a pebble, or a potsherd, or a bit of wood
- the lots of several persons concerned, inscribed with their names, were thrown together into a vase, which was then shaken, and he whose lot fell out first upon the ground was the one chosen
- what is obtained by lot, allotted portion
- a portion of the ministry common to the apostles
- used of the part which one will have in eternal salvation
- of salvation itself
- the eternal salvation which God has assigned to the saints
- of persons
- those whose care and oversight has been assigned to one [allotted charge], used of Christian churches, the administration of which falls to the lot of presbyters

G2820.gloss: from «2819»; to allot, i.e. (figuratively) to assign (a privilege):--obtain an inheritance.
G2820.outline:
- to cast lots, determine by lot
- to choose by lot
- to allot, assign by lot
- on to another as a possession
- in NT: to make a lot, i.e. a heritage, private possession

G2821.gloss: from a shorter form of «2564»; an invitation (figuratively):--calling.
G2821.outline:
- a calling, calling to
- a call, invitation
- to a feast
- of the divine invitation to embrace salvation of God

G2822.gloss: from the same as «2821»; invited, i.e. appointed, or (specially), a saint:--called.
G2822.outline:
- called, invited (to a banquet)
- invited (by God in the proclamation of the Gospel) to obtain eternal salvation in the kingdom through Christ
- called to (the discharge of) some office
- divinely selected and appointed

G2823.gloss: of uncertain derivation; an earthen pot used for baking in:--oven.
G2823.outline:
- a clibanus, a earthen vessel for baking bread. It was broader at the bottom than above at the orifice, and when sufficiently heated by a fire kindled within, the dough was baked by being spread upon the outside. [but according to others, the dough was baked by being placed inside and the fire or coals outside, the vessel being perforated with small holes that the heat might better penetrate.
- a furnace, oven

G2824.gloss: from «2827»; a slope, i.e. (specially) a "clime" or tract of country:--part, region.
G2824.outline:
- an inclination, slope, declivity
- the [supposed] sloping of the earth from the equator towards the poles, a zone
- a tract of land, a region

G2825.gloss: from «2827»; a couch (for sleep, sickness, sitting or eating):--bed, table.
G2825.outline:
- a small bed, a couch
- a couch to recline on at meals
- a couch on which a sick man is carried

G2826.gloss: neuter of a presumed derivative of «2825»; a pallet or little couch:--bed.

G2827.gloss: a primary verb; to slant or slope, i.e. incline or recline (literally or figuratively):--bow (down), be far spent, lay, turn to flight, wear away.
G2827.outline:
- transitively
- to incline, bow
- to cause to fall back
- to recline
- in a place for repose
- intransitively
- to incline one's self
- of the declining of the day

G2828.gloss: from a derivative of «2827»; properly, reclination, i.e. (concretely and specially), a party at a meal:--company.
G2828.outline:
- a hut erected to pass the night in
- a tent
- anything to recline on
- a chair in which to lean back the head
- a reclining chair
- a company reclining
- a row or party of persons reclining at meal

G2830.gloss: from kluzo (to billow or dash over); a surge of the sea (literally or figuratively):--raging, wave.
G2830.outline: - a dashing or surging wave, a surge, a violent agitation of the sea

G2831.gloss: middle voice from «2830»; to surge, i.e. (figuratively) to fluctuate:--toss to and fro.
G2831.outline:
- to be tossed by the waves
- metaph. to be agitated (like the waves) mentally

G2832.gloss: of Chaldee origin (corresponding to «0256»); Clopas, an Israelite:--Cleophas.
G2832.outline:
Cleophas = "my exchanges"
- the father of James the less, the husband of Mary the sister of the mother of Jesus

G2833.gloss: from a primary knao (to scrape); to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to tickle:--X itching.
G2833.outline:
- to scratch, tickle, make to itch
- to itch
- desirous of hearing something pleasant

G2834.gloss: probably of foreign origin; Cnidus, a place in Asia Minor:--Cnidus.
G2834.outline:
Cnidus or Gnidus = "nettled"
- a peninsula [now Cape Crio] and a city by the same name, situated at the extreme south west of the peninsula of Asia Minor, on a promontory now called Cape Crio, which projects between the islands of Cos and Rhodes

G2835.gloss: of Latin origin; a quadrans, i.e. the fourth part of an as:--farthing.
G2835.outline: - a quadrans (about the fourth part of an "as"); in the NT a coin equal to one half the Attic chalcus worth about 3/8 of a cent

G2836.gloss: from koilos ("hollow"); a cavity, i.e. (especially) the abdomen; by implication, the matrix; figuratively, the heart:--belly, womb.
G2836.outline:
- the whole belly, the entire cavity
- the upper [i.e. stomach] and the lower belly are distinguished
- the lower belly, the lower region, the receptacle of the excrement
- the gullet
- to be given up to the pleasures of the palate, to gluttony
- the womb, the place where the foetus is conceived and nourished until birth
- of the uterus of animals
- the innermost part of a man, the soul, heart as the seat of thought, feeling, choice

G2837.gloss: from «2749»; to put to sleep, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to slumber; figuratively, to decease:--(be a-, fall a-, fall on) sleep, be dead.
G2837.outline:
- to cause to sleep, put to sleep
- metaph.
- to still, calm, quiet
- to fall asleep, to sleep
- to die

G2838.gloss: from «2837»; sleeping, i.e. (by implication) repose:--taking of rest.
G2838.outline:
- a reposing, taking rest
- a lying, reclining

G2839.gloss: probably from «4862»; common, i.e. (literally) shared by all or several, or (ceremonially) profane:--common, defiled, unclean, unholy.
G2839.outline:
- common
- common i.e. ordinary, belonging to generality
- by the Jews, unhallowed, profane, Levitically unclean

G2840.gloss: from «2839»; to make (or consider) profane (ceremonially):--call common, defile, pollute, unclean.
G2840.outline:
- to make common
- to make (Levitically) unclean, render unhallowed, defile, profane
- to declare or count unclean

G2841.gloss: from «2844»; to share with others (objectively or subjectively):--communicate, distribute, be partaker.
G2841.outline:
- to come into communion or fellowship with, to become a sharer, be made a partner
- to enter into fellowship, join one's self to an associate, make one's self a sharer or partner

G2842.gloss: from «2844»; partnership, i.e. (literally) participation, or (social) intercourse, or (pecuniary) benefaction:--(to) communicate(-ation), communion, (contri-)distribution, fellowship.
G2842.outline:
- fellowship, association, community, communion, joint participation, intercourse
- the share which one has in anything, participation
- intercourse, fellowship, intimacy
- the right hand as a sign and pledge of fellowship (in fulfilling the apostolic office)
- a gift jointly contributed, a collection, a contribution, as exhibiting an embodiment and proof of fellowship

G2843.gloss: from «2844»; communicative, i.e. (pecuniarily) liberal:--willing to communicate.
G2843.outline:
- social, sociable, ready and apt to form and maintain communion and fellowship
- inclined to make others sharers in one's possessions, inclined to impart, free in giving, liberal

G2844.gloss: from «2839»; a sharer, i.e. associate:--companion, × fellowship, partaker, partner.
G2844.outline:
- a partner, associate, comrade, companion
- a partner, sharer, in anything
- of the altar in Jerusalem on which the sacrifices are offered
- sharing in the worship of the Jews
- partakers of (or with) demons
- brought into fellowship with them, because they are the authors of heathen worship

G2845.gloss: from «2749»; a couch; by extension, cohabitation; by implication, the male sperm:--bed, chambering, × conceive.
G2845.outline:
- a place for laying down, resting, sleeping in
- a bed, couch
- the marriage bed
- of adultery
- cohabitation, whether lawful or unlawful
- sexual intercourse

G2846.outline:
- a sleeping room, bed chamber
- the officer who is over the bed chamber, the chamberlain

G2847.gloss: from «2848» (from the kernel-shape of the insect); crimson-colored:--scarlet (colour, coloured).
G2847.outline:
- crimson, scarlet coloured. A kernel, the grain or berry of the "ilex coccifera"; these berries are the clusters of the eggs of a female insect, the "kermes" (resembling the cochineal), and when collected and pulverised produces a red which was used in dyeing (Pliny)
- scarlet cloth or clothing

G2848.gloss: apparently a primary word; a kernel of seed:--corn, grain.

G2849.gloss: from kolos (dwarf); properly, to curtail, i.e. (figuratively) to chastise (or reserve for infliction):--punish.
G2849.outline:
- to lop or prune, as trees and wings
- to curb, check, restrain
- to chastise, correct, punishment
- to cause to be punished

G2850.gloss: from a derivative of kolax (a fawner); flattery:--X flattering.

G2852.gloss: from a derivative of the base of «2849»; to rap with the fist:--buffet.
G2852.outline:
- to strike with the fist, give one a blow with the fist
- to maltreat, treat with violence and contumely

G2853.gloss: from kolla ("glue"); to glue, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to stick (figuratively):--cleave, join (self), keep company.
G2853.outline:
- to glue, to glue together, cement, fasten together
- to join or fasten firmly together
- to join one's self to, cleave to

G2854.gloss: neuter of a presumed derivative of kollura (a cake; prob akin to the base of «2853»); properly, a poultice (as made of or in the form of crackers), i.e. (by analogy) a plaster:-- eyesalve.
G2854.outline: - a preparation composed of various materials and used as a remedy for tender eyelids

G2855.gloss: from a presumed derivative of kollubos (a small coin; probably akin to «2854»); a coin-dealer:--(money-)changer.

G2856.gloss: from a derivative of the base of «2849»; to dock, i.e. (figuratively) abridge:--shorten.
G2856.outline:
- to mutilate
- in NT: to shorten, abridge, curtail

G2857.gloss: apparently feminine plural of kolossos ("colossal"); Colossae, a place in Asia Minor:--Colosse.
G2857.outline:
Colosse = "monstrosities"
- anciently a large and flourishing city, but in Strabo's time a small town of Phrygia Major situated on the Lycus not far from its junction with the Maeander and in the neighbourhood of Laodicea and Hierapolis

G2858.gloss: from «2857»; a Colossaean, (i.e. inhabitant of Colossae:--Colossian.

G2859.gloss: apparently a primary word; the bosom; by analogy, a bay:--bosom, creek.
G2859.outline:
- the front of the body between the arms
- the bosom of a garment, i.e. the hollow formed by the upper forepart of a rather loose garment bound by a girdle or sash, used for keeping and carrying things (the fold or pocket)
- a bay of the sea

G2860.gloss: from kolumbos (a diver); to plunge into water:--swim.

G2861.gloss: a diving-place, i.e. pond for bathing (or swimming):--pool.
G2861.outline: - a place for diving, a swimming hole, a reservoir or pool for bathing

G2862.gloss: of Latin origin; a Roman "colony" for veterans:--colony.
G2862.outline:
- a colony
- the city of Philippi is so called, where Octavius had planted a Roman colony

G2863.gloss: from «2864»; to wear tresses of hair:--have long hair.
G2863.outline: - to let the hair grow, have long hair

G2864.gloss: apparently from the same as «2865»; the hair of the head (locks, as ornamental, and thus differing from «2359»; which properly denotes merely the scalp):--hair.

G2865.gloss: from a primary komeo (to tend, i.e. take care of); properly, to provide for, i.e. (by implication) to carry off (as if from harm; genitive case obtain):--bring, receive.
G2865.outline:
- to care for, take care of, provide for
- to take up or carry away in order to care for and preserve
- to carry away, bear off
- to carry, bear, bring to, to carry away for one's self, to carry off what is one's own, to bring back
- to receive, obtain: the promised blessing
- to receive what was previously one's own, to get back, receive back, recover

G2866.gloss: neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of 2865 (meaning, properly, well dressed, i.e. nice); figuratively, convalescent:--+ began to amend.

G2867.gloss: from konia (dust; by analogy, lime); to whitewash:--whiten.
G2867.outline:
- to cover with lime, plaster over, whitewash
- the Jews were accustomed to whitewash the entrances to their sepulchres, as a warning against defilement by touching them
- term applied to a hypocrite who conceals his malice under an outward assumption of piety

G2868.gloss: from the base of «2867» and ornumi (to "rouse"); pulverulence (as blown about):--dust.

G2869.gloss: from «2873»; to tire, i.e. (figuratively) to relax:--cease.
G2869.outline:
- to grow weary or tired
- to cease from violence, cease raging

G2870.gloss: from «2875»; mourning (properly, by beating the breast):--lamentation.
G2870.outline: - lamentation with beating of the breast as a sign of grief

G2871.outline:
- the act of cutting, a cut
- a cutting in pieces, slaughter

G2872.gloss: from a derivative of «2873»; to feel fatigue; by implication, to work hard:--(bestow) labour, toil, be wearied.
G2872.outline:
- to grow weary, tired, exhausted (with toil or burdens or grief)
- to labour with wearisome effort, to toil
- of bodily labour

G2873.gloss: from «2875»; a cut, i.e. (by analogy) toil (as reducing the strength), literally or figuratively; by implication, pains:--labour, + trouble, weariness.
G2873.outline:
- a beating
- a beating of the breast with grief, sorrow
- labour
- trouble
- to cause one trouble, make work for him
- intense labour united with trouble and toil

G2874.gloss: from kopros (ordure; perhaps akin to «2875»); manure:--dung(-hill).

G2875.gloss: a primary verb; to "chop"; specially, to beat the breast in grief:--cut down, lament, mourn, (be-)wail. Compare the base of «5114».
G2875.outline:
- to cut, strike, smite
- to cut from, cut off
- to beat one's breast for grief

G2876.gloss: perhaps from «2880»; a crow (from its voracity):--raven.

G2877.gloss: neuter of a presumed derivative of kore (a maiden); a (little) girl:--damsel, maid.

G2878.gloss: of Hebrew and Chaldee origin respectively («07133»); a votive offering and the offering; a consecrated present (to the Temple fund); by extension (the latter term) the Treasury itself, i.e. the room where the contribution boxes stood:--Corban, treasury.
G2878.outline:
- a gift offered (or to be offered) to God
- the sacred treasury

G2879.gloss: of Hebrew origin («07141»); Core (i.e. Korach), an Israelite:--Core.
G2879.outline:
Korah = "baldness"
- a man who, with others, rebelled against Moses

G2880.gloss: a primary verb; to cram, i.e. glut or sate:--eat enough, full.

G2881.gloss: from «2882»; a Corinthian, i.e. inhabitant of Corinth:--Corinthian.
G2881.outline: - a Corinthian, and inhabitant of Corinth

G2882.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Corinthus, a city of Greece:--Corinth.
G2882.outline:
Corinth = "satiated"
- an ancient and famous city of Greece, on the Isthmus of Corinth, and about 40 miles (65 km) west of Athens

G2883.gloss: of Latin origin; Cornelius, a Roman:--Cornelius.
G2883.outline:
Cornelius = "of a horn"
- a Roman centurion of the Italian cohort stationed in Caesarea who converted to Christianity

G2884.gloss: of Hebrew origin («03734»); a cor, i.e. a specific measure:--measure.
G2884.outline: - a corus or cor, the largest Hebrew dry measure (i.e, for wheat, meal etc.) about 10 to 11 bushels (350 to 400 l)

G2885.gloss: from «2889»; to put in proper order, i.e. decorate (literally or figuratively); specially, to snuff (a wick):--adorn, garnish, trim.
G2885.outline:
- to put in order, arrange, make ready, prepare
- to ornament, adore
- metaph. to embellish with honour, gain honour

G2886.gloss: from «2889» (in its secondary sense); terrene ("cosmic"), literally (mundane) or figuratively (corrupt):--worldly.
G2886.outline:
- of or belonging to the world
- relating to the universe
- earthly
- worldly, i.e. having the character of this present corrupt age

G2887.gloss: from «2889» (in its primary sense); orderly, i.e. decorous:--of good behaviour, modest.

G2888.gloss: from «2889» and «2902»; a world-ruler, an epithet of Satan:--ruler.
G2888.outline:
- lord of the world, prince of this age
- the devil and his demons

G2889.gloss: probably from the base of «2865»; orderly arrangement, i.e. decoration; by implication, the world (in a wide or narrow sense, including its inhabitants, literally or figuratively (morally)):--adorning, world.
G2889.outline:
- an apt and harmonious arrangement or constitution, order, government
- ornament, decoration, adornment, i.e. the arrangement of the stars, 'the heavenly hosts', as the ornament of the heavens. 1 Pet. 3:
- the world, the universe
- the circle of the earth, the earth
- the inhabitants of the earth, men, the human family
- the ungodly multitude; the whole mass of men alienated from God, and therefore hostile to the cause of Christ
- world affairs, the aggregate of things earthly
- the whole circle of earthly goods, endowments riches, advantages, pleasures, etc, which although hollow and frail and fleeting, stir desire, seduce from God and are obstacles to the cause of Christ
- any aggregate or general collection of particulars of any sort
- the Gentiles as contrasted to the Jews (Rom. 11:12 etc)
- of believers only, John 1:29; 3:16; 3:17; 6:33; 12:47 1 Cor. 4:9; 2 Cor. 5:19

G2890.gloss: of Latin origin (fourth); Quartus, a Christian:--Quartus.
G2890.outline:
Quartus = "fourth"
- a Roman; probably before he lived at Rome, and therefore sends his salutations to the Christians there: he is mentioned among the seventy disciples, and said to be bishop of Berytus. (Gill)

G2892.gloss: of Latin origin; "custody", i.e. a Roman sentry:--watch.
G2892.outline: - guard: used of Roman soldiers guarding the sepulchre of Christ

G2893.gloss: from kouphos (light in weight); to unload:--lighten.
G2893.outline:
- to be light
- to lighten
- a ship by throwing the cargo overboard

G2895.gloss: probably of foreign origin; a mattress:--bed.
G2895.outline: - a pallet, camp bed (a rather simple bed holding only one person)

G2896.gloss: a primary verb; properly, to "croak" (as a raven) or scream, i.e. (genitive case) to call aloud (shriek, exclaim, intreat):--cry (out).
G2896.outline:
- to croak
- of the cry of a raven
- hence, to cry out, cry aloud, vociferate
- to cry or pray for vengeance
- to cry
- cry out aloud, speak with a loud voice

G2897.gloss: probably from the same as «726»; properly, a headache (as a seizure of pain) from drunkenness, i.e. (by implication) a debauch (by analogy, a glut):--surfeiting.
G2897.outline: - the giddiness and headache caused by drinking wine to excess

G2898.gloss: diminutive of a derivative of the base of «2768»; a skull ("cranium"):--Calvary, skull.

G2899.gloss: of uncertain derivation; a margin, i.e. (specially), a fringe or tassel:--border, hem.
G2899.outline:
- the extremity or prominent part of a thing, edge, skirt, margin
- the fringe of a garment
- in the NT a little appendage hanging down from the edge of the mantle or cloak, made of twisted wool
- a tassel, tuft: the Jews had such appendages attached to their mantles to remind them of the law

G2900.outline:
- mighty
- of the mighty power of God

G2901.gloss: from «2900»; to empower, i.e. (passively) increase in vigor:--be strengthened, be (wax) strong.
G2901.outline:
- to strengthen, make strong
- to be made strong, to increase in strength, to grow strong

G2902.gloss: from «2904»; to use strength, i.e. seize or retain (literally or figuratively):--hold (by, fast), keep, lay hand (hold) on, obtain, retain, take (by).
G2902.outline:
- to have power, be powerful
- to be chief, be master of, to rule
- to get possession of
- to become master of, to obtain
- to take hold of
- to take hold of, take, seize
- to lay hands on one in order to get him into one's power
- to hold
- to hold in the hand
- to hold fast, i.e. not discard or let go
- to keep carefully and faithfully
- to continue to hold, to retain
- of death continuing to hold one
- to hold in check, restrain

G2903.gloss: superlative of a derivative of «2904»; strongest, i.e. (in dignity) very honorable:--most excellent (noble).
G2903.outline:
- mightiest, strongest, noblest, most illustrious, best, most excellent
- used in addressing men of prominent rank or office

G2904.gloss: perhaps a primary word; vigor ("great") (literally or figuratively):--dominion, might(-ily), power, strength.
G2904.outline:
- force, strength
- power, might: mighty with great power
- a mighty deed, a work of power
- dominion

G2905.outline: - to cry out, cry aloud, to shout, to cry out to one

G2906.gloss: from «2896»; an outcry (in notification, tumult or grief):--clamour, cry(-ing).

G2908.gloss: neuter of an alternate form of «2909»; (as noun) better, i.e. greater advantage:--better.

G2909.gloss: comparative of a derivative of «2904»; stronger, i.e. (figuratively) better, i.e. nobler:--best, better.
G2909.outline:
- more useful, more serviceable, more advantageous
- more excellent

G2910.gloss: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to hang:--hang.
G2910.outline:
- to hang up, suspend
- to be suspended, to hang
- used of one hanging on a cross
- used of the Law and the Prophets, they is summed up or hanging on two precepts

G2911.gloss: from «2910»; overhanging, i.e. a precipice:--steep place.

G2912.gloss: from «2914»; a Cretan, i.e. inhabitant of Crete:--Crete, Cretian.
G2912.outline: - a Cretan, an inhabitant of the island of Crete

G2913.gloss: of Latin origin; growing; Cresces (i.e. Crescens), a Christian:--Crescens.
G2913.outline:
Crescens = "growing"
- an assistant of Paul, said to be one of the seventy disciples

G2914.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Crete, an island in the Mediterranean:--Crete.
G2914.outline:
Crete = "fleshy"
- the largest and most fertile island of the Mediterranean archipelago or Aegean Sea, now the modern Candia

G2917.gloss: from «2919»; a decision (the function or the effect, for or against ("crime")):--avenge, condemned, condemnation, damnation, + go to law, judgment.
G2917.outline:
- a decree, judgments
- judgment
- condemnation of wrong, the decision (whether severe or mild) which one passes on the faults of others
- in a forensic sense
- the sentence of a judge
- the punishment with which one is sentenced
- condemnatory sentence, penal judgment, sentence
- a matter to be judicially decided, a lawsuit, a case in court

G2918.gloss: perhaps a prim word; a lily:--lily.

G2919.gloss: properly, to distinguish, i.e. decide (mentally or judicially); by implication, to try, condemn, punish:--avenge, conclude, condemn, damn, decree, determine, esteem, judge, go to (sue at the) law, ordain, call in question, sentence to, think.
G2919.outline:
- to separate, put asunder, to pick out, select, choose
- to approve, esteem, to prefer
- to be of opinion, deem, think, to be of opinion
- to determine, resolve, decree
- to judge
- to pronounce an opinion concerning right and wrong
- to be judged, i.e. summoned to trial that one's case may be examined and judgment passed upon it
- to pronounce judgment, to subject to censure
- of those who act the part of judges or arbiters in matters of common life, or pass judgment on the deeds and words of others
- to rule, govern
- to preside over with the power of giving judicial decisions, because it was the prerogative of kings and rulers to pass judgment
- to contend together, of warriors and combatants
- to dispute
- in a forensic sense
- to go to law, have suit at law

G2920.gloss: decision (subjectively or objectively, for or against); by extension, a tribunal; by implication, justice (especially, divine law):--accusation, condemnation, damnation, judgment.

- selection
- judgment

- the college of judges (a tribunal of seven men in the several cities of Palestine; as distinguished from the Sanhedrin, which had its seat at Jerusalem)
- right, justice

G2921.gloss: of Latin origin; "crisp"; Crispus, a Corinthian:--Crispus.
G2921.outline:

- the ruler of the Jewish synagogue in Corinth, baptised by Paul

G2922.gloss: neuter of a presumed derivative of «2923»; a rule of judging ("criterion"), i.e. (by implication) a tribunal:--to judge, judgment (seat).
G2922.outline:

- the rule by which one judges
- the place where judgment is given
- the tribunal of a judge

- the matter judged, thing to be decided, suit, case

G2923.gloss: from «2919»; a judge (genitive case or specially):--judge.
G2923.outline:
- one who passes or arrogates to himself, judgment on anything
- an arbiter
- of a Roman procurator administering justice
- of God passing judgment on men
- of the leaders or rulers of the Israelites

G2924.outline: - relating to judging, fit for judging, skilled in judging

G2925.gloss: apparently a primary verb; to rap:--knock.

G2926.gloss: feminine of «2927»; a hidden place, i.e. cellar ("crypt"):--secret.
G2926.outline: - crypt, a covered way, vault, cellar

G2927.gloss: from «2928»; concealed, i.e. private:--hid(-den), inward(-ly), secret.
