G2929.gloss: from «2930»; to make (i.e. intransitively, resemble) ice ("crystallize"):--be clear as crystal.
G2929.outline:
- to be of crystalline brightness and transparency
- to shine like crystal

G2930.gloss: from a derivative of kruos (frost); ice, i.e. (by analogy) rock "crystal":--crystal.
G2930.outline: - crystal, a kind of precious stone

G2932.gloss: a primary verb; to get, i.e. acquire (by any means; own):--obtain, possess, provide, purchase.
G2932.outline:
- to acquire, get, or procure a thing for one's self, to possess
- to marry a wife

G2933.outline:
- a possession
- of property, lands, estates

G2934.gloss: from «2932»; property, i.e. (specially) a domestic animal:--beast.
G2934.outline:
- a beast
- esp. a beast of burden
- used for four legged animals as opposed to fishes and birds

G2936.gloss: probably akin to «2932» (through the idea of proprietorship of the manufacturer); to fabricate, i.e. found (form originally):--create, Creator, make.
G2936.outline:
- to make habitable, to people, a place, region, island
- to found a city, colony, state
- to create
- of God creating the worlds
- to form, shape, i.e. to completely change or transform

G2937.gloss: from «2936»; original formation (properly, the act; by implication, the thing, literally or figuratively):--building, creation, creature, ordinance.
G2937.outline:
- the act of founding, establishing, building etc
- the act of creating, creation
- creation i.e. thing created
- of individual things, beings, a creature, a creation 1b
- anything created 1b
- after a rabbinical usage (by which a man converted from idolatry to Judaism was called) 1b
- the sum or aggregate of things created
- institution, ordinance

G2938.gloss: from «2936»; an original formation (concretely), i.e. product (created thing):--creature.

G2939.gloss: from «2936»; a founder, i.e. God (as author of all things):--Creator.

G2940.gloss: from kubos (a "cube", i.e. die for playing); gambling, i.e. (figuratively) artifice or fraud:--sleight.
G2940.outline:
- dice playing
- metaph. the deception of men, because dice players sometimes cheated and defrauded their fellow players

G2941.gloss: from kubernao (of Latin origin, to steer); pilotage, i.e. (figuratively) directorship (in the church):--government.

G2942.gloss: from the same as «2941»; helmsman, i.e. (by implication) captain:--(ship) master.

G2943.gloss: adverb from the same as «2945»; from the circle, i.e. all around:--(round) about.
G2943.outline: - round about, from all sides, all around

G2944.gloss: from the same as «2945»; to encircle, i.e. surround:--compass (about), come (stand) round about.
G2944.outline:
- to go around, lead around
- to surround, encircle, encompass
- of persons standing around
- of besiegers

G2945.gloss: as if dative case of kuklos (a ring, "cycle"; akin to «2947»); i.e. in a circle (by implication, of «1722»), i.e. (adverbially) all around:--round about.
G2945.outline: - in a circle, around, round about, on all sides

G2946.gloss: from «2947»; a wallow (the effect of rolling), i.e. filth:--wallowing.
G2946.outline: - thing rolled, rolled (wallowed) mud or mire

G2947.gloss: from the base of «2949» (through the idea of circularity; compare «2945», «1507»); to roll about:--wallow.
G2947.outline:
- a rolling, wallowing
- to roll itself in mud
- to wallowing in the mire

G2948.gloss: from the same as «2947»; rocking about, i.e. crippled (maimed, in feet or hands):--maimed.
G2948.outline:
- crooked
- of the members of the body
- injured, disabled
- maimed, mutilated

G2949.gloss: from kuo (to swell (with young), i.e. bend, curve); a billow (as bursting or toppling):--wave.
G2949.outline:
- a wave (swell) esp. of the sea or of a lake
- of impulse and restless men, tossed to and fro by their raging passions

G2950.gloss: from a derivative of the base of «2949»; a "cymbal" (as hollow):--cymbal.
G2950.outline: - a cymbal, i.e. a hollow basin of brass, producing when struck together a musical sound

G2951.gloss: of foreign origin (compare «03646»); dill or fennel ("cummin"):--cummin.
G2951.outline: - cummin is a cultivated plant in Palestine with seeds that have a bitter warm taste and an aromatic flavour

G2952.gloss: neuter of a presumed derivative of «2965»; a puppy:--dog.

G2953.gloss: from «2954»; a Cyprian (Cypriot), i.e. inhabitant of Cyprus:--of Cyprus.
G2953.outline: - a Cyprian or Cypriote, i.e. a native of Cyprus

G2954.gloss: of uncertain origin; Cyprus, an island in the Mediterranean:--Cyprus.
G2954.outline:
Cyprus = "love: a blossom"
- a very fertile and delightful island of the Mediterranean, lying between Cilicia and Syria

G2955.gloss: probably from the base of «2949»; to bend forward:--stoop (down).
G2955.outline: - to stoop down, bend forward, to bow the head

G2956.gloss: from «2957»; i.e. Cyrenaean, i.e. inhabitant of Cyrene:--of Cyrene, Cyrenian.

G2957.gloss: of uncertain derivation; Cyrene, a region of Africa:--Cyrene.
G2957.outline:
Cyrene = "supremacy of the bridle"
- a large and very flourishing city of Libya Cyrenaica or Pentapolitana, about 11 miles (17 km) from the sea. Among its inhabitants were a great number of Jews, whom Ptolemy I. had brought there, and invested with the right of citizens

G2958.gloss: of Latin origin; Cyrenius (i.e. Quirinus), a Roman:--Cyrenius.
G2958.outline:
Cyrenius = "warrior"
- the Greek form of the Roman name Quirinus. His full name is Publius Sulpicius Quirinus. He was consul B.C. 12., and was made governor of Syria after the banishment of Archelaus in A.D. 6. He was probably twice governor of Syria; his first governorship extended from B.C. 4 (the year of Christ's birth) to B.C. 1. It was during this time that he was sent to make enrolment which caused Joseph and Mary to visit Bethlehem. Luke 2:2. The second enrolment is mentioned in Acts 5:37.

G2959.gloss: feminine of «2962»; Cyria, a Christian woman:--lady.
G2959.outline: - a Christian woman to whom the second Epistle of John is addressed

G2960.gloss: from «2962»; belonging to the Lord (Jehovah or Jesus):--Lord's.
G2960.outline:
- belonging to the Lord
- related to the Lord

G2961.gloss: from «2962»; to rule:--have dominion over, lord, be lord of, exercise lordship over.
G2961.outline:
- to be lord of, to rule, have dominion over
- of things and forces
- to exercise influence upon, to have power over

G2962.gloss: from kuros (supremacy); supreme in authority, i.e. (as noun) controller; by implication, Master (as a respectful title):-- God, Lord, master, Sir.
G2962.outline:
- he to whom a person or thing belongs, about which he has power of deciding; master, lord
- the possessor and disposer of a thing
- the owner; one who has control of the person, the master
- in the state: the sovereign, prince, chief, the Roman emperor
- is a title of honour expressive of respect and reverence, with which servants greet their master
- this title is given to: God, the Messiah

G2963.gloss: from «2962»; mastery, i.e. (concretely and collectively) rulers:--dominion, government.
G2963.outline:
- dominion, power, lordship
- in the NT: one who possesses dominion

G2964.gloss: from the same as «2962»; to make authoritative, i.e. ratify:--confirm.
G2964.outline:
- to make valid
- to confirm publicly or solemnly, to ratify

G2965.gloss: a primary word; a dog ("hound") (literally or figuratively):--dog.
G2965.outline:
- a dog
- metaph. a man of impure mind, an impudent man

G2966.gloss: from the base of «2849»; a limb of the body (as if lopped):--carcase.
G2966.outline:
- a member of a body, particularly the more external and prominent members esp. the feet
- a dead body, corpse, inasmuch as the members of a corpse are loose and fall apart

G2967.gloss: from the base of «2849»; to estop, i.e. prevent (by word or act):--forbid, hinder, keep from, let, not suffer, withstand.
G2967.outline:
- to hinder, prevent forbid
- to withhold a thing from anyone
- to deny or refuse one a thing

G2968.gloss: from «2749»; a hamlet (as if laid down):--town, village.
G2968.outline:
- the common sleeping place to which labourers in the field return, a village
- the name of the city near which the villages lie and to whose municipality they belong
- the inhabitants of villages

G2969.outline: - a village approximating in size and number of inhabitants to a city, a village city, a town

G2970.gloss: from «2749»; a carousal (as if letting loose):--revelling, rioting.
G2970.outline:
- a revel, carousal
- a nocturnal and riotous procession of half drunken and frolicsome fellows who after supper parade through the streets with torches and music in honour of Bacchus or some other deity, and sing and play before houses of male and female friends; hence used generally of feasts and drinking parties that are protracted till late at night and indulge in revelry

G2971.gloss: apparently a derivative of the base of «2759» and a derivative of «3700»; a mosquito (from its stinging proboscis):--gnat.
G2971.outline: - a wine gnat or midge that is bred in fermenting and evaporating wine

G2972.gloss: of uncertain origin; Cos, an island in the Mediterranean:--Cos.

G2973.gloss: of Hebrew origin (compare «07081»); Cosam (i.e. Kosam) an Israelite:--Cosam.

G2974.gloss: from «2875»; blunted, i.e. (figuratively) of hearing (deaf) or speech (dumb):--deaf, dumb, speechless.
G2974.outline:
- blunted, dull
- blunted (or lamed) in tongue, dumb
- blunted, dull in hearing
- deaf

G2975.gloss: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses; to lot, i.e. determine (by implication, receive) especially by lot:--his lot be, cast lots, obtain.
G2975.outline:
- to obtain by lot
- to receive by divine allotment, obtain
- to cast lots, determine by lot

G2976.gloss: probably of Hebrew origin («0499»); Lazarus (i.e. Elazar), the name of two Israelites (one imaginary):--Lazarus.
G2976.outline:
Lazarus = "whom God helps" (a form of the Hebrew name Eleazar)
- an inhabitant of Bethany, beloved by Christ and raised from the dead by him
- a very poor and wretched person to whom Jesus referred to in Luke 16:20-25

G2978.gloss: of uncertain derivation; a whirlwind (squall):--storm, tempest.
G2978.outline:
- a whirlwind, a tempestuous wind

G2979.outline: - to kick, strike with the heel

G2980.gloss: a prolonged form of an otherwise obsolete verb; to talk, i.e. utter words:--preach, say, speak (after), talk, tell, utter. Compare «3004».
G2980.outline:
- to utter a voice or emit a sound
- to speak
- to use the tongue or the faculty of speech
- to utter articulate sounds
- to talk
- to utter, tell
- to use words in order to declare one's mind and disclose one's thoughts
- to speak

G2981.outline:
- speech, i.e a story
- dialect, mode of speech, pronunciation
- speech which discloses the speaker's native country

G2982.gloss: or lamma lam-mah'; of Hebrew origin (4100 with prepositional prefix); lama (i.e. why):--lama.

G2985.gloss: from «2989»; a "lamp" or flambeau:--lamp, light, torch.

- a torch

G2986.gloss: from the same as «2985»; radiant; by analogy, limpid; figuratively, magnificent or sumptuous (in appearance):--bright, clear, gay, goodly, gorgeous, white.

- shining

G2993.outline:
Laodicea = "justice of the people"

G2994.gloss: from «2993»; a Laodicean, i.e. inhabitant of Laodicia:--Laodicean.
G2994.outline: - a Laodicean, an inhabitant of Laodicea

G2995.outline:
- the throat
- of the instrument or organ of speech

G2996.gloss: of uncertain origin; Lasaea, a place in Crete:--Lasea.
G2996.outline:
Lasea = "shaggy"
- a city in Crete on the coast near Fair Havens

G2997.gloss: a strengthened form of a primary verb, which only occurs in this and another prolonged form as alternate in certain tenses; to crack open (from a fall):--burst asunder.
G2997.outline:
- to crack, crackle, crash

G2998.gloss: from the same as the first part of «2991» and the base of «5114»; to quarry:--hew.

G2999.gloss: from «3000»; ministration of God, i.e. worship:--(divine) service.

- service rendered for hire
- any service or ministration: the service of God
- the service and worship of God according to the requirements of the Levitical law
- to perform sacred services

- to serve for hire
- to serve, minister to, either to the gods or men and used alike of slaves and freemen
- in the NT, to render religious service or homage, to worship
- to perform sacred services, to offer gifts, to worship God in the observance of the rites instituted for his worship
- of priests, to officiate, to discharge the sacred office

G3002.gloss: of uncertain origin; Lebbaeus, a Christian:--Lebbaeus.
G3002.outline:
Lebbaeus = "a man of heart"
- one name of Jude, who was one of the twelve apostles

G3003.gloss: of Latin origin; a "legion", i.e. Roman regiment (figuratively):--legion.
G3003.outline: - a legion, a body of soldiers whose number differed at different times, and in the time of Augustus seems to have consisted of 6826 men (i.e. 6100 foot soldiers, and 726 horsemen)

G3004.gloss: a primary verb; properly, to "lay" forth, i.e. (figuratively) relate (in words (usually of systematic or set discourse; whereas «2036» and «5346» generally refer to an individual expression or speech respectively; while «4483» is properly to break silence merely, and «2980» means an extended or random harangue)); by implication, to mean:--ask, bid, boast, call, describe, give out, name, put forth, say(-ing, on), shew, speak, tell, utter.

- to say, to speak

- to teach

- to point out with words, intend, mean, mean to say
- to call by name, to call, name
- to speak out, speak of, mention

G3006.gloss: apparently a primary word; smooth, i.e. "level":--smooth.

G3007.gloss: a primary verb; to leave, i.e. (intransitively or passively) to fail or be absent:--be destitute (wanting), lack.
G3007.outline:
- to leave, leave behind, forsake, to be left behind
- to lag, be inferior
- to be destitute of, to lack
- to be wanting, to fail

G3008.gloss: from «3011»; to be a public servant, i.e. (by analogy) to perform religious or charitable functions (worship, obey, relieve):--minister.

- to assume an office which must be administered at one's own expense
- to discharge a public office at one's own cost

- of those who aid others with their resources, and relieve their poverty

G3009.gloss: from «3008»; public function (as priest ("liturgy") or almsgiver):--ministration(-try), service.
G3009.outline:
- a public office which a citizen undertakes to administer at his own expense
- any service
- of military service
- of the service of workmen
- of that done to nature in the cohabitation of man and wife
- biblical usage
- a service or ministry of the priests relative to the prayers and sacrifices offered to God
- a gift or benefaction for the relief of the needy

G3010.gloss: from the same as «3008»; functional publicly ("liturgic"); i.e. beneficient:--ministering.
G3010.outline: - relating to the performance of service, employed in ministering

G3011.gloss: from a derivative of «2992» and «2041»; a public servant, i.e. a functionary in the Temple or Gospel, or (genitive case) a worshipper (of God) or benefactor (of man):--minister(-ed).
G3011.outline:
- a public minister, a servant of the state
- a minister, servant
- so of military labourers
- of the temple
- of one busied with holy things
- of a priest
- of the servants of a king

G3012.gloss: of Latin origin; a "linen" cloth, i.e. apron:--towel.
G3012.outline:
- a linen cloth, towel
- of the towel or apron with which servants put on when about to work

G3014.gloss: from the same as «3013»; scaliness, i.e. "leprosy":--leprosy.
G3014.outline:
- leprosy
- a most offensive, annoying, dangerous, cutaneous disease, the virus of which generally pervades the whole body, common in Egypt and the East

G3015.gloss: from the same as «3014»; scaly, i.e. leprous (a leper):--leper.
G3015.outline:
- scaly, rough
- leprous, affected with leprosy

G3016.gloss: neuter of a derivative of the same as «3013»; something scaled (light), i.e. a small coin:--mite.
G3016.outline:
- thin, small
- a small brass coin, equivalent to the eighth part of an "as", worth about a 1/5 of a cent

G3017.gloss: of Hebrew origin («03878»); Levi, the name of three Israelites:--Levi. Compare «3018».
G3017.outline:
Levi = "joined"
- the third son of the patriarch Jacob by his wife Leah, the founder of the tribe of Israelites which bears his name
- the son of Melchi, one of Christ's ancestors
- the son of Simeon, an ancestor of Christ

G3018.gloss: a form of «3017»; Lewis (i.e. Levi), a Christian:--Levi.
G3018.outline:
Levi = "joined"
- the son of Alphaeus, a collector of customs

G3019.gloss: from «3017»; a Levite, i.e. descendant of Levi:--Levite.
G3019.outline:
- one of the tribe of Levi
- in a narrower sense those were called Levites who, not being of the family of Aaron, for whom alone the priesthood was reserved, served as assistants to the priests. It was their duty to keep the sacred utensils and the temple clean, to provide the sacred loaves, to open and shut the gates of the temple, to sing the sacred hymns in the temple, and to do many other things.

G3020.gloss: from «3019»; Levitic, i.e. relating to the Levites:--Levitical.

G3022.outline:
- light, bright, brilliant
- brilliant from whiteness, (dazzling) white
- of the garments of angels, and of those exalted to the splendour of the heavenly state
- shining or white garments worn on festive or state occasions
- of white garments as the sign of innocence and purity of the soul
- dead white
- of the whitening colour of ripening grain

G3023.outline:
- a lion
- a brave and mighty hero

- andChrist as "the Lion of the tribe of Judah" (Re. 5:
-

G3025.gloss: apparently a primary word; a trough, i.e. wine-vat:--winepress.
G3025.outline:
- a tub or trough shaped receptacle, vat, in which grapes are trodden
- the lower vat, dug in the ground, into which the must or new wine flowed from the press

G3026.gloss: apparently a primary word; twaddle, i.e. an incredible story:--idle tale.

G3027.gloss: from leizomai (to plunder); a brigand:--robber, thief.

G3029.gloss: of uncertain affinity; much (adverbially):--exceeding, great(-ly), sore, very (+ chiefest).

G3030.gloss: of foreign origin («03828»); the incense-tree, i.e. (by implication) incense itself:--frankincense.
G3030.outline:
- the frankincense tree
- the perfume, frankincense

G3031.gloss: from «3030»; frankincense, i.e. (by extension) a censer for burning it:--censer.
G3031.outline:
- the gum exuding from a frankincense tree
- a censer

G3032.gloss: of Latin origin; a Roman freedman:--Libertine.

- Libertine, denotes Jews (according to Philo) who had been made captives of the Romans under Pompey but were afterwards set free; and who although they had fixed their abode in Rome, had built at their own expense a synagogue at Jerusalem which they frequented when in that city, The name Libertines adhered to them to distinguish them from free born Jews who had subsequently taken up their residence at Rome. Evidence seems to have been discovered of the existence of a "synagogue of the Libertines" at Pompeii.

The word for "Pavement" is found nowhere else in the NT, but itsHebrew equivalent occurs just once in the OT, and it is evident thatthe Holy Sprit would have us link the two passages together. In 2Kings 16:17 we read, "King Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, andremoved the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off thebrazen oxen that were under it and put it upon a "pavement" ofstones." In Ahaz's case, his act was the conclusive token of hissurrender to abject apostasy. So here of Pilate coming down to thelevel of the apostate Jews. In the former case it was a Jewish rulerdominated by a Gentile idolater; in the latter, a Gentile idolater,dominated by Jews who rejected their Messiah! AWP

G3141.gloss: from «3144»; evidence given (judicially or genitive case):--record, report, testimony, witness.

- an historical sense

G3145.gloss: from a primary masso (to handle or squeeze); to chew:--gnaw.

G3148.gloss: probably from the base of «3145» (through the idea of contact); a whip (literally, the Roman flagellum for criminals; figuratively, a disease):--plague, scourging.

G3149.gloss: from the base of «3145»; a (properly, female) breast (as if kneaded up):--pap.
G3149.outline:

- the breasts (nipples) of a man
- breasts of a women

G3152.gloss: from the base of «3155»; empty, i.e. (literally) profitless, or (specially), an idol:--vain, vanity.

- useless, of no purpose

G3153.gloss: from «3152»; inutility; figuratively, transientness; morally, depravity:--vanity.

- what is devoid of truth and appropriateness

- frailty, want of vigour

G3157.gloss: of Hebrew origin («04977»); Matthan (i.e. Mattan), an Israelite:--Matthan.

G3158.gloss: probably a shortened form of «3161»; Matthat (i.e. Mattithjah), the name of two Israelites:--Mathat.
G3158.outline:
Matthat = "gift of God"

- grandfather of the Mary

G3159.gloss: apparently a shortened form of «3161»; Matthias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite:--Matthias.
G3159.outline:
Matthias = "gift of God"

G3160.gloss: probably a shortened form of «3161» (compare «4992»); Mattatha (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite:--Mattatha.

G3161.gloss: of Hebrew origin («04993»); Mattathias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite and a Christian:--Mattathias.
G3161.outline:
Mattathias = "gift of Jehovah"
- the son of Amos, in the genealogy of Christ
- Mattathias was the son of Semei in the genealogy of Christ

G3162.gloss: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of «3163»; a knife, i.e. dirk; figuratively, war, judicial punishment:--sword.
G3162.outline:

- a straight sword, for thrusting

G3163.gloss: from «3164»; a battle, i.e. (figuratively) controversy:--fighting, strive, striving.
G3163.outline:

G3164.outline:
- to fight
- of armed combatants, or those who engage in a hand to hand struggle
- of those who engage in a war of words, to quarrel, wrangle, dispute
- of those who contend at law for property and privileges

G3165.gloss: a shorter (and probably originally) from of «1691»; me:--I, me, my.

G3166.gloss: from a compound of «3173» and aucheo (to boast; akin to «837» and «2744»); to talk big, i.e. be grandiloquent (arrogant, egotistic):--boast great things.

- to be grandiloquent

G3167.gloss: from «3173»; magnificent, i.e. (neuter, plural as noun) a conspicuous favor, or (subjectively) perfection:--great things, wonderful works.

G3168.gloss: from «3167»; superbness, i.e. glory or splendor:--magnificence, majesty, mighty power.
G3168.outline:

- of the majesty of God

G3169.gloss: from «3173» and «4241»; befitting greatness or magnificence (majestic):--excellent.
G3169.outline:

G3170.gloss: from «3173»; to make (or declare) great, i.e. increase or (figuratively) extol:--enlarge, magnify, shew great.
G3170.outline:
- to make great, magnify
- metaph. to make conspicuous
- to deem or declare great
- to esteem highly, to extol, laud, celebrate
- to get glory and praise

G3172.gloss: from «3173»; greatness, i.e. (figuratively) divinity (often God himself):--majesty.
G3172.outline:
- majesty
- of the majesty of God

- measure and height: long 1a

- persons, eminent for ability, virtue, authority, power

- a thing to be highly esteemed for its excellence: excellent
- splendid, prepared on a grand scale, stately
- great things
- of God's preeminent blessings

G3175.outline:

- of a city or a people
- of the associates or courtiers of a king

G3176.gloss: superlative of «3173»; greatest or very great:--exceeding great.

G3177.gloss: from «3326» and «2059»; to explain over, i.e. translate:--(by) interpret(-ation).

G3178.gloss: apparently a primary word; an intoxicant, i.e. (by implication) intoxication:--drunkenness.

G3179.gloss: from «3326» and «2476»; to transfer, i.e. carry away, depose or (figuratively) exchange, seduce:--put out, remove, translate, turn away.

- to remove from the office of a steward
- to depart from life, to die

G3180.gloss: from a compound of «3326» and «3593» (compare "method"); travelling over, i.e. travesty (trickery):--wile, lie in wait.

G3181.gloss: from «3326» and «3725»; bounded alongside, i.e. contiguous (neuter plural as noun, frontier):--border.

G3182.gloss: a prolonged (transitive) form of «3184»; to intoxicate:--be drunk(-en).

- to intoxicate, make drunk

G3183.gloss: from «3184»; tipsy, i.e. (as noun) a sot:--drunkard.

- to be drunken

G3185.gloss: neuter of «3187»; (adverbially) in greater degree:--the more.

G3187.gloss: irregular comparative of «3173»; larger (literally or figuratively, specially, in age):--elder, greater(-est), more.

G3190.gloss: of uncertain origin; Meleas, an Israelite:--Meleas.
G3190.outline:
Melea = "my dear friend: object of care"
- the son of Joseph in the genealogy of Christ

G3191.gloss: from a presumed derivative of «3199»; to take care of, i.e. (by implication) revolve in the mind:--imagine, (pre-)meditate.
G3191.outline:
- to care for, attend to carefully, practise
- to meditate i.e. to devise, contrive

G3193.gloss: from «3192»; relating to honey, i.e. bee (comb):--honeycomb.

G3194.gloss: of uncertain origin; Melita, an island in the Mediterranean:--Melita.
G3194.outline:

- to be about
- to be on the point of doing or suffering something

G3196.gloss: of uncertain affinity; a limb or part of the body:--member.

G3197.outline:
Melchi meaning "my king, my counsel"

G3198.outline:

- to remain, abide
- in reference to place
- to sojourn, tarry
- not to depart 1a
- to continue to be present 1a
- to be held, kept, continually
- in reference to time
- to continue to be, not to perish, to last, endure 1b
- of persons, to survive, live
- in reference to state or condition
- to remain as one, not to become another or different
- to wait for, await one

G3307.gloss: from «3313»; to part, i.e. (literally) to apportion, bestow, share, or (figuratively) to disunite, differ:--deal, be difference between, distribute, divide, give participle
G3307.outline:
- to divide

- to distribute
- a thing among people
- bestow, impart

G3308.gloss: from «3307» (through the idea of distraction); solicitude:--care.

G3309.gloss: from «3308»; to be anxious about:--(be, have) care(-ful), take thought.
G3309.outline:

- to seek to promote one's interests

G3311.gloss: from «3307»; a separation or distribution:--dividing asunder, gift.

- a division, partition
- distribution (of various kinds)
- a separation

- a part
- a part due or assigned to one
- lot, destiny
- one of the constituent parts of a whole
- in part, partly, in a measure, to some degree, as respects a part, severally, individually
- any particular, in regard to this, in this respect

G3314.gloss: from «3319» and «2250»; midday; by implication, the south:--noon, south.

- as respects to time: noon
- as respects to locality
- the south

G3315.gloss: from «3316»; to interpose (as arbiter), i.e (by implication) to ratify (as surety):--confirm.

- to act as a mediator between litigating or covenanting parties

G3318.gloss: from «3319» and «4215»; Mesopotamia (as lying between the Euphrates and the Tigris; compare 0763), a region of Asia:--Mesopotamia.

- middle
- the midst
- in the midst of, amongst

- mid-heaven

G3323.gloss: of Hebrew origin («04899»); the Messias (i.e. Mashiach), or Christ:--Messias.

- a name of Christ

G3328.gloss: from «3326» and «906»; to throw over, i.e. (middle voice figuratively) to turn about in opinion:--change mind.

- to transfer, lead over
- to direct

G3330.gloss: from «3326» and «1325»; to give over, i.e. share:--give, impart.

- to change
- of things instituted or established

G3333.gloss: from «3326» and «2564»; to call elsewhere, i.e. summon:--call (for, hither).

- to call from one place to another, to summon
- to call one's self

G3335.gloss: from «3326» and «2983»; to participate; genitive case, to accept (and use):--eat, have, be partaker, receive, take.

- to be or to be made a partner

G3338.gloss: from «3326» and the middle voice of «3199»; to care afterwards, i.e. regret:--repent (self).

- it is a care to one afterwards

G3339.gloss: from «3326» and «3445»; to transform (literally or figuratively, "metamorphose"):--change, transfigure, transform.

- to change into another form, to transform, to transfigure

- to be or become partaker
- to partake

G3353.gloss: from «3348»; participant, i.e. (as noun) a sharer; by implication, an associate:--fellow, partaker, partner.

G3384.gloss: apparently a primary word; a "mother" (literally or figuratively, immediate or remote):--mother.

- small, little

- of space

- of time: short, brief, a little while, how little!
- of quantity: i.e. number, amount
- of rank or influence

- to remind
- to be recalled or to return to one's mind, to remind one's self of, to remember
- to be recalled to mind, to be remembered, had in remembrance
- to remember a thing
- be mindful of

G3404.gloss: from a primary misos (hatred); to detest (especially to persecute); by extension, to love less:--hate(-ful).

- to hate, pursue with hatred, detest
- to be hated, detested

G3405.gloss: from «3406»; requital (good or bad):--recompence of reward.

- wages, hire

- of punishments

G3409.gloss: from «3408»; to let out for wages, i.e. (middle voice) to hire:--hire.

- to let out for hire
- to hire

Mitylene = "mutilated"

G3413.gloss: of Hebrew origin («04317»); Michael, an archangel:--Michael.

- the first of the chief princes or archangels who is supposed to be the guardian angel of the Israelites

G3415.gloss: middle voice of a derivative of «3306» or perhaps of the base of «3145» (through the idea of fixture in the mind or of mental grasp); to bear in mind, i.e. recollect; by implication, to reward or punish:--be mindful, remember, come (have) in remembrance. Compare «3403».
G3415.outline:
- to remind
- to be recalled or to return to one's mind, to remind one's self of, to remember
- to be recalled to mind, to be remembered, had in remembrance
- to remember a thing
- be mindful of

G3416.gloss: of uncertain origin; Mnason, a Christian:--Mnason.
G3416.outline:

G3417.gloss: from «3415» or «3403»; recollection; by implication, recital:--mention, remembrance.

G3418.gloss: from «3415»; a memorial, i.e. sepulchral monument (burial-place):--grave, sepulchre, tomb.

- a sepulchre or tomb

- to make mention of

G3429.gloss: from «3432»; (middle voice) to commit adultery:--commit adultery.

- an adulterer

G3433.gloss: probably by variation for «3425»; with difficulty:--hardly, scarce(-ly), + with much work.
G3433.outline:
- with difficulty, hardly

It was heated red hot by a fire from within, and the little ones placed in its arms to be slowly burned, while to prevent the parents from hearing the dying cries, the sacrificing priests beat drums

- form

- of an image or form seen in a vision
- of a dream

G3467.gloss: from a compound of the base of «3466» and ops (the face; from «3700»); to shut the eyes, i.e. blink (see indistinctly):-- cannot see far off.

G3469.gloss: from «3470»; to carp at, i.e. censure (discredit):--blame.

G3479.gloss: from «3478»; a Nazarene, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth:--of Nazareth.

G3481.gloss: of Hebrew origin («05416»); Nathan, an Israelite:--Nathan.

Nathan = "a giver"

G3482.gloss: of Hebrew origin («05417»); Nathanael (i.e. Nathanel), an Israelite and Christian:--Nathanael.

Nathanael = "gift of God"

G3484.gloss: probably of Hebrew origin (compare «04999»); Nain, a place in Palestine:--Nain.

Nain =meaning "beauty"

G3485.gloss: from a primary naio (to dwell); a fane, shrine, temple :--shrine, temple. Compare «2411».

G3487.outline:
- nard, the head or spike of a fragrant East Indian plant belonging to the genus Valerianna, which yields a juice of delicious odour which the ancients used (either pure or mixed) in the preparation of a most precious ointment
- nard oil or ointment

G3488.gloss: a flower of the same name, from narke (stupefaction, as a "narcotic"); Narcissus, a Roman:--Narcissus.
G3488.outline:
Narcissus = "stupidity"
- a dweller at Rome mentioned by Paul in Rom. 16:11

G3489.gloss: from a compound of «3491» and «71»; to be shipwrecked (stranded, "navigate"), literally or figuratively:--make (suffer) shipwreck.

G3490.gloss: from «3491» and «2819» ("clerk"); a captain:--owner of a ship.
G3490.outline:
- a ship owner, ship master
- one who hires out his vessel, or a portion of it, for purposes of transportation

G3491.gloss: from nao or neo (to float); a boat (of any size):--ship.
G3491.outline: - a ship, vessel of considerable size

G3492.gloss: from «3491»; a boatman, i.e. seaman:--sailor, shipman.

G3493.gloss: of Hebrew origin («05152»); Nachor, the grandfather of Abraham:--Nachor.
G3493.outline:
Nahor = "snorting"
- was the name of two persons in the family of Abraham, an ancestor of Christ

G3494.gloss: from a derivative of «3501»; a youth (up to about forty years):--young man.

G3495.gloss: from the same as «3494»; a youth (under forty):--young man.
G3495.outline:
- a young man, youth
- used of a young attendant or servant

G3496.gloss: from «3501» and «4172»; new town; Neapolis, a place in Macedonia:--Neapolis.
G3496.outline:
Neapolis = "new city"
- a maritime city of Macedonia, on the gulf of Syrymon, having a port and colonised by Chalcidians

G3497.gloss: of Hebrew origin («05283»); Neeman (i.e. Naaman), a Syrian:--Naaman.
G3497.outline:
Naaman the Syrian = "pleasantness"
- commander-in-chief of the army of Syria

G3498.gloss: from an apparently primary nekus (a corpse); dead (literally or figuratively; also as noun):--dead.
G3498.outline:
- properly
- one that has breathed his last, lifeless
- deceased, departed, one whose soul is in heaven or hell
- destitute of life, without life, inanimate
- metaph.
- spiritually dead
- destitute of a life that recognises and is devoted to God, because given up to trespasses and sins
- inactive as respects doing right
- destitute of force or power, inactive, inoperative

G3499.gloss: from «3498»; to deaden, i.e. (figuratively) to subdue:--be dead, mortify.
G3499.outline:
- to make dead, to put to death, slay
- worn out
- of an impotent old man
- to deprive of power, destroy the strength of

G3500.outline:
- putting to death, killing
- being put to death
- the dead state, utter sluggishness
- of bodily members and organs

G3501.gloss: including the comparative neoteros neh-o'-ter-os; a primary word; "new", i.e. (of persons) youthful, or (of things) fresh; figuratively, regenerate:--new, young.

G3504.gloss: from «3501» and a derivative of «5453»; newly planted, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert ("neophyte"):--novice.
G3504.outline:
- newly planted
- a new convert, neophyte (one who has recently become a Christian)

G3505.pos:
Nero = "brave"
  1. a famous but cruel emperor or Rome from 54 to 68 A.D.
G3505.gloss: of Latin origin; Neron (i.e. Nero), a Roman emperor:--Nero.

G3506.gloss: apparently a primary verb; to "nod", i.e. (by analogy), signal:--beckon.
G3506.outline:
- to give a nod
- to signify by a nod (of what one wishes to be done)

G3507.gloss: from «3509»; properly, cloudiness, i.e. (concretely) a cloud:--cloud.
G3507.outline:
- a cloud
- used of the cloud which led the Israelites in the wilderness

G3508.gloss: of Hebrew origin («05321»); Nephthaleim (i.e. Naphthali), a tribe in Palestine:--Nephthalim.
G3508.outline:
Naphtali = "wrestling"
- was the sixth son of Jacob, the second child borne to him by Bilhah, Rachel's slave. His posterity form the tribe of Naphtali.

G3509.gloss: apparently a primary word; a cloud:--cloud.
G3509.outline:
- a cloud, a large dense multitude, a throng
- used to denote a great shapeless collection of vapour obscuring the heavens as opposed to a particular and definite masses of vapour with some form or shape
- a cloud in the sky

G3510.gloss: of uncertain affinity; a kidney (plural), i.e. (figuratively) the inmost mind:--reins.
G3510.outline:
- a kidney
- kidneys, loins
- used of the inmost thoughts, feelings, purposes, of the soul

G3511.gloss: from a form of «3485» and koreo (to sweep); a temple-servant, i.e. (by implication) a votary:--worshipper.
G3511.outline:
- one who sweeps and cleans a temple
- one who has charge of a temple, to keep and adorn it, a sacristan
- the worshipper of a deity
- word appears from coins still extant, it was an honourary title [temple-keeper or temple-warden] of certain cities, esp. in Asia Minor, or in which some special worship of some deity or even some deified human ruler had been established; used of Ephesus

G3512.gloss: from the comparative of «3501»; appertaining to younger persons, i.e. juvenile:--youthful.
G3512.outline:
- peculiar to an age, of youth, youthful, younger
- younger (than now)
- young, youthful
- younger (by birth)
- an attendant, servant, inferiority in rank

G3513.pos:
1. by
    1. used in the affirmations of oaths
G3513.gloss: probably an intensive form of «3483»; a particle of attestation (accompanied by the object invoked or appealed to in confirmation); as sure as:--I protest by.

G3514.gloss: from neo (of like meaning); to spin:--spin.

G3515.gloss: from «3516»; to act as a babe, i.e. (figuratively) innocently:--be a child.

G3516.gloss: from an obsolete particle ne- (implying negation) and «2031»; not speaking, i.e. an infant (minor); figuratively, a simple-minded person, an immature Christian:--babe, child (+ -ish).
G3516.outline:
- an infant, little child
- a minor, not of age
- metaph. childish, untaught, unskilled

G3517.gloss: apparently from a derivative of the base of «3491» (meaning wet); Nereus, a Christian:--Nereus.
G3517.outline:
Nereus = "lump"
- a Christian at Rome saluted by Paul

G3518.gloss: of Hebrew origin («05374»); Neri (i.e. Nerijah), an Israelite:--Neri.
G3518.outline:
Neri = "Jehovah is my lamp"
- the grandfather of Zerubbabel

G3520.gloss: probably from the base of «3491»; an island:--island, isle.

G3521.gloss: from «3522»; abstinence (from lack of food, or voluntary and religious); specially, the fast of the Day of Atonement:-- fast(-ing).
G3521.outline:
- a fasting, fast
- a voluntary, as a religious exercise
- of private fasting
- the public fast as prescribed by the Mosaic Law and kept yearly on the great day of atonement, the tenth of the month of Tisri (the month Tisri comprises a part of our September and October); the fast accordingly, occurred in the autumn when navigation was usually dangerous on account of storms
- a fasting caused by want or poverty

G3522.outline: - to abstain as a religious exercise from food and drink: either entirely, if the fast lasted but a single day, or from customary and choice nourishment, if it continued several days

G3523.gloss: from the inseparable negative particle ne- (not) and «2068»; not eating, i.e. abstinent from food (religiously):--fasting.

G3524.outline:
- sober, temperate
- abstaining from wine, either entirely or at least from its immoderate use
- of things free from all wine, as vessels, offerings

G3525.gloss: of uncertain affinity: to abstain from wine (keep sober), i.e. (figuratively) be discreet:--be sober, watch.
G3525.outline:
- to be sober, to be calm and collected in spirit
- to be temperate, dispassionate, circumspect

G3526.gloss: of Latin origin; black; Niger, a Christian:--Niger.
G3526.outline:
Niger = "black"
- surname of the prophet Simeon

G3527.gloss: probably from «3528»; victorious; Nicanor, a Christian:--Nicanor.
G3527.outline:
Nicanor = "conqueror"
- one of the seven deacons in the church at Jerusalem

G3528.gloss: from «3529»; to subdue (literally or figuratively):--conquer, overcome, prevail, get the victory.
G3528.outline:
- to conquer
- to carry off the victory, come off victorious
- of Christ, victorious over all His foes
- of Christians, that hold fast their faith even unto death against the power of their foes, and temptations and persecutions
- when one is arraigned or goes to law, to win the case, maintain one's cause

G3529.gloss: apparently a primary word; conquest (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) the means of success:--victory.

G3530.gloss: from «3534» and «1218»; victorious among his people; Nicodemus, an Israelite:--Nicodemus.
G3530.outline:
Nicodemus = "conqueror"
- a member of the Sanhedrin who took the part of Jesus

G3531.gloss: from «3532»; a Nicolaite, i.e. adherent of Nicolaus:--Nicolaitane.
G3531.outline:
Nicolaitans = "destruction of people"
- a sect mentioned in Rev. 2:6,15, who were charged with holding the error of Balaam, casting a stumbling block before the church of God by upholding the liberty of eating things sacrificed to idols as well as committing fornication

G3532.gloss: from «3534» and «2994»; victorious over the people; Nicolaus, a heretic:--Nicolaus.
G3532.outline:
Nicolas = "victor of the people"
- was a proselyte of Antioch and one of the seven deacons of the church at Jerusalem

G3533.gloss: from «3534» and «4172»; victorious city; Nicopolis, a place in Macedonia:--Nicopolis.

G3534.gloss: from «3529»; a conquest (concretely), i.e. (by implication) triumph:--victory.

G3535.gloss: of Hebrew origin («05210»); Ninevi (i.e. Nineveh), the capital of Assyria:--Nineve.
G3535.outline:
Nineveh = "offspring of ease: offspring abiding"
- the capital of the ancient kingdom of Assyria

G3536.gloss: from «3535»; a Ninevite, i.e. inhabitant of Nineveh:--of Nineve, Ninevite.
G3536.outline: - a Ninevite, an inhabitant of Nineveh

G3537.outline: - a vessel for washing the hands and the feet, a basin

G3538.gloss: to cleanse (especially the hands or the feet or the face); ceremonially, to perform ablution:--wash. Compare «3068».
G3538.outline:
- to wash
- to wash one's self

G3539.gloss: from «3563»; to exercise the mind (observe), i.e. (figuratively) to comprehend, heed:--consider, perceive, think, understand.
G3539.outline:
- to perceive with the mind, to understand, to have understanding
- to think upon, heed, ponder, consider

G3540.gloss: from «3539»; a perception, i.e. purpose, or (by implication) the intellect, disposition, itself:--device, mind, thought.
G3540.outline:
- a mental perception, thought
- an evil purpose
- that which thinks, the mind, thoughts or purposes

G3541.gloss: of uncertain affinity; a spurious or illegitimate son:--bastard.
G3541.outline:
- illegitimate, bastard
- one born, not in lawful wedlock, but of a concubine or female slave

G3542.gloss: feminine from the same as «3551»; pasture, i.e. (the act) feeding (figuratively, spreading of a gangrene), or (the food) pasturage:--X eat, pasture.
G3542.outline:
- pasturage, fodder, food
- fig. he shall not want the needful supplies for the true life
- growth, increase
- of evils spreading like a gangrene
- of ulcers
- of a conflagration

G3543.gloss: from «3551»; properly, to do by law (usage), i.e. to accustom (passively, be usual); by extension, to deem or regard:-- suppose, thing, be wont.
G3543.outline:
- to hold by custom or usage, own as a custom or usage, to follow a custom or usage
- it is the custom, it is the received usage
- to deem, think, suppose

G3544.gloss: from «3551»; according (or pertaining) to law, i.e. legal (ceremonially); as noun, an expert in the (Mosaic) law:--about the law, lawyer.
G3544.outline:
- pertaining to the law, one learned in the law
- in the NT an interpreter and teacher of the Mosaic law

G3545.gloss: adverb from a derivative of «3551»; legitimately (specially, agreeably to the rules of the lists):--lawfully.
G3545.outline: - lawfully, agreeable to the law, properly

G3546.gloss: from «3543»; what is reckoned as of value (after the Latin numisma), i.e. current coin:--money.
G3546.outline:
- anything received and sanctioned by usage or law
- money, (current) coin, legal tender

G3547.gloss: from «3551» and «1320»; an expounder of the (Jewish) law, i.e. a Rabbi:--doctor (teacher) of the law.
G3547.outline:
- a teacher and interpreter of the law: among the Jews
- of those who among Christians went about as champions and interpreters of the Mosaic law

G3548.gloss: from «3550»; legislation (specially, the institution of the Mosaic code):--giving of the law.

G3549.gloss: from «3550»; to legislate, i.e. (passively) to have (the Mosaic) enactments injoined, be sanctioned (by them):--establish, receive the law.
G3549.outline:
- to enact laws
- laws are enacted or prescribed for one, to be legislated for, furnished with laws
- to sanction by law, enact

G3550.gloss: from «3551» and a derivative of «5087»; a legislator:--lawgiver.

G3551.gloss: from a primary nemo (to parcel out, especially food or grazing to animals); law (through the idea of prescriptive usage), genitive case (regulation), specially, (of Moses (including the volume); also of the Gospel), or figuratively (a principle):--law.
G3551.outline:
- anything established, anything received by usage, a custom, a law, a command
- of any law whatsoever
- a law or rule producing a state approved of God 1a
- by the observance of which is approved of God
- a precept or injunction
- the rule of action prescribed by reason
- of the Mosaic law, and referring, acc. to the context. either to the volume of the law or to its contents
- the Christian religion: the law demanding faith, the moral instruction given by Christ, esp. the precept concerning love
- the name of the more important part (the Pentateuch), is put for the entire collection of the sacred books of the OT

G3552.gloss: from «3554»; to be sick, i.e. (by implication, of a diseased appetite) to hanker after (figuratively, to harp upon):--dote.
G3552.outline:
- to be sick
- metaph. of any ailment of the mind
- to be taken with such an interest in a thing as amounts to a disease, to have a morbid fondness for

G3554.gloss: of uncertain affinity; a malady (rarely figuratively, of moral disability):--disease, infirmity, sickness.

G3555.outline:
- a nest of birds
- a brood of birds

G3557.gloss: middle voice from nosphi (apart or clandestinely); to sequestrate for oneself, i.e. embezzle:--keep back, purloin.
G3557.outline:
- to set apart, separate, divide
- to set apart or separate for one's self
- to purloin, embezzle, withdraw covertly and appropriate to one's own use

G3558.gloss: of uncertain affinity; the south(-west) wind; by extension, the southern quarter itself:--south (wind).
G3558.outline:
- the south wind
- the south, the southern quarter

G3559.gloss: from «3563» and a derivative of «5087»; calling attention to, i.e. (by implication) mild rebuke or warning:--admonition.

G3560.gloss: from the same as «3559»; to put in mind, i.e. (by implication) to caution or reprove gently:--admonish, warn.

G3561.gloss: feminine of a compound of «3501» and «3376» (as noun by implication, of «2250»); the festival of new moon:--new moon.
G3561.outline:
- new moon
- of the Jewish festival of the new moon

G3562.gloss: adverb from a comparative of the accusative case of «3563» and «2192»; in a mind-having way, i.e. prudently:--discreetly.

G3563.gloss: probably from the base of «1097»; the intellect, i.e. mind (divine or human; in thought, feeling, or will); by implication, meaning:--mind, understanding. Compare «5590».
G3563.outline:
- the mind, comprising alike the faculties of perceiving and understanding and those of feeling, judging, determining
- the intellectual faculty, the understanding
- reason in the narrower sense, as the capacity for spiritual truth, the higher powers of the soul, the faculty of perceiving divine things, of recognising goodness and of hating evil
- the power of considering and judging soberly, calmly and impartially
- a particular mode of thinking and judging, i.e thoughts, feelings, purposes, desires

G3564.gloss: probably contracted for a compound of «3565» and «1435»; nymph-given (i.e. -born); Nymphas, a Christian:--Nymphas.
G3564.outline:
Nymphas = "bridegroom"
- a wealthy and zealous Christian in Laodicea

G3565.gloss: from a primary but obsolete verb nupto (to veil as a bride; compare Latin "nupto," to marry); a young married woman (as veiled), including a betrothed girl; by implication, a son's wife:--bride, daughter in law.
G3565.outline:
- a betrothed woman, a bride
- a recently married woman, young wife
- a young woman
- a daughter-in-law

G3567.outline:
- the chamber containing the bridal bed, the bridal chamber
- of the friends of the bridegroom whose duty it was to provide and care for whatever pertained to the bridal chamber, i.e. whatever was needed for the due celebration of the nuptials
- the room in which the marriage ceremonies are held

G3568.gloss: a primary particle of present time; "now" (as adverb of date, a transition or emphasis); also as noun or adjective present or immediate:--henceforth, + hereafter, of late, soon, present, this (time). See also «3569», «3570».
G3568.outline: - at this time, the present, now

G3569.gloss: from neuter plural of «3588» and «3568»; the things now, i.e. (adverbially) at present:--(but) now.

G3570.gloss: a prolonged form of «3568» for emphasis; just now:--now.

G3571.outline:
- night
- metaph. the time when work ceases
- the time of death
- the time for deeds of sin and shame
- the time of moral stupidity and darkness
- the time when the weary and also the drunken give themselves up to slumber

G3572.gloss: apparently a primary word; to prick ("nudge"):--pierce.
G3572.outline:
- pierce
- to pierce through, transfix
- often of severe or even deadly wounds given one

G3573.gloss: from a presumed derivative of «3506»; to nod, i.e. (by implication) to fall asleep; figuratively, to delay:--slumber.
G3573.outline:
- to nod in sleep, to sleep
- to be overcome or oppressed with sleep
- to fall asleep, drop off to sleep
- to be negligent, careless
- of a thing i.e. to linger, delay

G3574.gloss: from «3571» and «2250»; a day-and-night, i.e. full day of twenty-four hours:--night and day.
G3574.outline: - a night and a day, the space of twenty four hours

G3575.gloss: of Hebrew origin («05146»); Noe, (i.e. Noach), a patriarch:--Noe.
G3575.outline:
Noah = "rest"
- the tenth in descent from Adam, second father of the human family

G3576.gloss: from a derivative of «3541»; sluggish, i.e. (literally) lazy, or (figuratively) stupid:--dull, slothful.

G3578.gloss: from «3581»; hospitality, i.e. (by implication) a place of entertainment:--lodging.
G3578.outline:
- hospitality, hospitable reception
- a lodging place, lodgings

G3579.gloss: from «3581»; to be a host (passively, a guest); by implication, be (make, appear) strange:--entertain, lodge, (think it) strange.
G3579.outline:
- to receive as a guest, to entertain, hospitably
- to be received hospitably
- to stay as a guest, to lodge
- be lodged
- to surprise or astonish by the strangeness and novelty of a thing
- to think strange, be shocked

G3580.gloss: from a compound of «3581» and «1209»; to be hospitable:--lodge strangers.
G3580.outline: - to receive and entertain hospitably, to be hospitable

G3581.gloss: apparently a primary word; foreign (literally, alien, or figuratively, novel); by implication, a guest or (vice-versa) entertainer:--host, strange(-r).
G3581.outline:
- a foreigner, a stranger
- alien (from a person or a thing)
- without the knowledge of, without a share in
- new, unheard of
- one who receives and entertains another hospitably
- with whom he stays or lodges, a host

G3582.gloss: as if from xeo (properly, to smooth; by implication, (of friction) to boil or heat); a vessel (as fashioned or for cooking) (or perhaps by corruption from the Latin sextarius, the sixth of a modius, i.e. about a pint), i.e. (specially), a measure for liquids or solids, (by analogy, a pitcher):--pot.
G3582.outline:
- a sextarius
- a vessel for measuring liquids, holding about a pint (.5 litre)
- a wooden pitcher or ewer from which water or wine is poured, whether holding a sextarius or not

G3583.gloss: from «3584»; to desiccate; by implication, to shrivel, to mature:--dry up, pine away, be ripe, wither (away).
G3583.outline:
- to make dry, dry up, wither
- to become dry, to be dry, be withered
- of plants
- of the ripening of crops
- of fluids
- of the members of the body
- to waste away, pine away, i.e. a withered hand

G3584.gloss: from the base of «3582» (through the idea of scorching); arid; by implication, shrunken, earth (as opposed to water):--dry land, withered.
G3584.outline:
- dry
- of members of the body deprived of their natural juices, shrunk, wasted, withered
- of the land in distinction from the water

G3586.gloss: from another form of the base of «3582»; timber (as fuel or material); by implication, a stick, club or tree or other wooden article or substance:--staff, stocks, tree, wood.
G3586.outline:
- wood
- that which is made of wood
- as a beam from which any one is suspended, a gibbet, a cross
- a log or timber with holes in which the feet, hands, neck of prisoners were inserted and fastened with thongs
- a fetter, or shackle for the feet
- a cudgel, stick, staff
- a tree

G3587.gloss: from a derivative of the same as «3586» (meaning a razor); to shave or "shear" the hair:--shave.
G3587.outline:
- to shear, shave
- to get one's self shaved

G3588.gloss: in all their inflections; the definite article; the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom):--the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc.

G3591.gloss: probably from the same as «43»; a mass (as bending or bulging by its load), i.e. burden (hindrance):--weight.
G3591.outline:
- whatever is prominent, protuberance, bulk, mass
- hence a burden, weight, encumbrance

G3592.pos: 1. this one here, these things, as follows, thus
G3592.gloss: from «3588» and «1161»; the same, i.e. this or that one (plural these or those); often used as a personal pronoun:--he, she, such, these, thus.

G3594.gloss: from «3595»; to show the way (literally or figuratively (teach)):--guide, lead.
G3594.outline:
- to be a guide, lead on one's way, to guide
- to be a guide or a teacher
- to give guidance to

G3595.gloss: from «3598» and «2233»; a conductor (literally or figuratively (teacher)):--guide, leader.
G3595.outline:
- a leader of the way, a guide
- a teacher of the ignorant and inexperienced

G3596.gloss: from a compound of «3598» and «4198»; to be a wayfarer, i.e. travel:--go on a journey.

G3598.gloss: apparently a primary word; a road; by implication, a progress (the route, act or distance); figuratively, a mode or means:--journey, (high-)way.
G3598.outline:
- properly
- a way
- a travelled way, road
- a travellers way, journey, travelling
- metaph.
- a course of conduct
- a way (i.e. manner) of thinking, feeling, deciding

G3599.gloss: perhaps from the base of «2068»; a "tooth":--tooth.

G3600.outline:
- to cause intense pain
- to be in anguish, be tormented
- to torment or distress one's self

G3602.gloss: from a derivative of the base of «1416»; moaning, i.e. lamentation:--mourning.

G3603.gloss: from the neuter of «3739» and the third person singular present indicative of «1510»; which is:--called, which is (make), that is (to say).

G3604.gloss: of Hebrew origin («05818»); Ozias (i.e. Uzzijah), an Israelite:--Ozias.
G3604.outline:
Uzziah = "strength of Jehovah"
- son of Amaziah, king of Judah from B.C. 810 - 758

G3605.gloss: a primary verb (in a strengthened form); to scent (usually an ill "odor"): stink.
G3605.outline:
- to give out an odour (either good or bad), to smell, emit a smell
- of a decaying corpse

G3606.gloss: from «3739» with the directive enclitic of source; from which place or source or cause (adverb or conjunction):--from thence, (from) whence, where(-by, -fore, -upon).
G3606.outline:
- from which, whence
- of the place from which
- of the source from which a thing is known, from which, whereby
- of the cause from which, for which reason, wherefore, on which account

G3607.gloss: of uncertain affinity; a linen cloth, i.e. (especially) a sail:--sheet.
G3607.outline:
- linen (i.e. fine white linen for women's clothing)
- linen clothes (sheet or sail)

G3608.gloss: neuter of a presumed derivative of «3607»; a linen bandage:--linen clothes.
G3608.outline:
- a piece of linen, small linen cloth
- strips of linen cloth for swathing the dead

G3609.gloss: from «3624»; domestic, i.e. (as noun), a relative, adherent:--(those) of the (his own) house(-hold).
G3609.outline:
- belonging to a house or family, domestic, intimate
- belonging to one's household, related by blood, kindred
- belonging to the household of God
- belonging, devoted to, adherents of a thing

G3610.gloss: from «3611»; a fellow resident, i.e. menial domestic:--(household) servant.

G3612.gloss: from «3611»; a tenement, i.e. (specially), a jail:--prison.
G3612.outline:

G3613.gloss: neuter of a presumed derivative of «3611» (equivalent to «3612»); a residence (literally or figuratively):--habitation, house.

G3614.gloss: from «3624»; properly, residence (abstractly), but usually (concretely) an abode (literally or figuratively); by implication, a family (especially domestics):--home, house(-hold).

G3615.gloss: from «3614»; familiar, i.e. (as noun) relatives:--they (them) of (his own) household.
G3615.outline:

G3616.gloss: from «3617»; to be the head of (i.e. rule) a family:--guide the house.
G3616.outline:
- to be master (or head) of a house
- to rule a household, manage family affairs

G3617.gloss: from «3624» and «1203»; the head of a family:--goodman (of the house), householder, master of the house.

G3618.gloss: from the same as «3619»; to be a house-builder, i.e. construct or (figuratively) confirm:--(be in) build(-er, -ing, up), edify, embolden.

- to found, establish

G3619.gloss: feminine (abstract) of a compound of «3624» and the base of «1430»; architecture, i.e. (concretely) a structure; figuratively, confirmation:--building, edify(-ication, -ing).
G3619.outline:
- (the act of) building, building up
- metaph. edifying, edification
- the act of one who promotes another's growth in Christian wisdom, piety, happiness, holiness
- a building (i.e. the thing built, edifice)

G3621.gloss: from «3623»; to manage (a house, i.e. an estate):--be steward.
G3621.outline:
- to be a steward

- to manage, dispense, order, regulate

G3622.gloss: from «3623»; administration (of a household or estate); specially, a (religious) "economy":--dispensation, stewardship.

- the office of a manager or overseer, stewardship

- the manager of household or of household affairs

- the manager of a farm or landed estate, an overseer
- the superintendent of the city's finances, the treasurer of a city (or of treasurers or quaestors of kings)
- metaph. the apostles and other Christian teachers and bishops and overseers

G3624.gloss: of uncertain affinity; a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally or figuratively):--home, house(-hold), temple.
G3624.outline:
- a house
- an inhabited house, home
- any building whatever
- of a palace
- the house of God, the tabernacle
- any dwelling place

- of tents, and huts, and later, of the nests, stalls, lairs, of animals

- the inmates of a house, all the persons forming one family, a household
- the family of God, of the Christian Church, of the church of the Old and New Testaments
- stock, family, descendants of one

G3625.gloss: feminine participle present passive of «3611» (as noun, by implication, of «1093»); land, i.e. the (terrene part of the) globe; specially, the Roman empire:--earth, world.
G3625.outline:
- the inhabited earth
- the portion of the earth inhabited by the Greeks, in distinction from the lands of the barbarians

- the whole inhabited earth, the world
- the inhabitants of the earth, men
- the universe, the world

G3626.gloss: from «3624» and ouros (a guard; be "ware"); a stayer at home, i.e. domestically inclined (a "good housekeeper"):--keeper at home.
G3626.outline:
- caring for the house, working at home
- the (watch or) keeper of the house
- keeping at home and taking care of household affairs
- a domestic

G3628.outline:
- compassion, pity, mercy
- bowels in which compassion resides, a heart of compassion
- emotions, longings, manifestations of pity

G3630.gloss: from «3631» and a derivative of the alternate of «4095»; a tippler:--winebibber.
G3630.outline: - a winebibber, given to wine, a wino

G3631.gloss: a primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin («03196»)); "wine" (literally or figuratively):--wine.
G3631.outline:
- wine
- metaph. fiery wine of God's wrath

G3632.gloss: from «3631» and a form of the base of «5397»; an overflow (or surplus) of wine, i.e. vinolency (drunkenness):--excess of wine.

G3634.gloss: probably akin to «3588», «3739», and «3745»; such or what sort of (as a correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverbially) with negative, not so:--so (as), such as, what (manner of), which.
G3634.outline: - what sort of, what manner of, such as

G3635.gloss: from oknos (hesitation); to be slow (figuratively, loath):--delay.
G3635.outline:
- to feel loath, to be slow
- to delay, hesitate

G3636.gloss: from «3635»; tardy, i.e. indolent; (figuratively) irksome:--grievous, slothful.

G3637.gloss: from «3638» and «2250»; an eight-day old person or act:--the eighth day.
G3637.outline:
- eight days old
- passing the eighth day

G3639.gloss: from a primary ollumi (to destroy; a prolonged form); ruin, i.e. death, punishment:--destruction.
G3639.outline:
- ruin, destroy, death
- for the destruction of the flesh, said of the external ills and troubles by which the lusts of the flesh are subdued and destroyed

G3640.gloss: from «3641» and «4102»; incredulous, i.e. lacking confidence (in Christ):--of little faith.
G3640.outline: - of little faith, trusting too little

G3641.gloss: of uncertain affinity; puny (in extent, degree, number, duration or value); especially neuter (adverbially) somewhat:--+ almost, brief(-ly), few, (a) little, + long, a season, short, small, a while.
G3641.outline:
- little, small, few
- of number: multitude, quantity, or size
- of time: short
- of degree or intensity: light, slight

G3643.gloss: from a compound of «3641» and ora ("care"); to have little regard for, i.e. to disesteem:--despise.
G3643.outline: - to care little for, regard lightly, make small account

G3644.gloss: from «3645»; a ruiner, i.e. (specially), a venomous serpent:--destroyer.

G3646.gloss: from a derivative of a compound of «3650» and a derivative of «2545»; a wholly-consumed sacrifice ("holocaust"):--(whole) burnt offering.

- a whole burnt offering

G3647.gloss: from «3648»; integrity, i.e. physical wholeness:--perfect soundness.
G3647.outline:

G3648.gloss: from «3650» and «2819»; complete in every part, i.e. perfectly sound (in body):--entire, whole.
G3648.outline:

- of a body without blemish or defect, whether of a priest or of a victim
- free from sin, faultless
- complete in all respects, consummate

G3649.gloss: a reduplicated primary verb; to "howl" or "halloo", i.e. shriek:--howl.
G3649.outline:
- to howl, wail, lament
- of a loud cry whether for joy or of grief

G3650.gloss: a primary word; "whole" or "all", i.e. complete (in extent, amount, time or degree), especially (neuter) as noun or adverb:--all, altogether, every whit, + throughout, whole.

G3651.gloss: from «3650» and «5056»; complete to the end, i.e. absolutely perfect:--wholly.

G3652.gloss: probably a contraction from Olumpiodoros (Olympian-bestowed, i.e. heaven-descended); Olympas, a Christian:--Olympas.

G3653.gloss: of uncertain derivation; an unripe (because out of season) fig:--untimely fig.

G3654.gloss: adverb from «3650»; completely, i.e. altogether; (by analogy), everywhere; (negatively) not by any means:--at all, commonly, utterly.

G3655.gloss: of uncertain affinity; a thunder storm:--shower.
G3655.outline:
- a shower
- a violent storm, accompanied by high wind with thunder and lightning

G3656.gloss: from «3658»; to be in company with, i.e. (by implication) to converse:--commune, talk.
G3656.outline:
- to be in company with
- to associate with
- to stay with
- to converse with, talk about: with one

G3658.gloss: from the base of «3674» and a derivative of the alternate of «138» (meaning a crowd); association together, i.e. a multitude:--company.
G3658.outline: - a multitude of men gathered together, a crowd, a throng

G3659.gloss: from «3700»; a sight, i.e. (by implication) the eye:--eye.

G3660.gloss: to swear, i.e. take (or declare on) oath:--swear.
G3660.outline:
- to swear
- to affirm, promise, threaten, with an oath

G3661.gloss: adverb from a compound of the base of «3674» and «2372»; unanimously:--with one accord (mind).
G3661.outline:
- with one mind, with one accord, with one passion
A unique Greek word, used 10 of its 12 New Testament occurrences inthe Book of Acts, helps us understand the uniqueness of the Christiancommunity. Homothumadon is a compound of two words meaning to "rushalong" and "in unison". The image is almost musical; a number ofnotes are sounded which, while different, harmonise in pitch andtone. As the instruments of a great concert under the direction of aconcert master, so the Holy Spirit blends together the lives ofmembers of Christ's church.

G3663.gloss: from «3664» and the alternate of «3958»; similarly affected:--of (subject to) like passions.

- like, similar, resembling

- like: i.e. corresponding to a thing

- to be made like

G3668.outline: - likewise, equally, in the same way

G3669.outline:
- a making like
- likeness: after the likeness of God

G3670.gloss: from a compound of the base of «3674» and «3056»; to assent, i.e. covenant, acknowledge:--con- (pro-)fess, confession is made, give thanks, promise.
G3670.outline:

- to concede

- declare

- profession

G3673.gloss: from the base of «3674» and «5078»; a fellow-artificer:--of the same craft.

G3675.gloss: from the base of «3674» and «5424»; like-minded, i.e. harmonious:--of one mind.

G3676.gloss: adverb from the base of «3674»; at the same time, i.e. (conjunctionally) notwithstanding, yet still:--and even, nevertheless, though but.

G3678.gloss: neuter of a presumed derivative of «3688»; a little ass:--young ass.

G3679.gloss: from «3681»; to defame, i.e. rail at, chide, taunt:--cast in teeth, (suffer) reproach, revile, upbraid.

- to reproach, upbraid, revile

Onesiphorus = "bringing profit"

G3687.gloss: from «3686»; to name, i.e. assign an appellation; by extension, to utter, mention, profess:--call, name.

- vinegar

G3692.gloss: probably from «3700»; a hole (as if for light), i.e. cavern; by analogy, a spring (of water):--cave, place.

- of fissures in the earth
- of caves in rocks or mountains, holes

G3694.gloss: from the same as «3693» with enclitic of direction; to the back, i.e. aback (as adverb or preposition of time or place; or as noun):--after, back(-ward), (+ get) behind, + follow.

- back, behind, after, afterwards

G3695.gloss: from «3696»; to equip (with weapons (middle voice and figuratively)):--arm self.

- to arm, furnish with arms
- to provide

G3696.outline:
- any tool or implement for preparing a thing
- arms used in warfare, weapons
- an instrument

G3698.gloss: from «3739» and «4218»; what(-ever) then, i.e. (of time) as soon as:--when.

G3703.gloss: apparently from the base of «3796» and «5610»; properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit:--fruit.

G3704.gloss: from «3739» and «4459»; what(-ever) how, i.e. in the manner that (as adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or actual):--because, how, (so) that, to, when.

G3705.gloss: from «3708»; something gazed at, i.e. a spectacle (especially supernatural):--sight, vision.

G3707.gloss: from «3708»; gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being seen:--visible.

G3708.gloss: properly, to stare at (compare «3700»), i.e. (by implication) to discern clearly (physically or mentally); by extension, to attend to; by Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear:--behold, perceive, see, take heed.

- to see with the eyes
- to see with the mind, to perceive, know
- to see, i.e. become acquainted with by experience, to experience

G3709.gloss: from «3713»; properly, desire (as a reaching forth or excitement of the mind), i.e. (by analogy), violent passion (ire, or (justifiable) abhorrence); by implication punishment:--anger, indignation, vengeance, wrath.

G3710.gloss: from «3709»; to provoke or enrage, i.e. (passively) become exasperated:--be angry (wroth).

G3712.gloss: from «3713»; a stretch of the arms, i.e. a fathom:--fathom.

G3714.gloss: from «3735»; mountainous, i.e. (feminine by implication, of «5561») the Highlands (of Judaea):--hill country.

G3716.gloss: from a compound of «3717» and «4228»; to be straight-footed, i.e. (figuratively) to go directly forward:--walk uprightly.
G3716.outline:
- to walk in a straight course
- metaph. to act uprightly

G3717.gloss: probably from the base of «3735»; right (as rising), i.e. (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct:--straight, upright.
G3717.outline:
- straight, erect
- upright

- to cut straight, to cut straight ways

- daybreak, dawn

G3724.gloss: from «3725»; to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e. (figuratively) to appoint, decree, specify:--declare, determine, limit, ordain.

G4028.gloss: from «4012» and «2572»; to cover all around, i.e. entirely (the face, a surface):--blindfold, cover, overlay.

G4029.gloss: from «4012» and «2749»; to lie all around, i.e. inclose, encircle, hamper (literally or figuratively):--be bound (compassed) with, hang about.
G4029.outline:
- to lie around
- to be compassed with, have round one

G4030.gloss: feminine of a compound of «4012» and «2776»; encirclement of the head, i.e. a helmet:--helmet.
G4030.outline:
- a helmet
- metaph.
- the protection of the soul which consists in (the hope of) salvation

G4031.gloss: from «4012» and «2904»; strong all around, i.e. a master (manager):--+ come by.

G4032.gloss: from «4012» and «2928»; to conceal all around, i.e. entirely:--hide.

G4033.gloss: from «4012» and «2944»; to encircle all around, i.e. blockade completely:--compass round.
G4033.outline:
- to encircle, compass about
- of a city (besieged)

G4034.gloss: from «4012» and «2989»; to illuminate all around, i.e. invest with a halo:--shine round about.

G4035.gloss: from «4012» and «3007»; to leave all around, i.e. (passively) survive:--remain.
G4035.outline:
- to leave over
- to remain over, to survive

G4036.gloss: from «4012» and «3077»; grieved all around, i.e. intensely sad:--exceeding (very) sorry(-owful).
G4036.outline:
- very sad, exceedingly sorrowful
- overcome with sorrow so much as to cause one's death

G4037.gloss: from «4012» and «3306»; to stay around, i.e. await:--wait for.

G4038.gloss: adverb from «4012»; all around, i.e. (as an adjective) circumjacent:--round about.

G4039.gloss: from «4012» and «3611»; to reside around, i.e. be a neighbor:--dwell round about.
G4039.outline: - to dwell round about, to be one's neighbour

G4040.gloss: from «4012» and «3624»; housed around, i.e. neighboring (used elliptically as a noun):--neighbour.

G4041.gloss: from the present participle feminine of a compound of 4012 and «1510»; being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own):--peculiar.
G4041.outline:
- that which is one's own, belonging to one's possessions
- a people selected by God from the other nations for his own possession

G4042.gloss: from «4023»; a being held around, i.e. (concretely) a passage (of Scripture, as circumscribed):--place.
G4042.outline:

- that which is contained
- the contents of any writing

G4043.gloss: from «4012» and «3961»; to tread all around, i.e. walk at large (especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport oneself, follow (as a companion or votary):--go, be occupied with, walk (about).

- an obtaining

G4048.gloss: from «4012» and «4486»; to tear all around, i.e. completely away:--rend off.
G4048.outline:

- that which is left over, residue, remains

- to be over, to remain

- to abound, overflow

- to be pre-eminent, to excel
- to excel more than, exceed
- to make to abound
- to furnish one richly so that he has abundance
- to make abundant or excellent

G4053.outline:
- exceeding some number or measure or rank or need

- exceeding abundantly, supremely

- more abundantly

- more earnestly, more exceedingly
- especially, above others

G4060.gloss: from «4012» and «5087»; to place around; by implication, to present:--bestow upon, hedge round about, put about (on, upon), set about.

- to put or bind a thing around another
- to present, to bestow, confer, a thing upon one

- to be driven

Persis = "a Persian woman"

G4070.gloss: adverb from «4009»; the by-gone, i.e. (as noun) last year:--+ a year ago.
G4070.outline:
- last year
- the year just past

G4075.outline:
- rocky, stony

- rue

- a wandering, a straying about

- fulness, abundance, plenitude

G4151.gloss: from «4154»; a current of air, i.e. breath (blast) or a breeze; by analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit, the Holy Spirit:--ghost, life, spirit(-ual, -ually), mind. G4224.gloss: from the alternate of «4095»; a drinking-bout or carousal:--banqueting.

G4228.gloss: a primary word; a "foot" (figuratively or literally):--foot(-stool).

G4229.gloss: from «4238»; a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material):--business, matter, thing, work.

G4233.gloss: from a derivative of «4238»; a practiser, i.e. (specially), an official collector:--officer.

G4234.gloss: from «4238»; practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a function:--deed, office, work.

- in a bad sense, wicked deed, crime, wicked doings (our practices i.e. trickery)

- to undertake, to do

- to act

- mildness of disposition, gentleness of spirit, meekness
Meekness toward God is that disposition of spirit in which we acceptHis dealings with us as good, and therefore without disputing orresisting. In the OT, the meek are those wholly relying on God ratherthan their own strength to defend them against injustice. Thus,meekness toward evil people means knowing God is permitting theinjuries they inflict, that He is using them to purify His elect, andthat He will deliver His elect in His time. (Is. 41:17, Lu. 18:1-

-

- to stand out, to be conspicuous, to be eminent
- to be becoming, seemly, fit

G4242.gloss: from «4243»; seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors):--ambassage, message.

- elder, of age,
- the elder of two people
- advanced in life, an elder, a senior
- forefathers
- a term of rank or office
- among the Jews
- members of the great council or Sanhedrin (because in early times the rulers of the people, judges, etc., were selected from elderly men)
- of those who in separate cities managed public affairs and administered justice
- among the Christians, those who presided over the assemblies (or churches) The NT uses the term bishop, elders, and presbyters interchangeably
- the twenty four members of the heavenly Sanhedrin or court seated on thrones around the throne of God

G4246.gloss: from the same as «4245»; an old man:--aged (man), old man.
G4246.outline:
- an old man, an aged man
- ambassador

G4247.gloss: feminine of «4246»; an old woman:--aged woman.

G4248.gloss: from «4253»; leaning (falling) forward ("prone"), i.e. head foremost:--headlong.

Priscilla = "ancient"

- to go before

G4255.gloss: from «4253» and «138»; to choose for oneself before another thing (prefer), i.e. (by implication) to propose (intend):--purpose.

- to purpose

G4256.gloss: from «4253» and a derivative of «156»; to accuse already, i.e. previously charge:--prove before.

G4257.gloss: from «4253» and «191»; to hear already,i.e. anticipate:--hear before.

- to hear before

G4291.gloss: from «4253» and «2476»; to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise:--maintain, be over, rule.

- to set or place before
- to set over
- to be over, to superintend, preside over
- to be a protector or guardian
- to give aid
- to care for, give attention to
- profess honest occupations

G4292.gloss: middle voice from «4253» and «2564»; to call forth to oneself (challenge), i.e. (by implication) to irritate:--provoke.
G4292.outline:
- to call forth
- to call forth to one's self
- esp. to challenge to a combat or contest with one
- to provoke, to irritate

- to beat forward

- an opinion formed before the facts are known

- to take before

G4302.gloss: from «4253» and «3004»; to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn:--foretell, tell before.

- antetestor

- to provide for one

G4307.gloss: from «4306»; forethought, i.e. provident care or supply:--providence, provision.

- forethought, providential care

G4313.gloss: from «4253» and «4198»; to precede (as guide or herald):--go before.

- to send before, to make to precede
- to go before one

- of a messenger or a herald

G4314.outline:
- to the advantage of
- at, near, by
- to, towards, with, with regard to

- to go up further

- to be given or addicted to
- to devote thought and effort to

- a stranger, alien
- a proselyte

- for a season

- temporary

- to bid to come to one's self

- a joining the party of one
- partiality

G4347.outline:

- to rush upon, beat against
- to be made to stumble by a thing
- i.e. metaph. to be induced to sin

G4352.outline:

- to Christ
- to heavenly beings
- to demons

-

G4424.outline:
Ptolemais or Accho = "warlike"
- a maritime city of Phoenicia, which got its name, apparently, from Ptolemy Lathyrus, who captured it 103 BC, and rebuilt it more beautifully

G4425.gloss: from «4429»; a winnowing-fork (as scattering like spittle):--fan.

G4426.gloss: from a presumed derivative of «4429» (and thus akin to «4422»); to frighten:--terrify.

G4428.gloss: probably akin to petannumi (to spread; and thus apparently allied to «4072» through the idea of expansion, and to 4429 through that of flattening; compare «3961»); to fold, i.e. furl a scroll:--close.

G4430.gloss: from the alternate of «4098»; a ruin, i.e. (specially), lifeless body (corpse, carrion):--dead body, carcase, corpse.
G4430.outline:
- a fall, downfall
- metaph. a failure, defeat, calamity
- an error, lapse into sin
- that which has fallen
- the fallen body of one dead or slain, a corpse, a carcase

G4431.gloss: from the alternate of «4098»; a crash, i.e. downfall (literally or figuratively):--fall.

G4432.gloss: from «4433»; beggary, i.e. indigence (literally or figuratively):--poverty.
G4432.outline:
- beggary
- in the NT poverty
- the condition of one destitute of riches and abundance

G4433.gloss: from «4434»; to be a beggar, i.e. (by implication) to become indigent (figuratively):--become poor.
G4433.outline: - to be a beggar, to beg, to be poor

G4434.gloss: from ptosso (to crouch); akin to «4422» and the alternate of «4098»); a beggar (as cringing), i.e. pauper (strictly denoting absolute or public mendicancy, although also used in a qualified or relative sense; whereas «3993» properly means only straitened circumstances in private), literally (often as noun) or figuratively (distressed):--beggar(-ly), poor.
G4434.outline:
- reduced to beggary, begging, asking alms
- destitute of wealth, influence, position, honour
- lowly, afflicted, destitute of the Christian virtues and eternal riches
- helpless, powerless to accomplish an end
- poor, needy
- lacking in anything
- as respects their spirit
- destitute of wealth of learning and intellectual culture which the schools afford (men of this class most readily give themselves up to Christ's teaching and proved them selves fitted to lay hold of the heavenly treasure)

G4435.gloss: from a primary pux (the fist as a weapon); the clenched hand, i.e. (only in dative case as adverb) with the fist (hard scrubbing):--oft.
G4435.outline:
- the fist, clenched hand
- up to the elbow

G4436.gloss: from Putho (the name of the region where Delphi, the seat of the famous oracle, was located); a Python, i.e. (by analogy, with the supposed diviner there) inspiration (soothsaying):-- divination.
G4436.outline:
